title: LPU Pitch Fest 2026 – Pitch Your Startup & Get Investment Opportunity : LPU/18.4/RESM/2024/006/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Dear All, Registrations are now open for LPU Pitch Fest 2026, organized by the Department of Entrepreneurship & Startups, Division of Innovation & Entrepreneurship, under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing, Lovely Professional University. LPU Pitch Fest 2026 provides student entrepreneurs and aspiring founders an opportunity to present their innovative ideas and startup ventures before investors, industry experts, and mentors Pitch your idea, receive expert evaluation, and get an opportunity to secure investment for your startup! Event Detail 1.) Event Name: LPU Pitch Fest 2026 2.) Date: 03rd September 2026 3.) Guest Lecture: 09:00 AM – 12:00 Block 32 4.) Startup Pitching Session:After 12:00 Capgemini Block, Block 34 Event Highlights Guest Lecture by Industry Experts Live Startup Pitching Session Direct Interaction with Investors Expert Evaluation & Feedback Mentorship & Networking Opportunities Investment Opportunity of up to ?10 Lakhs Investment Opportunity Selected startup ideas may get an investment opportunity of up to ?10 Lakhs based on the evaluation and assessment of the startup by the jury/investors. The final investment decision will be taken solely by the investor based on the evaluation, potential, feasibility, scalability, business model, and other relevant parameters. Important Note The pitching session is only for shortlisted/selected startups and student entrepreneurs. DL (Duty Leave) will be provided only to students participating in the startup pitching session. Students attending only the guest lecture or as audience members will **not be eligible for DL. Selected participants must be available for the pitching session after the guest lecture.* The investment amount is not guaranteed and will be decided by the investor after evaluation. Registration: https://forms.gle/4VfBRoun5dQK2krE6

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. Application Deadline Application Deadline: Please refer to the official scholarship page for the current application deadline. Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/reliance-foundation-scholarships Google Forms: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqXDebzrBjZu05n75b0L2-RRnqsVbW5ckY9ajpVfn0s4rHzQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104097927478792016511 Note 1. It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. 2. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. 3. Students are advised to carefully check the programme-specific eligibility criteria before applying. 4. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in.

title: Today is the Last date to Enroll in Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260831/0004 (8/31/2026)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement.To join the Skill Development Courses, you are required to complete the payment through the enrollment link provided below by 31st August, 2026. Please note: As per the requests received from students, the last date for registration has been extended to 31st August, 2026.Tentatively classes will start from 1st September and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll SDC Courses: 31-08-2026 Enrolment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in

body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of Kotak Mahindra Group Companies, aimed at providing financial support to meritorious girl students from economically disadvantaged sections to help them pursue higher education. Under this scholarship, eligible girl students pursuing professional undergraduate courses can receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to cover their academic expenses and other educational costs. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. The scholarship is applicable for professional undergraduate courses in fields such as Engineering, Medicine, Design, Architecture, Specialised Commerce, Finance, Computer Courses, and other professional courses. The applicant must be studying in a recognized college/university/institution in India. Benefits Selected students will receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to support their educational expenses. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. For any queries regarding the conference or the poster presentation or academic benefits, you can meet Prof. Rahul Saha at Block 38-Room 207, Cabin 3.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. The scholarship is applicable for professional undergraduate courses in fields such as Engineering, Medicine, Design, Architecture, Specialised Commerce, Finance, Computer Courses, and other professional courses. The applicant must be studying in a recognized college/university/institution in India. Benefits Selected students will receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to support their educational expenses. Application Deadline: 31 August Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EnF7gh947EmjwYXWA Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “PersonaX” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct a workshop titled “The GD Playbook: A Workshop on Strategies to Speak, Lead and Influence”. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. This workshop aims to help students understand the importance of participating effectively in a Group Discussion (GD) in professional environments. title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. Application Deadline Application Deadline: Please refer to the official scholarship page for the current application deadline. Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/reliance-foundation-scholarships Google Forms: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqXDebzrBjZu05n75b0L2-RRnqsVbW5ckY9ajpVfn0s4rHzQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104097927478792016511 Note 1. It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. 2. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. 3. Students are advised to carefully check the programme-specific eligibility criteria before applying. 4. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in.

title: Today is the Last date to Enroll in Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260831/0004 (8/31/2026)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement.To join the Skill Development Courses, you are required to complete the payment through the enrollment link provided below by 31st August, 2026. Please note: As per the requests received from students, the last date for registration has been extended to 31st August, 2026.Tentatively classes will start from 1st September and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. This workshop aims to help students understand the importance of participating effectively in a Group Discussion (GD) in professional environments. The session will focus on how employers evaluate discussion skills - not merely on speaking ability, but on clarity, confidence, structure, teamwork, listening, and contextual awareness. title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. For any queries regarding the conference or the poster presentation or academic benefits, you can meet Prof. Rahul Saha at Block 38-Room 207, Cabin 3.

body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of Kotak Mahindra Group Companies, aimed at providing financial support to meritorious girl students from economically disadvantaged sections to help them pursue higher education. Under this scholarship, eligible girl students pursuing professional undergraduate courses can receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to cover their academic expenses and other educational costs. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. title: Today is the Last date to Enroll in Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260831/0004 (8/31/2026)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of Kotak Mahindra Group Companies, aimed at providing financial support to meritorious girl students from economically disadvantaged sections to help them pursue higher education. Under this scholarship, eligible girl students pursuing professional undergraduate courses can receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to cover their academic expenses and other educational costs. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “PersonaX” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct a workshop titled “The GD Playbook: A Workshop on Strategies to Speak, Lead and Influence”. This workshop aims to help students understand the importance of participating effectively in a Group Discussion (GD) in professional environments. The session will focus on how employers evaluate discussion skills - not merely on speaking ability, but on clarity, confidence, structure, teamwork, listening, and contextual awareness. The main objectives of the event are: · To encourage participants to express their ideas clearly, confidently, and effectively. · To help participants analyse different perspectives, build logical arguments, and work constructively with others. · To provide participants with an opportunity to demonstrate leadership, active listening, problem-solving, and the ability to make informed decisions. Target Audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 1st September, 2026 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 14-101L Resource Person: Ms. Vidushi Vidhu Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/TheGDPlaybookWorkshop

title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. For any queries regarding the conference or the poster presentation or academic benefits, you can meet Prof. Rahul Saha at Block 38-Room 207, Cabin 3.

body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. title: The GD Playbook: A Workshop on Strategies to Speak, Lead and Influence : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260831/0002 (8/31/2026)
body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “PersonaX” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct a workshop titled “The GD Playbook: A Workshop on Strategies to Speak, Lead and Influence”. This workshop aims to help students understand the importance of participating effectively in a Group Discussion (GD) in professional environments. The session will focus on how employers evaluate discussion skills - not merely on speaking ability, but on clarity, confidence, structure, teamwork, listening, and contextual awareness. The main objectives of the event are: · To encourage participants to express their ideas clearly, confidently, and effectively. · To help participants analyse different perspectives, build logical arguments, and work constructively with others. · To provide participants with an opportunity to demonstrate leadership, active listening, problem-solving, and the ability to make informed decisions. Target Audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 1st September, 2026 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 14-101L Resource Person: Ms. Vidushi Vidhu Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/TheGDPlaybookWorkshop

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Applications “Vedic Maths – A workshop based on speed maths.” This workshop focuses on mastering techniques to identify patterns, break down complex shapes, and accurately count figures—an essential component of reasoning sections in competitive examinations. Through interactive problem sets, smart shortcuts, and structured strategies, participants will strengthen observation skills and boost analytical speed. Whether you’re preparing for banking exams, SSC, GATE, or other competitive tests, this session offers an excellent opportunity to elevate your problem-solving mindset. Don’t miss this opportunity to gain a winning edge and elevate your analytical mindset. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 1st September, 2026 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 38-502 Resource Person: Ms. Sadhna Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/VedicMathsWorkshopSpeedMath

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship.
