title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0001 (8/31/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of Kotak Mahindra Group Companies, aimed at providing financial support to meritorious girl students from economically disadvantaged sections to help them pursue higher education. Under this scholarship, eligible girl students pursuing professional undergraduate courses can receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to cover their academic expenses and other educational costs. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. The scholarship is applicable for professional undergraduate courses in fields such as Engineering, Medicine, Design, Architecture, Specialised Commerce, Finance, Computer Courses, and other professional courses. The applicant must be studying in a recognized college/university/institution in India. Benefits Selected students will receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to support their educational expenses. Application Deadline: 31 August Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EnF7gh947EmjwYXWA Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. Application Deadline Application Deadline: Please refer to the official scholarship page for the current application deadline. Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/reliance-foundation-scholarships Google Forms: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqXDebzrBjZu05n75b0L2-RRnqsVbW5ckY9ajpVfn0s4rHzQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104097927478792016511 Note 1. It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. 2. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. 3. Students are advised to carefully check the programme-specific eligibility criteria before applying. 4. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in.

title: Today is the Last date to Enroll in Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260831/0004 (8/31/2026)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement.To join the Skill Development Courses, you are required to complete the payment through the enrollment link provided below by 31st August, 2026. Please note: As per the requests received from students, the last date for registration has been extended to 31st August, 2026.Tentatively classes will start from 1st September and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “PersonaX” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct a workshop titled “The GD Playbook: A Workshop on Strategies to Speak, Lead and Influence”. This workshop aims to help students understand the importance of participating effectively in a Group Discussion (GD) in professional environments. The session will focus on how employers evaluate discussion skills - not merely on speaking ability, but on clarity, confidence, structure, teamwork, listening, and contextual awareness. The main objectives of the event are: · To encourage participants to express their ideas clearly, confidently, and effectively. · To help participants analyse different perspectives, build logical arguments, and work constructively with others. · To provide participants with an opportunity to demonstrate leadership, active listening, problem-solving, and the ability to make informed decisions. Target Audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. For any queries regarding the conference or the poster presentation or academic benefits, you can meet Prof. Rahul Saha at Block 38-Room 207, Cabin 3.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0001 (8/31/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of Kotak Mahindra Group Companies, aimed at providing financial support to meritorious girl students from economically disadvantaged sections to help them pursue higher education. Under this scholarship, eligible girl students pursuing professional undergraduate courses can receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to cover their academic expenses and other educational costs. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. The scholarship is applicable for professional undergraduate courses in fields such as Engineering, Medicine, Design, Architecture, Specialised Commerce, Finance, Computer Courses, and other professional courses. The applicant must be studying in a recognized college/university/institution in India. Benefits Selected students will receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to support their educational expenses. Application Deadline: 31 August Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EnF7gh947EmjwYXWA Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

body: Dear Vertos, Are you ready to create a positive impact while enhancing your skills, personality, and leadership abilities? The LPU-NSS Recruitment Drive 2026 is now open, offering you an incredible opportunity to become a part of a prestigious community dedicated to service, leadership, social responsibility, and nation-building. Registration Link: https://forms.gle/XdWjKDYtysBMasho8 Why Join NSS? Become a part of India’s largest youth movement for community service. Develop leadership, teamwork, communication, and organizational skills. Get opportunities to participate in State-level and National-level camps, awareness drives, and impactful social initiatives. Earn recognition while contributing meaningfully towards society. Build confidence, discipline, and a strong sense of responsibility. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. For any queries regarding the conference or the poster presentation or academic benefits, you can meet Prof. Rahul Saha at Block 38-Room 207, Cabin 3.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. The scholarship is applicable for professional undergraduate courses in fields such as Engineering, Medicine, Design, Architecture, Specialised Commerce, Finance, Computer Courses, and other professional courses. The applicant must be studying in a recognized college/university/institution in India. Benefits Selected students will receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to support their educational expenses. Application Deadline: 31 August Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EnF7gh947EmjwYXWA Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “PersonaX” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct a workshop titled “The GD Playbook: A Workshop on Strategies to Speak, Lead and Influence”. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260831/0003 (8/31/2026)
body: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026-27 is an initiative of Reliance Foundation that aims to support talented and meritorious students in pursuing higher education and building successful careers. Under this scholarship, eligible students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes can receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 to support their educational expenses. Eligibility For Undergraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class XII. Must have taken admission in an eligible undergraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to students pursuing eligible undergraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Selection is based on academic merit, aptitude, and other criteria specified by Reliance Foundation. For Postgraduate Students Applicant must be an Indian citizen. Must have secured a minimum of 7.5 CGPA or equivalent in their undergraduate degree. Applicants with a valid GATE score of 550–1,000 may also be eligible. Must be enrolled in an eligible postgraduate degree programme at a recognized institution in India. The scholarship is applicable to eligible postgraduate programmes as specified by Reliance Foundation. Benefits Selected students may receive financial assistance of up to INR 6,00,000 during the duration of their eligible programme, subject to the applicable scholarship terms and conditions. The scholarship also provides opportunities for students to become part of the Reliance Foundation Scholars community and benefit from development and networking opportunities. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. This workshop aims to help students understand the importance of participating effectively in a Group Discussion (GD) in professional environments. title: Poster Presentation at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information Security (ICAIIS 2026) : LPU/9.1/OADM/2024/010/IC/260829/0001 (8/29/2026)
body: The Research and Development Cell (RDC) at Lovely Professional University is organizing the International Conference on AI in Information Security 2026 (ICAIIS 2026) on 10-11 September 2026. The conference is focused on advancing research and innovation in the duality of AI and Information Security. As part of the conference, a Poster Presentation category is open for students and scholars to present their research ideas, ongoing work, innovations, and project outcomes. The scholars, with no papers or posters but interested in gaining advanced knowledge in the domain of Information Security and AI and industrial practices, and wishing to know the conference environment, can also join as "LPU Participants without paper" category. Registration link: https://www.lpu.in/conferences/icaiis/registration-form.php (Copy the link in a new tab to work.) Poster Registration Fee (Poster): INR 800 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days Other registration for LPU (without paper): INR 1000 per author. Includes: Conference kit, certificate, and food coupons for 2 days All the registered students, irrespective of registration category, will get Academic Benefits along with Certificates. Poster presentation Guidelines: 1. Poster Size to Maintain: Participants should prepare the poster in A0 size, portrait orientation. Recommended dimensions: 84.1 cm × 118.9 cm or 33.1 inches × 46.8 inches. 2. The best three posters will be awarded prizes. 3. The poster should clearly include the title, author details, affiliation, introduction, objectives, methodology, results/findings, conclusion, and references, wherever applicable. title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship : LPU/20.4/INDU/2026/003/IC/260828/0002 (8/28/2026)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2026 till 11:59 pm Apply Now : Google Form:- https://forms.gle/HNUTV25DDhxTQgyq8 Website Link:- https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at industry.interface@lpu.co.in

title: Overcoming MTI (Mother Tongue Influence) for Effective Vocal Communication — A Workshop on Accent Neutralization and Clear Speech : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260801/0002 (7/28/2026)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Overcoming MTI (Mother Tongue Influence) for Effective Vocal Communication — A Workshop on Accent Neutralization and Clear Speech”. This workshop will help students to identify and correct pronunciation patterns influenced by their mother tongue that affect clarity, confidence, and professionalism in spoken English. Participants will be introduced to common MTI patterns found among Hindi, Punjabi, Haryanvi, and other regional-language speakers, and will practice correcting them through guided listening, articulation drills, and live speaking exercises. The workshop aims to simulate real interview and workplace speaking situations, enabling students to apply correct stress, intonation, and pronunciation while communicating with clarity and confidence. The main objectives of the event: · To help students identify their own Mother Tongue Influence (MTI) patterns affecting pronunciation and clarity. · To train participants in correct articulation, word stress, and intonation for professional spoken English. · To build confidence in neutral, clear vocal communication for interviews, presentations, and workplace interactions. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 1st August, 2026 Time: 07:00 PM Onwards Venue: Online Resource Person: Mr.Rohit Pannu Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/OverComingMTIWorkshop

title: LPU brings: The Global Experience of Academic Excellence at National University of Singapore – Asia's #1 University : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/260727/0002 (7/27/2026)
body: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations cell) brings an exciting opportunity for LPU students to go on 8 days, 16th August 2026 – 23rd August 2026 Academic Immersion Program Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at National University of Singapore, Singapore (Ranked # 8 in the world and # 1 in Asia). This program is only for B. Tech Computer Science and Engineering, B.Sc. Computer Science, BCA, B. Tech Electronics and Communication, B. Tech Electrical, Bachelor of Design (Multimedia), BBA students & B. Com. Eligibility: Only for Bachelor Students. Minimum 6 CGPA No backlog No re-appear Selection of participation is based on profile evaluation. Duration: 16th August 2026 – 23rd August 2026 Application Deadline: 2nd August 2026 Scholarship: 30,000 INR (First 5 students only) Program Cost: SGD 2,500 (1,88,000 INR) Initial Deposit: INR 80,000 Final Fee: 1,58,000 INR Registration fee: Rs.2000 Highlights: Introduction with the latest technologies in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Students will have the knowledge on the fundamentals of AI including the various types of machine learning algorithms. Hands-on experience in applying AI and ML on real-world data. Global Networking: Interaction with international peers and faculty. Cultural Experience: Visit iconic attractions like Marina Bay & Gardens by the Bay. Full Day trip to the Universal Studio. COURSE STRUCTURE - TOPICS DURATION Session 1: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Big Data 3.0 hours Session 2: Introduction to Machine: Learning 3.0 hours Session 3: Supervised Machine Learning 3.0 hours Session 4: Neural Networks and Deep Learning 3.0 hours Session 5: Group Project and Presentations 3.0 hours Inclusions: Professional and administrative fee. Programme delivery of 15 hours contact time in classroom (3 hours each day) - from 02:00 PM to 05:00 PM Venue for pre-arranged classroom activities. Welcome gift for participants. Technical support on-site and online. E-Certificate of completion for participants who successfully completed and passed the programme. 7 Nights Hotel Accommodation on Twin sharing with Breakfast. Local Airport Transfers (Group Pick Up & Drop as per the timings) Local Transport for NUS Visit. Universal Studio - Full Day trip on 22nd August 2026. Exclusions: International Airfare Visa Fees Lunch & Dinner Travel Insurance Personal Expenses Please note: The fees are to be paid to an International Account. If students prefer to pay to an Indian Account, an additional 18% GST will apply. Register here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1FNgthuHKrtfUfbHvmGpAQ5KpQL40gPqUCY0DYHVunvo/edit For further information, please contact Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310), Contact No. 9875928583 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Satya Scholarship Program 2026 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-8)/IC/260724/0109 (7/24/2026)
body: The Nehru Sidhant Kender Trust (“the Trust”) is dedicated to empowering young minds, particularly girl students, by enhancing access to quality higher education. The Trust has launched the Satya Scholarship Program 2026, a merit-cum-means initiative designed to assist students from various socio-economic backgrounds in pursuing higher education after Class 12. The scholarship offers 100% coverage of annual course fees, plus accommodation and meal support, for students enrolled in 3–5-year undergraduate or integrated master's programs in Commerce, Engineering & Technology, and Medical & Health Sciences. It is available to students from Punjab admitted to 38 selected institutes in Ludhiana district, and to Ludhiana district students entering any of the top 50 NIRF-ranked institutions in India. Recipients will be known as Satya Scholars. The scholarship is renewable annually based on academic performance, attendance, conduct, and continued enrollment Link to apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/satya-scholarship-program The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30-07-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: . Open to first-year students in 3 to 5-year undergraduate or integrated master's courses in: a) Commerce: BBA, B. Com b) Engineering and Technology: B. Tech, (all streams), BCA, B. Arch c) Medical and Health Sciences: BPT . Must have passed Class 12 Board Exam from a recognised board in Punjab with at least 60% aggregate. . Students from the Ludhiana district who have secured admission to any of the above courses at one of the top 50 NIRF-ranked institutions across India are eligible for the scholarship. (List Attached) . Annual parental income must not exceed INR 8 lakh; guardian income limits apply for orphans. Note: . Preference for girl students, sportspersons, persons with disabilities (PwD), orphans, and children of single parents. . Satya Scholars must maintain 75% attendance, good conduct, and a minimum GPA of 6 (or 60% marks) for scholarship renewal. Benefits: . 100% of the annual course fee coverage as per the approved fee structure of the selected institute, for the full duration of the course (3 to 5 years). . Hostel and mess charges or PG/rented accommodation support will be provided to all eligible scholars studying outside their hometown, based on the institute's approved charges or actual expenses incurred, whichever is lower. . For institutes without hostel facilities, a fixed monthly stipend of ?5,000 will be provided towards accommodation and meals. Note: . Refundable charges, including caution money and security deposits, are not covered under the scholarship and shall be borne by the student. . If a Satya Scholar has already paid the course fee to the institute at the time of scholarship announcement, the amount paid will be reimbursed directly to the bank account of the scholar or the parent/guardian, as applicable. title: Enroll in Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260603/0001 (6/3/2026)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. Moreover, students can also join Foreign language courses. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 5th June,2026.Tentatively classes will start from 8th June 2026 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll SDC Courses: 05-06-2026 Enrolment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in To get detailed information about SDC courses you can join online session on 04-06-2026 Session link: https://tinyurl.com/sdclpu Slots of sessions are provided below: 10:00am-10:30am 12:00pm-12:30pm 03:00pm-03:30pm 04:00pm-04:30pm

title: LPU Global | Sponsored Study Visit to Russia - Limited Slots Available : LPU/11.2/IRC(USPR)/2024/001(1.3)/IC/260602/0001 (6/2/2026)
body: The Division of International Affairs is excited to present a sponsored short-term international summer school programme for LPU students at our esteemed partner university, HSE University, Russia. This is a rare opportunity to gain hands-on academic exposure, immerse yourself in a new culture, and build a truly global perspective - all as part of your journey at LPU. This opportunity is available only for 10 students of LPU. Programme Highlights : Duration: 10 Days | July 2026 – August 2026 (27th or 28th July 2026 to 7th/8th August 2026 Host University: HSE University, Russia For Students of: School of Architecture, Design, Multimedia, Game Design, Fine Arts, and UI/UX What's Covered: All of the following are fully sponsored for selected students: · Local travel in Russia · Accommodation · Meals · Academic lectures and workshops · Cultural excursions and activities What You Pay Students are responsible for : · International travel (return airfare) · Visa fees · Travel Insurance · Program fee: ? 25,000 only Who Can Apply? · Currently enrolled in Design or related programmes at LPU Under Grade & Graduate students from the School of Architecture, Design, Multimedia, Game Design, Fine Arts, and UI/UX). · Minimum CGPA: 8.5 and above. · Minimum age: 18 years · Must hold a valid passport with a minimum validity of 6 Months Important Details: Number of Seats Available in the Program : Only 10 Registration Deadline : 7th June 2026 Selection Process: Profile Assessment followed by an Interview Round. Students holding a valid passport should apply Note: International tickets must be booked independently by selected students as per the deadline communicated at the time of selection. How to Apply Register Here: https://forms.gle/4oprHQubACJg88fHA Please note: Seats are extremely limited - we strongly encourage interested students to register at the earliest. For More Information, Contact: Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310) Ph: 91-9875928583, Email: study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Admission Referral – National Students (Under Student Revenue Generation Policy – EDU Revolution) : LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260602/0001 (6/2/2026)
body: Admission Referral – National Students (Under Student Revenue Generation Policy – EDU Revolution) Last date to apply for admission with current scholarship extended till 2nd June. Hurry Up! As part of the University’s Education Revolution (EDU Revolution) and the Student Revenue Generation Policy, Lovely Professional University continues to empower students to become active contributors in the institution’s growth journey. Students can now refer eligible and high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the structured Revenue Generation framework. Students are advised to refer to the official announcement titled “Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution)” (Ref. No.: LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260330/0001) for detailed guidelines. Path to Apply: UMS → Student Services → Admission Referral Form. Guidelines (Mandatory) - The referral in all cases must be new and should not exist in any university system before submission. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. -No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - All referrals must be submitted through the official university portal only. - University holds final discretion on approval of referral and allocation of points. - Points will be reviewed and awards will be granted based on total accumulated points by November 2026. Referral Policy is not applicable in the following cases: - Admission for Online or Distance Mode programmes. - Referring student who is receiving a 100% scholarship. -An existing student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - Candidate who has already applied for admission before submission of the referral form. - If the referred student’s admission status is not active. All interested students are requested to follow the above-mentioned process and complete the form accordingly. Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) is attached for your reference. For any further clarification, you are kindly requested to visit Ms. Kavita Ghotra at Block 30-408, Cabin 5.

Following important points are to be kept in mind for applying the internship letter: 1. All the eligible students must apply for summer Internship online through the University Management System (UMS) via the following path: UMS Navigation-->Academics-->Placement Services-->Internship Recommendation Letter 2. While applying from the above interface all the students needs to specify one of the following two modes for obtaining training certificate either via MODE 1-E-mail (signed digital letter) or via Mode 2-Hard copy (Physical copy from TPC office). 3. Respective Training & Placement coordinators need to verify the student application and provide recommendation on the same via UMS. 4. All student(s) must ensure that before starting their summer Internship their application should be duly approved from respective School-TPC. 5. All 4–6-week summer internships must start in June 2026 and have an end date of or before 30th July 2026. Screenshot for student UMS interface are also attached as Annexure II with this announcement. title: Information Regarding Summer Training / Internship (2028 Graduating Batch – B.Tech CSE/IT) : LPU/6.12/TPC3/2025/003/IC/260420/0002 (4/20/2026)
body: As per the scheme of CSE/IT, all second-year students (2028 graduating batch) are required to undergo a mandatory 4–6 weeks summer training/internship after the completion of their 4th semester (2nd year of B.Tech). Eligible students will be divided into the following two categories, and must complete training accordingly: 1. Domain Technologies Students in this category must complete their training/internship in non-programming domains, such as: Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Cloud Computing, Full Stack Development (FSD), Database, Networks, Cyber Security, Data Science,etc. Students in this category may also opt for an internship, subject to prior approval from the Career Counselling Cell. 2. Core Technologies Students in this category must complete their training in programming languages only, as it is essential for Computer Science students to gain strong programming proficiency. Categorization Criteria Categorization (Domain/Core) will be based on academic performance (grades from 1st to 3rd semester). For lateral entry students, it will be based on 1st semester grades. The category allocation will be communicated separately. Special PEP (Professional Enhancement Program) Due to evolving hiring practices, companies are now assessing students as early as the 5th semester and offering internships after the 6th semester. To prepare students a selected group (from placement-registered students) will undergo Special PEP training. This training will be conducted offline on campus. Allocation in this input will be through a test followed by interview. Selected students must stay on campus during summer vacations. The list of shortlisted students will be shared separately. Competitive Programming/Data Structures and Algorithms, Professional Communication Skills will be taught during the training. A Mandatory Summer Training Project will be part of training program. Placement Preparedness Course A comprehensive, accessible training program for students who wish to strengthen their placement readiness skills while remaining on campus. Key Features: Selection Process: No entrance test required; open enrollment for all Students Mode: Paid Program Curriculum Focus: Core Programming Concepts + Data Structure and Algorithms Database Management Systems (DBMS) Computer Networks Professional Communication Skills Mandatory Project Additional Resources: Access to LMS (Learning Management System) Portal AI-Powered Mock Interview Platform Personalized feedback and performance analytics Category: Core Technologies Training / Internship Process: For detailed information Visit Website Link: https://tinyurl.com/csesummertraining2028 NOTE: You are advised not to enroll in any course without verifying your eligibility(CORE/DOMAIN) and getting the confirmation of the recommended courses from website.

title: Summer Break Opportunity – Upskill, Get Certified & Gain Academic Advantage. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)(Vol-1)/IC/260417/0094 (4/17/2026)
body: As you step into the Summer Break before start of the next academic session, this is the perfect time to invest in yourself and accelerate your future learning journey by effectively utilizing this transition period to gain a head start for the upcoming academic term. Students are encouraged to undertake activities that can be aligned with or mapped to their upcoming term courses, thereby enabling better conceptual understanding and application of knowledge in advance as well as makes you eligible for relevant academic benefits/equivalence by: . Enrolling in and completing NPTEL / SWAYAM/SWAYAM+ courses . Pursuing relevant national and international industry certifications . Undertaking paid/unpaid internships beyond the curriculum . Working on industry-relevant projects (preferably with industry collaboration or from standardized platforms) . Enrolling in skill development courses . Participating in community service projects (beyond the Community Development courses) Please Note: The above are indicative options; students may choose other options as well and may seek advice/consent of their mentor/faculty member in this regard for other possible options Additionally, the students should also actively participate in the Summer Rev opportunity wherein students would get opportunity to Earn, Learn and Gain Academic Benefits On completion and submission of relevant proofs on EDU Rev portal the students shall be eligible for academic benefits/equivalence in upcoming term as per the university guidelines under EDU Revolution after due verification. A brief description of the activities and how they can be conducted is described below: Initiative Description NPTEL / SWAYAM courses . Find out mapped NPTEL/SWAYAM certifications available for courses of your upcoming term . Complete the chosen certification and submit the relevant proof National and International industry certifications . Gain certifications from reputed platforms (like Coursera, Google, Microsoft, AWS, IBM, Meta, and Salesforce etc.) to build job-ready skills. Internships beyond the curriculum . Work with companies or organizations or professional to get real-world experience and effective skill development (e.g., get ideas from Internshala, LinkedIn internships, startups). Industry-relevant projects . Work on practical projects that solve real problems and strengthen your hands-on skills (e.g., Smart India Hackathon, GitHub projects, Freelancing Projects (Fiverr/Upwork etc.) Skill development courses . Short courses to improve important skills like coding, communication, design, or analytics (e.g. edX; LinkedIn Learning Community service projects . Participate in social or community-based activities to develop teamwork, leadership, and social responsibility (e.g., NSS activities, NGO volunteering, social impact projects) Use this summer to prepare, progress, and perform better in the upcoming term.

title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS). : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260417/0092 (4/17/2026)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from May 2026. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is finalization of : a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for SAS registration: a. The research scholar must have cleared the course work or must be exempted for the same due to M. Phil. b. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration c. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy Note: Research scholars from the School of Agriculture who have cleared the first term of coursework may request for registration at: rdc.sas@lpu.co.in The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation: All eligible research scholars are required to register for SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 17th April 2026 to 13th May 2026. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis: All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the attached guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->SAS-->Click to Submit report. All the research scholars are required to completely register for SAS evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the synopsis followed by the verification of synopsis by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 17th April 2026 to 13th May 2026. 3. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluations --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --->SAS. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the SAS synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 15th May 2026. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt the domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co Supervisor/ Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 13th May 2026, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS. d) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from November 2026 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. e) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. h) Research scholars are required to bring two hard copies of the Synopsis report, duly verified and signed by the respective Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (wherever applicable), at the time of evaluation. i) It is mandatory to submit one hard copy of the SAS report to CRDP (Block 38, Room No. 304), while the second copy must be retained by the scholar for reference by the panel members during the evaluation. j) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. k) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. m) The research scholar must bring their own laptop and projector cable (HDMI & VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding SAS registration, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: Student Services --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).
