title: Invitation to Attend Bharat Innovation Challenge - Grand Finale on 17th and 18th April 2026 : LPU/19.4/DCG/2024/002/IC/260416/0003 (4/16/2026)
body: Dear Staff/ Faculty/ Students It is our privilege to invite you to the Grand Finale of the Bharat Innovation Challenge 2025-26, to be held on 17th & 18th April 2026, at the campus of Lovely Professional University, Punjab. Recognised as India's Biggest Brain Marathon, the Bharat Innovation Challenge is a national initiative that empowers students aged 13–18 to develop AI-powered, real-world solutions. What began as a vision has evolved into a nationwide movement, engaging participants from 28 states, 500+ cities, and thousands of schools across India. The Grand Finale marks the culmination of this journey, bringing together the most promising young innovators from across the country. Finalist teams will showcase their ideas and prototypes before an esteemed panel of industry leaders, academicians, and domain experts, offering them a unique platform for recognition and growth. The Event Will Feature: 1. Innovation Expo showcasing student prototypes 2. Pitching sessions to jury from industry 3. Industry & expert interactions 4. Awards & recognition ceremony Participants will compete across multiple themes and categories, with top teams receiving cash prizes worth Rs. 14+ Lakh, further encouraging innovation and excellence. The Bharat Innovation Challenge is supported by a strong ecosystem of industry and knowledge partners, whose contributions play a vital role in mentoring participants and strengthening the overall impact of the initiative. We believe that your presence will add immense value to this celebration of innovation and will inspire the young minds who are shaping the future of our nation. We would be honoured to have you join us on this significant occasion. The formal invitation is attached herewith for your reference. For more queries, please contact Mr. Amritpal Singh Kalsi (98885-98735), Dr. Manoj Sindhwani (90415-93324), Mr. Rahul Vishwakarma (97795-45556).

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Headline Hackathon – A Competition on Creative Communication”. This competition is designed to enhance students’ creativity, collaborative thinking, and professional communication skills by challenging teams to design and present a startup product announcement using an unconventional method. Teams will work together within a limited time to plan a startup concept, organise their thoughts, and prepare a visual press release poster that clearly explains their innovation, its purpose, target audience, and real-world relevance. After preparation, teams will present their product where they will formally announce their startup, explain the features of their product, justify its usefulness, and respond confidently as if addressing media or investors. Students can now refer eligible and high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the structured Revenue Generation framework. Students are advised to refer to the official announcement titled “Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution)” (Ref. Guidelines (Mandatory) - The referral in all cases must be new and should not exist in any university system before submission. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - All referrals must be submitted through the official university portal only. - University holds final discretion on approval of referral and allocation of points. - Points will be reviewed and awards will be granted based on total accumulated points by November 2026. Referral Policy is not applicable in the following cases: - Admission for Online or Distance Mode programmes. - Referring student who is receiving a 100% scholarship. - An existing student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - Candidate who has already applied for admission before submission of the referral form. - If the referred student’s admission status is not active. All interested students are requested to follow the above-mentioned process and complete the form accordingly. Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) is attached for your reference. title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260410/0020 (4/10/2026)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from June 2026 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State-of-the-Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) biannually after successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of ETP registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy for that term. c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. e. In case the scholar has communicated/accepted/published a research/review article, the scholar is required to select the log request ID while registering for ETP evaluation. A log request can be generated through the supervisor’s UMS via following path: UMS Navigation --> Research and Development Cell --> Research and academic contributions --> Monthly status of research achievements/log request Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->ETP Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 10th April 2026 to 6th May 2026 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics --> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->ETP-->Click to Submit report. ETP reports will be considered only if submitted through the UMS interface. Submissions made through any other means, such as email or RMS, will not be accepted. Therefore, all scholars must ensure that their reports are uploaded through the online interface. Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 10th April 2026 to 6th May 2026 3. Selection of ETP Evaluation Slot Research scholars are required to select their preferred week for the upcoming ETP evaluation through the UMS interface after uploading the ETP report. The scholars can follow the below mentioned Path for selecting the slots: Academics --> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity--> Click to Select the ETP Evaluation Slot --> Click to select the ETP evaluation slot The selected slot will be final and cannot be changed under any circumstances. Scholars must ensure their availability as per the allotted schedule. Slot modification will be permitted only in case of a university-declared event or holiday. Note:- The scheduled slots are applicable only for RAC evaluation, and availability is limited for each domain; therefore, scholars are advised to book their slots at the earliest to secure their preferred schedule. If a scholar fails to select a slot within the stipulated timeline, the Department of Ph.D. Evaluation will automatically assign a slot based on availability. 4. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path UMS navigation -->Division of Examination--> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation -->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification -->ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 11th May 2026. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. d) Research scholars are required to bring two hard copies of the ETP report, duly verified and signed by the respective Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (wherever applicable), at the time of evaluation. e) It is mandatory to submit one hard copy of the ETP report to CRDP (Block 38, Room No. 304), while the second copy must be retained by the scholar for reference by the panel members during the evaluation. f) Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. g) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. h) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. i) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process/appear for the evaluation after registration will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". j) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). k) The slot booking is not applicable for Research Mentorship committee (RMC) evaluation For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines and as per guidelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. e. In case the scholar has communicated/accepted/published a research/review article, the scholar is required to select the log request ID while registering for ETP evaluation. A log request can be generated through the supervisor’s UMS via following path: UMS Navigation --> Research and Development Cell --> Research and academic contributions --> Monthly status of research achievements/log request Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->ETP Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 10th April 2026 to 6th May 2026 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics --> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->ETP-->Click to Submit report. ETP reports will be considered only if submitted through the UMS interface. Submissions made through any other means, such as email or RMS, will not be accepted. Therefore, all scholars must ensure that their reports are uploaded through the online interface. Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 10th April 2026 to 6th May 2026 3. Selection of ETP Evaluation Slot Research scholars are required to select their preferred week for the upcoming ETP evaluation through the UMS interface after uploading the ETP report. The scholars can follow the below mentioned Path for selecting the slots: Academics --> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity--> Click to Select the ETP Evaluation Slot --> Click to select the ETP evaluation slot The selected slot will be final and cannot be changed under any circumstances. Scholars must ensure their availability as per the allotted schedule. Slot modification will be permitted only in case of a university-declared event or holiday. Note:- The scheduled slots are applicable only for RAC evaluation, and availability is limited for each domain; therefore, scholars are advised to book their slots at the earliest to secure their preferred schedule. If a scholar fails to select a slot within the stipulated timeline, the Department of Ph.D. Evaluation will automatically assign a slot based on availability. 4. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path UMS navigation -->Division of Examination--> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation -->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification -->ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 11th May 2026. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. d) Research scholars are required to bring two hard copies of the ETP report, duly verified and signed by the respective Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (wherever applicable), at the time of evaluation. e) It is mandatory to submit one hard copy of the ETP report to CRDP (Block 38, Room No. 304), while the second copy must be retained by the scholar for reference by the panel members during the evaluation. f) Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. g) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. h) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. i) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process/appear for the evaluation after registration will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". j) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). k) The slot booking is not applicable for Research Mentorship committee (RMC) evaluation For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines and as per guidelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

title: Final Report Submission timelines for Project, Dissertation and similar courses for Spring Term 25262. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260408/0008 (4/8/2026)
body: This is for the information of all faculty members supervising the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines mentioned in Annexure-III (Attached). 1. Uploading the soft copy of final report. All students need to prepare the final report of their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in four parts i.e., PDF File-1, PDF File-2, PDF File-3 and PDF file-4 (details of pdf files are given in Table 1) via their UMS as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation Table 1- Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) PDF File 1* PDF File 2 PDF File 3 PDF File 4 (Applicable only for final stage Master Dissertation) Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload "only Content Report" which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student's Name, Reg. Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone Project-II, Dissertation-II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/code-of-ethics.pdf . Also, AI plagiarism check will be applied so students should refrain from using AI. Student need to submit graphical abstract from Thesis/Dissertation work at Master's Level) Please ensure that PDF File 1 contains student as well as supervisor signatures on the declaration certificates before uploading the same on the UMS interface. Important Note- 1. It is advised that the student(s) must ensure timely uploading of their final report before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report before final submission of the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office by the students. 2.In Extreme cases if the final report is not ready and requires more time, student can request for an extension of maximum 60 days with a fee of Rupees 1000/- in 30-310 by filling the hard copy Extension form. 3.The guidelines (Annexure-II) attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done. 4.Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-III. 2. Uploading the detail of the Research Publication/ Patent on UMS (if any): In case student/ student group has a research publication (at least acceptance proof)/Patent (submission proof) all students in a specific Project group need to fill the details of the Research Publications/Patent as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Patent details The above interface would require a log request ID which can be generated by respective Supervisor via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->Division of Research and Development-->Research and Academic Contributions--->Log Request Note- It is mandatory to have the research publication/Patent affiliated with Lovely Professional University otherwise the student would not be eligible for the Final ETP viva-voce. 3. Online Report Recommendation from Supervisor: The soft copy of the final report uploaded by each student should be recommended by the supervisor in order to be eligible for the final ETP viva. In case report is not recommended by supervisor then final ETP viva for the student(s) shall not be conducted. 4. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative office (A.O. Office) Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, two hard copies, either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. While submitting the hardcopy of project report the AOs must write the E-Receipt Number, sign and put their UID along with the University stamp on hardcopies carried by the student. One Signed and stamped copy of the report should be returned to the student and the same must be carried by the student at the time of ETP viva. Respective School AO’s can generate an online report submission number via the following UMS path. UMS Navigation-- >Administrative Task-->Report Submission Important Points: 1. For students working in groups, any one member of the group can make the submission in AO office and it will be considered for all. Whereas, the supervisor must recommend the uploaded soft-copy via UMS interface for all students in-order to enable hard-copy submission for the whole group.2. In case a student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be awarded.3. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III. In case of any query, faculty may log an RMS request using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)--->Log Request Select Category: Examination Select Sub Category: Others

title: Drone Expo 2026 at the International Exhibition Centre, Bengaluru. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/260406/0002 (4/6/2026)
body: Dear Students, Department of Student Research and Project – Student Welfare Wing is pleased to inform you about an exciting opportunity to explore the latest advancements in drone technology. The Drone Expo 2026 is scheduled to be held on 17th–18th April 2026 at the International Exhibition Centre, Bengaluru. This premier event will bring together industry experts, innovators, and enthusiasts from across the country to showcase cutting-edge developments in unmanned aerial systems (UAS), robotics, and related technologies. The expo will feature live demonstrations, technical sessions, exhibitions, and networking opportunities with leading organizations in the drone ecosystem. Students with an interest in technology, engineering, innovation, and entrepreneurship can participate. Attending this expo will provide valuable insights into emerging trends, career opportunities, and practical applications of drone technology in various sectors. Key Highlights: Live drone demonstrations Interaction with industry professionals Exposure to innovative drone applications Learning and networking opportunities Detail of event:- Date: - 17th–18th April 2026 Venue: - International Exhibition Centre, Bengaluru Last Date to register: - 8th April 2026 Note:- The visit to Drone Expo 2026 at the International Exhibition Centre, Bengaluru is self funded. body: Admissions-Wing is recruiting students for Part time (9 am to 5 pm/6 pm) as a student counsellor. Conducting surveys and collecting information from students/parents in Department of digital engagement: Student will be responsible for conducting surveys and collecting information, writing posts/content. 02. Data Entry, Reception handling, Campus visits, survey/Feedback and Routing in Walk-in Admission Cell: Candidates will be responsible for data entry for new enquiries, taking surveys/feedback and routing the enquiries to the Counselor for further processing including campus visit for parents/students 03.Walk-in handling and follow-up with parents/students for Loan related queries. Students enrolled in Under Graduate/ Post Graduate Degree (with no active backlogs and without any major indisciplinary case). · Students having any curriculum requirement/Placement activity/Classes/Training scheduled during the period of job (Between May to July) which is clashing with job timings (9 am to 5 pm/6 pm) need not to apply. title: Akanksha Scholarship for Women in STEM : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260402/0014 (4/2/2026)
body: The Progress Akanksha Scholarship for Women in STEM 2026 supports women in India pursuing first-year undergraduate studies in computer science-related fields with renewable financial assistance of up to INR 1,50,000 per year based on need. It is open to Indian women students enrolled in eligible computing and STEM courses, with a family income limit of INR 5,00,000 and a minimum of 75% in Class XII. Link for apply Scholarship: (Create an account on the official Kaleidoscope application portal) https://apply.mykaleidoscope.com/program/ProgressAkanksha2026IN The Last date for the scholarship is 11-04-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Be a woman with Indian citizenship 2. Enrolled in the first year of under-graduation program (B.E/BTech) and major in Computer Science Engineering (CSE), Computer Science Information Technology (CSIT), or related courses 3. Aggregate marks secured in XII standard examination must be 75% or above 4. Family income must not exceed INR 5,00,000 Exclusions 1. Progress employees, board members and their families are not eligible 2. Students in graduate school are not eligible 3. For the purpose of this scholarship, STEM is defined as computer science, software engineering, IT and/or computer information systems Benefits: Up to INR 1,50,000 per year Essay Requirement: Applicants must submit a 500 to1000 word essay covering: 1. Your passion for STEM 2. How your interest in STEM began 3. Your future goals 4. How you have helped others through: . Volunteering . Mentorship . Community engagement . Especially STEM-related activities How to Apply? . Eligible candidates must complete and submit an online application, including: . One required essay. . Copy of 12th standard mark sheet. . Copy of Government ID/Aadhaar Card. . University admission letter. . Proof of family income (Income Certificate, BPL card, or similar). . Resume/CV. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26--------> Akanksha Scholarship for Women in STEM All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Opportunity for Recoup Continuous Assessment (CA) for courses offered in (Spring Term) 2025-26. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260402/0002 (4/2/2026)
body: Continuous Assessment (CA) constitutes an integral component of the academic evaluation process, ensuring continuous learning and timely assessment of student progress. As per the University curriculum, there are certain course codes in which all CA components are mandatory. In such courses, students are required to appear in all scheduled CAs, and the marks obtained are considered in the final evaluation. To support the students who could not perform well in earlier CAs or were absent in any CA, the University is providing an opportunity through CA Recoup, which shall be applicable to all students of the regular term enrolled in courses where all CA components are compulsory. Application Process: 1. Students are required to apply through the Google Form link provided: https://forms.gle/Qcm7gXZt7vYx8sVZ8 All required details must be filled carefully and correctly. 2. Last date to apply: 10 April 2026. No applications shall be accepted after the deadline. 3. Students applying for multiple course codes must fill the form separately for each course. Important Points to note: 1. Only those students who apply through the official link shall be eligible for CA Recoup. 2. The Recoup CA marks (only if higher than previous attempted CA marks) shall be considered for the final CA calculation. 3. The CA Recoup shall be conducted in the class by the concerned faculty. 4. The last date to conduct CA Recoup is 30-04-2026. 5. Details such as syllabus, actual date of conduct, type of CA shall be communicated by the concerned faculty. 6. Recoup CA shall be planned in additional lectures and may be scheduled on Saturdays also (Except second Saturdays). 7. Recoup CA shall be applicable only for some selected Academic Tasks for the course codes as per the Annexure attached. In case of any query, you may visit the Division of Examination, 30-310, Cabin- 1. Also you may log an RMS request using the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Transactions---> Log Request Select Category: Academics Sub-Category: Continuous Assessment

title: Ace the GD: A Workshop on From Thinking to Speaking (4/2/2026)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration Division of Residential Services is going to conduct “Ace the GD: A Workshop on From Thinking to Speaking”. This workshop is designed to foster speaking, listening, and critical thinking skills among participants by engaging them in collaborative group discussions. Through thought-provoking and diverse topics, participants will learn to express their views confidently, listen actively, respect differing opinions, and build arguments effectively, all in a supportive and inclusive environment. The main objectives of the event are: To understand diverse perspectives by actively listening and interpreting key ideas during group discussions. To evaluate arguments critically by identifying strengths, weaknesses, and biases in different viewpoints. To create original insights and collaborative solutions through thoughtful and engaging dialogue. Target audience: The students of Girls Hostel – 3 will participate in the event. body: Dear Students, In reference to our previous announcement on dated 7th November 2025 "Mandatory Updation of Students’ Bank Details for Research Log Requests : LPU/9.1/GENA/2024/022/IC/251107/0001" This is a reminder regarding the recent update in the Research Log Request interface to facilitate seamless processing of research achievements involving student contributors. Despite the earlier communication, it has been observed that many Research Log Requests are still pending due to incomplete submission of student bank details. Student Action Required: Whenever a faculty member submits a Research Log Request and LPU student(s) are listed as contributors (in categories such as Research Paper, Conference Paper, Book Chapter, IPR, etc.), those students are required to enter their bank details once under the Student Research Achievement Reports section. Responsibility of Applicants: Research Log Request applicants are requested to ensure and inform the concerned students to update their bank details immediately under the mentioned categories. Please Note: Research Log requests will not be visible to the Research Department for further processing until the student has submitted their bank details. In cases where the student has a “Program Complete” status, the log request will be redirected to the DRD Team, who will coordinate with the applicant to complete the required details. Navigation Path in UMS: You can fill the Bank details as per given UMS path. UMS Login → Academics → Research and Development → Research Achievement Reports. Your cooperation is essential to ensure timely processing of all research-related requests.

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on AI-Powered Pedagogy: Revolutionizing the Academic Landscape : LPU/13.2/AOTP/2024/001/IC/260401/0002 (4/1/2026)
body: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming education by reshaping teaching methods, assessment systems, and student engagement practices. As institutions embrace technology-driven pedagogy, it is essential for educators to integrate AI tools effectively while ensuring ethics and academic integrity. The Human Resource Development Center invites registration for the Short Term Course on AI-Powered Pedagogy: Revolutionizing the Academic Landscape. The program aims to provide practical exposure to AI-powered tools, personalized learning systems, automated assessments, and responsible AI integration in academic practices. Program Schedule Title Short Term Course on AI-Powered Pedagogy: Revolutionizing the Academic Landscape Course Outcome The participants will be able to: • Analyze and implement AI-driven tools to enhance teaching, learning, and student engagement in academic settings. • Develop AI-powered content and assessment strategies to personalize learning experiences and optimize educational outcomes. • Critically evaluate the ethical, pedagogical, and research implications of AI integration in academia to ensure responsible and effective usage Resource Persons Dr. Neha Munjal, Professor , School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences, Lovely Professional University Dr. Uma Kamboj, Associate Professor, School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences, Lovely Professional University Date April 20-25, 2026 (Mon-Sat) Time 06:30 - 08:30 P.M Registration Fee LPU Associate: Research Scholar / Faculty / Alumni - Rs. 1000/- External Participants - Rs. 1500/- Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes April 18, 2026 Mode Online Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation

title: Automated Hostel Leave Check-In / Check-Out System : LIT/17/OMC/2024/001/IC/260330/0001 (3/30/2026)
body: Dear Students, This is to inform you that the Hostel Leave Check-In / Check-Out System is being updated and will be implemented at the Main Gate w.e.f. 31st March 2026 (Tuesday). The system now utilizes Face Recognition technology integrated with numbered turnstile gates (G1, G2, G3 etc.) for a completely Automatic Check-Out & Check-In process. Key Instructions: Gate Assignment: After your leave is approved in UMS, you will be assigned specific turnstile gates for check-out and check-in. These gate numbers (e.g., G3, G5) will be clearly mentioned on your Hostel Leave Slip. Movement Protocol: You are required to use only your assigned gates for exit and entry. The gates will remain active only for your approved leave duration. Face Scan Entry: To pass through the turnstile, simply approach your assigned gate and look into the Face Scanner. Note: Ensure your face is clearly visible (remove helmets or deep-tinted sunglasses) for a quick scan. System Sync Time: After leave approval, gate access may take 2–4 minutes to reflect in the system. Students are advised to plan accordingly to ensure smooth and hassle-free movement. Understanding Gate Activation Status Please refer to the Activation Status table on your digital Hostel Leave Slip to confirm if the turnstile gate is ready for your movement: Status Meaning Action Activated Your face scan is synced and the gate is authorized. Proceed to your assigned gate for scanning. Processing The system is currently uploading your data to the gate. Wait 2-5 minutes for the status to turn green. Deactivated Your leave time has expired or the movement is complete. Students can apply for new leave or extend existing leave via UMS. Error There is a technical mismatch or system issue. Contact the Security/Helpdesk. Example Scenario: If your leave is approved from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and your slip shows: Check-out Gate: G3, G4 Check-in Gate: G5, G6 Then: 1. You can exit through Gate G3 or G4 and enter only through Gate G5 or G6 via Face Scan. 2. The Face Recognition will only work between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM. 3. Entry/Exit attempts before or after this time will be automatically denied. Sample Hostel Leave Slip (Updated Version) is attached.
uploaded_by: Attachment: 1 Sample Leave Slip.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Residential Services *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

title: Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution : LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260330/0001 (3/30/2026)
body: Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy - a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you - as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator - to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel - your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives: - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General participation conditions & guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. -PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral). - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity. - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPA. No disciplinary case. b. No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives. c. It is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community.

title: Updated Student Admission Referral In)centives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution : LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260327/0002 (3/27/2026)
body: Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy - a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you - as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator - to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel - your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives: - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General participation conditions & guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. -PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral). - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity. - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPA. No disciplinary case. b. No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives. c. It is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community.

title: Call for participation in 1st NLUJ-CCLRP National Essay Writing Competition 2026 by The National Law University Jodhpur : LPU/18.2/CULA/2024/001/IC/260326/0001 (3/26/2026)
body: Dear Students, LPU Literary Society is pleased to announce that LPU has been invited to participate in the 1st NLUJ-CCLRP National Essay Writing Competition 2026 by The National Law University Jodhpur to commemorate World Consumer Rights Day. The competition is focused on “Safe Products, Confident Consumers”, aims to encourage students to explore issues such as product safety, digital consumer rights, platform accountability and emerging risks in modern marketplaces. Competition Highlights : Open to students pursuing 3-year or 5-year law degrees. Individual and co-authored submissions permitted. (Maximum 2 students can jointly co-author). Cash prizes for top entries, along with Certificate of MeritE-Certificates of participation for all contributors .The following cash prizes shall be awarded to the best three entries: a. First Position: Rs. 4000 & Certificate of Merit b. Second Position: Rs. 3000 & Certificate of Merit c. Third Position: Rs 2000 & Certificate of Merit Theme: “Safe Products, Confident Consumers” Sub themes - Consumer Awareness and Education, Consumer Rights in the Digital Age, Speedy Redressal of Consumer Disputes, Dark Patterns in E-Commerce and Digital Platforms, AI Driven Consumer Harm, Data Privacy as a consumer right, Centre for Consumer Law Research & Practice Influencer Advertising and Consumer Risks, Consumer Protection in Healthcare and Pharmaceuticals, Misleading Advertising and Consumer Knowledge, Rise of greenwashing and its regulation in India, Effectiveness of Consumer Protection Act, 2019, The list of themes is only indicative. Participants may make submissions on any theme within the purview of the broad theme of consumer protection. Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their essays by 10th April, 2026 to https://forms.gle/8TxZPon3NHhaDcVK6 For queries contact : Ms Barbie 8054486727

title: Akanksha Scholarship for Women in STEM : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260323/0002 (3/23/2026)
body: Description The Progress Akanksha Scholarship for Women in STEM 2026 supports women in India pursuing first-year undergraduate studies in computer science-related fields with renewable financial assistance of up to INR 1,50,000 per year based on need. It is open to Indian women students enrolled in eligible computing and STEM courses, with a family income limit of INR 5,00,000 and a minimum of 75% in Class XII. Eligibility Are a woman Are an Indian citizen Are enrolled in the first year of college in India Are pursuing: Computer Science Engineering Computer Science Information Technology Software Engineering IT Or another related computer science-focused course Have at least 75% aggregate in Class XII Have a family income of INR 5,00,000 or less Scholarship Amount and Benefits Up to INR 1,50,000 per year Covers: Tuition Fees Other educational expenses Essay Requirement Applicants must submit a 500–1000 word essay covering: Your passion for STEM How your interest in STEM began Your future goals How you have helped others through: Volunteering Mentorship Community engagement Especially STEM-related activities Application Deadline 01- April- 2026 Registration Details: https://forms.gle/H7v7E4nNdqzjf2jq7 https://share.google/SHsJ75gOXvy5PKxy4 Note : It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. title: Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) : LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260320/0003 (3/20/2026)
body: In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy - a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you - as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator - to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel - your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives: - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General participation conditions & guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. - PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral). - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity. - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPA. No disciplinary case. b. No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives. c. It is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community.

title: LPU Global: Amazing opportunity for BBA and B. Com students to do remote internship at UK/EU based industries : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/260318/0001 (3/18/2026)
body: The London School of Digital Business (LSDB) is offering an exciting opportunity for highly motivated 1st and 2nd year students pursuing BBA and B.Com programs to undertake remote international internships with reputed UK and EU-based industries. Selected candidates will be eligible to receive a monthly stipend ranging from £50 to £250, starting from the second month of the internship, based on performance and role requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for students to enhance their employability, gain international work experience, and build a strong professional profile early in their academic journey. Number of Seats: 5 Eligibility: 1st and 2nd year students of BBA and B. Com with minimum CGPA of 8.5 Strong proficiency in English communication, both written and spoken. Last date to apply: 21st March 2026 Process: Fill google form to show interest (Only 5 will be selected depending upon their profile) Shortlisted candidates attend a first-round interview with the LSDB HR team. Shortlisted candidates out of the interview will undertake a 1–2-week skills development and interview preparation programme. After training, he/she will attend an interview with a LSDB’s UK/EU client. If selected, pay the 100 GBP as program fee. (Non-refundable) Signs a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). Receives a confirmation email along with their assigned mentor’s details. The internship commences. From the second month onwards, the student begins receiving a stipend. (Stipend: £50 to £250) Subject to performance, students may be considered for a long-term internship or contractual opportunity. Upon completion of the remote internship, the student receives an official internship experience letter. For further information kindly contact Division of International Affairs at block 32-310 or email at studyabroad@lpu.co.in

title: Invitation to Online Webinar: Developing AI-Powered Battery Management Systems for Electric 2-3 Wheelers : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260313/0001 (3/13/2026)
body: We are pleased to inform you about an exciting webinar series organized by MathWorks on “Developing AI-Powered Battery Management Systems for Electric 2-3 Wheelers.” This series will demonstrate how MATLAB® and Simulink® are used to design, simulate, and validate advanced Battery Management Systems (BMS) for next-generation electric vehicles. The sessions will cover topics such as battery modeling, AI-based SOC/SOH estimation, predictive diagnostics, and model-driven development for EV software, helping engineers build safe, efficient, and production-ready battery systems. Webinar Schedule (a) 17 March 2026 Topic: Battery Pack Development and BMS Design for Electric 2-Wheelers & 3-Wheelers Learn about lithium-ion battery modeling, battery pack design, thermal performance evaluation, and BMS algorithms for SOC/SOH estimation. (b) 18 March 2026 Topic: Intelligent BMS – Leveraging AI for Accuracy, Safety, and Sustainability Explore how Artificial Intelligence can improve battery performance through predictive maintenance, fault detection, and accurate battery analytics. (c) 8 April 2026 Topic: Delivering Production-Ready Software for EV 2-3 Wheelers with Confidence Understand model-driven development, automated testing, and embedded code generation for reliable EV software deployment. Key Highlights 1. Battery modeling and simulation using MATLAB & Simulink 2. AI-driven SOC/SOH estimation and predictive diagnostics 3. Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing workflows 4. Model-based design and automated verification 5. Generation of production-ready embedded software Students interested in Electric Vehicles, Battery Technology, AI in EV systems, and Embedded Software Development are encouraged to attend. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Speak and Compete – An Activity-Based Competition on English Grammar”. The event aims to strengthen students’ grammatical accuracy and confidence in spoken English through engaging and interactive activities. The event will begin with a non-competitive speaking session, where participants will take part in activity-based tasks that encourage the practical use of English grammar in everyday situations. Students will respond to different scenarios using appropriate tenses and grammatical structures, helping them build confidence and fluency in speaking. This will be followed by a competitive quiz round, where participants will test their knowledge of English grammar through quick and engaging questions. The quiz will challenge students to apply grammatical concepts accurately while thinking critically under time constraints. title: vivo Kanya Gyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260311/0001 (3/11/2026)
body: The vivo Kanya Gyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 is vivo India’s CSR initiative designed to empower young women from underserved and economically disadvantaged backgrounds across India to pursue education and careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) by providing financial assistance, mentorship and industry connect. The program is open to young women currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses (first or second year). This initiative enables students to continue their studies without financial barriers while building a strong foundation by receiving curated mentoring sessions which help them for corporate readiness for future STEM careers. Selected scholars will receive an annual scholarship renewable for up to three years. Eligibility Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) at NIRF-ranked colleges; preference will be given to government colleges. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or vivo India are ineligible. Note: Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible. Preference will be given to the following applicants: Single-parent children Children from the Aspirational District Have deceased parents Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalised communities. Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families Girls Representing State and National Level Sports Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by a selection panel. Benefits Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 60,000 per year for up to three years. Note: The scholarship will cover essential education-related expenses, including institution fees, hostel and accommodation, food, transport, equipment, and laptop costs, for which the scholar will submit relevant documents for verification as proof. Application Deadline: Deadline:15- March- 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: Apply Now : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/vivo-kanya-gyaan-scholarship-program Google Forms: https://forms.gle/RKRoZxFeQyXsmNn17 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in

title: Golden Opportunity for Final Year UG Students to Pursue Ph.D. after 4-Year Graduation with LPUNEST fee exemption and assured scholarships : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/260310/0063 (3/10/2026)
body: Lovely Professional University invites final year Undergraduate students (8th semester) who will be completing their 4-year/8-semester Bachelor’s Degree by June 2026 with minimum 75% aggregate marks (or equivalent grade as prescribed by UGC) to apply for admission to the Ph.D. Programme. This initiative provides a unique opportunity for talented and research-oriented students to begin their doctoral journey immediately after completing their undergraduate degree, without the need to wait for a postgraduate qualification. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, and research contingency grant. Who are eligible ? Completion of 4-year/8-semester Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant discipline Minimum 75% aggregate marks or equivalent grade as prescribed by UGC at the time of admission to Ph.D. programme Relaxation of 5% marks (or equivalent grade) may be allowed for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/Differently-Abled/EWS and other categories, as per the guidelines of the statutory body from time to time. Why Consider a Ph.D. after Your UG Degree? Pursuing a Ph.D. directly after a 4-year undergraduate programme offers several advantages: . Start your research career early and gain expertise in your chosen field. . Opportunity to work closely with experienced faculty and researchers. . Access to advanced research facilities, laboratories, and datasets. . Enhance your academic profile for careers in research, academia, industry, and policy-making. . Potential opportunities for research fellowships, publications, and international collaborations. . Become part of a community of scholars driving innovation and knowledge creation. Important Points 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year UG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student needs to appear for LPUNEST on 4th April 2026 (Saturday) followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Important Dates: LPUNEST Ph.D. Registration 26th February 2026 (Thursday)– 01st April 2026 (Wednesday) Conduct of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 04th April 2026 (Saturday) Result of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 08th April 2026 (Wednesday) Research Proposal Discussion 10 th April 2026 (Friday) - 13 th April 2026 (Monday) Final Result 17 th April 2026 (Friday) Last date of Ph.D. Admission 31st May 2026 (Sunday) Programme Fee and Scholarship The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 60% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee Applicable per semester 60% Rs 30,000/- Rs 20,000/- 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- How to Apply? Final year undergraduate students can register for LPUNEST through their UMS by following the path below: UMS Navigation: Academics → Research and Development → PhD Discipline Preference The detailed step-by-step process to apply for LPUNEST is provided in the attachment with this announcement. IMPORTANT NOTE: Admission to the following Ph.D. programmes is not permitted directly after a 4-year UG programme: Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology, Pharmacy Practice, Agronomy, Fruit Science, Vegetable Science, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Law, Clinical Embryology For more information For detailed information regarding benefits, eligibility, and research opportunities, students may visit: Centre for Research Degree Programme (CRDP) Block 38, Room 406 or raise a request through RMS using the following path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department (Ph.D. [Centre for Research Degree Programmes]) -- > Category -- > Sub Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description

title: Establishment of Census Data Workstation at LPU Central Library- Level 3 : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/260309/0006 (3/9/2026)
body: Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) is pleased to announce the successful signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University and the Directorate of Census Operations Punjab for the establishment of a Census Data Workstation at the Central Library (Level–3). This collaboration marks an important step towards strengthening research infrastructure within the University. The Census Data Workstation will provide authorized access to detailed census datasets. Since first synchronous census of the entire country which was conducted in year 1881 and related resources, enabling researchers to undertake advanced academic studies based on authentic national data. The availability of this facility will significantly benefit Ph.D. scholars and faculty members by providing them with reliable demographic, socio-economic, and regional datasets. These datasets will support high-quality research in areas such as population studies, urban and rural development, migration patterns, education, health, employment, and public policy analysis. Access to such structured and verified data will enhance the quality, accuracy, and impact of research publications and doctoral work conducted at the University. Researchers interested in using the Census Data Workstation must obtain prior approval from the Steering Committee. For initiating the approval process, Ph.D. scholars and faculty members are required to approach the Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) in block 38-406 or raise RMS. The CRDP will facilitate the necessary permissions and guide researchers regarding the appropriate procedures for accessing and utilizing the census data resources. This MoU reflects the University’s commitment to promoting data-driven research, evidence-based policy analysis, and interdisciplinary academic collaboration. The Census Data Workstation is expected to become a valuable resource for researchers, enabling them to generate meaningful insights and contribute to impactful scholarly work. Faculty members and research scholars are encouraged to make effective use of this facility to strengthen their research outcomes and contribute to the broader academic community. body: Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy — a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you — as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator — to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities.Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel — your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives- - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General Participation Conditions & Guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. - PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid.· - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution.· - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026.· - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral).· - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity.· - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points.· - Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPAo No disciplinary case. b. No fee defaultThis initiative extends beyond incentives. c. it is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community.

Students can book the residential facility with Early Decision Benefit (upto Rs. 10,000/-) till 31st Mar. 2026. Allotment of residential facilities will be done in 3 Phases as mentioned below: Hostel Booking Timelines and Process Phases Start Date End Date Eligibility EDB Token Amount Phase-1 Round -I At 05:30 PM on 05th March 2026 At 11:59 PM on 31st March 2026 Students Having CGPA 08 or Above (For both Boys & Girls) Rs. 10,000/- Rs. 10,000/- (To be paid between 1-7 April 2026) Round –II At 05:30 PM on 06th March 2026 For all Girls Rs. 10,000/- Round –III At 11:00 AM on 07th March 2026 For all Boys Rs. 10,000/- Phase-2 At 02:00 PM on 01st April 2026 At 11:59 PM on 30th April 2026 All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) Rs. 5,000/- Rs. 10,000/- (At the time of Booking) Phase-3 01st May 2026 NA All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) NA Rs. 10,000/- (At the time of Booking) Residential Charges Payment Timelines and Process Payment Type Timeline Action From To Hostel Seat EDB Token Amount 01st April 2026 07th April 2026 Confirmed Rs. 10,000/- (Secured) 08th April 2026 15th April 2026 Confirmed Rs. 5,000/- (Reduced To 50%) 16th April 2026 30th April 2026 Confirmed Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) After 30th April 2026 Cancelled Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) 50% Residential Charges Till 15th June 2026 Confirmed Secured (As Applicable) 16th June 2026 30th June 2026 Confirmed Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) After 30th June 2026 Cancelled Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) 100% Residential Charges On or Before Hostel Reporting Confirmed Secured (As Applicable) Booking can be done through “Hostel Booking” option available on UMS Dashboard or by visiting: UMS Navigation -> Residential Services -> Residential Facilities Booking -> Hostel Booking There are 3 options available on this interface that a student can choose: INDIVIDUAL BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat for their own. GROUP BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat along with their friends. Student can choose his/her roommates by selecting group booking option (Validation of group members has to be done using the OTP sent to individual group member’s “My message” on UMS). WAITLIST: This option is applicable for the situation if student is unable to book the desired hostel/seater. Waitlist request can be submitted under following scenarios: Waitlist (Hostel Already Booked):- In case student have already booked the hostel seat but still want to change the booked seat and the desired hostel/ seater is not available, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. Waitlist (Hostel Not Booked):- In case student has not booked the hostel due to non-availability of preferred hostel/ seater, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. EDB benefits will not be applicable on waitlist request; rather these benefits will be applicable according the date of actual booking the residential services. Allotment for Residential Scholarship Holder:- Allotment will be separately managed by OMC-DRS (Block 29-301) (based on the details provided by the concerned departments i.e Sports or Cultural) for students awarded hostel charges waiver under any scholarship scheme (like Sports, Cultural, Board topper etc.), such students need not to participate in the Allotment Process of Residential Facilities. Changes in the booked residential facilities: - Option to change booked hostel seat will be provided to students after 01st April 2026. Students can change their booked hostel seat without any shifting charges once in a complete academic session. Second time onwards each request for the change of hostel/ room will be processed with a shifting charge of Rs. 1000/-. Students may upgrade their booked seat by paying the difference of amount between both room types and without shifting charges any time during the complete academic session, whereas down-gradation of hostel seat will be permitted before reporting in hostel only and with shifting charges (As applicable). Important Point:- Students who are not opting for the residential facility will be required to submit their PG/Rented/Private Accommodation details as per guidelines of UGC, Police and other local authorities. Residential Facilities will be provided till the end of the regular academic session including regular exams or 10 months from the start of the session, whichever is earlier. Students can come and join 02 days prior to the start of academic session and will be required to vacate residential room/apartment within 02 days after completion of stay period. Students may check the complete process of booking through demo video as mentioned in following link: Click Here To Watch Hostel Booking Process Students must go through the attachments for rest other details i.e. Residential Charges, Refund Guidelines. For any query students may visit Residential Query Window: Block 32 Basement, Window No. 03, or lodge RMS on UMS through following path: UMS Navigation >> Relationship Management System (RMS) >> Log Request >> Academic & Administrative Issues >> Select Message Type “Grievance” >> Search by category “Residential Services (Hostel Allotment/ Transfer) : Hostel Allotment” category.
