title: Exciting Opportunity: I.I.M.U.N. U.S.A. Leadership Program 2026 : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/260306/0001 (3/6/2026)
body: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to announce an exceptional global leadership opportunity for students to participate in the I.I.M.U.N. U.S.A. Leadership Program 2026. This 21-day international leadership and experiential learning program will be held from 6th to 26th September 2026 and will provide students with unparalleled exposure to global leadership, diplomacy, innovation, and industry practices across eight major U.S. cities — Boston, New York, Washington D.C., Dallas, Houston, Seattle, Portland, and San Francisco. The program is designed to immerse students in academic learning, institutional visits, and industry interactions with global leaders and renowned organizations. Key Highlights: Selected students will have the opportunity to: Attend leadership lectures delivered by tenured professors from leading universities such as Harvard, MIT, Stanford, and Tufts. Participate in 40+ experiential learning engagements aimed at developing leadership skills and global awareness. Visit prominent global institutions including the United Nations, NASA, World Bank, and the International Monetary Fund. Interact with leaders and representatives from globally recognized companies such as Google, Amazon, Nike, Microsoft, and Uber. Attend masterclasses in International Relations, Finance, Technology, Business, Design, Science, Law, Public Policy, and Professional Networking. Receive a Program Completion Certificate from I.I.M.U.N., along with Letters of Recommendation for outstanding participants. Eligibility: Open to students from disciplines such as International Relations, Finance, Technology, Business, Design, Science, Law, and Public Policy. Applicants must be below 25 years of age. Applicants must hold a passport valid until March 2027 or later. Selection will be conducted on a first-come, first-served basis. Program Inclusions: Round-trip international flights Visa assistance and travel insurance Accommodation in 4-star hotels Vegetarian meals throughout the program Local transportation within the United States Delegate kit and professional photography Study tours, lectures, and experiential engagements Program Fee: Rs. 7,50,000 per student (inclusive of taxes and visa costs). body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “Jubilant Minds” of School of Polytechnic is going to conduct “Power Pointless: A competitive event on Enhancing Public Speaking Skills.” The event will focus on testing the limits of cognitive flexibility, storytelling, and professional poise. Unlike traditional presentations where slides support the speaker, this event will force the speaker to support the slides by presenting competitors with a specific, serious-sounding topic and a deck of completely random, unseen images that they will have to instantly synthesize into a coherent, persuasive, and entertaining narrative. title: Invitation to Participate – GOER 2026 (National Level Competition) : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/260228/0002 (2/28/2026)
body: Students are invited to participate in GOER 2026, a national level enterprise risk management competition conducted by Institute of Risk Management (IRM) India. GOER - Game of Enterprise Risk 2026, is a business simulation where teams manage a hypothetical company and make strategic decisions to handle financial, operational, and external risks. It is designed to test analytical thinking, leadership, negotiation, and crisis management skills. Eligibility: UG Category First and Second Year students (For 4 year programmes, up to Third Year). Final Year students are not eligible. PG Category First Year students only. Each team will consist of 10 students plus 2 backup members. Shortlisted teams will attend a virtual masterclass and take part in further evaluation rounds. Finalist teams will compete in person in Hyderabad on 20 June 2026. There is no participation fee. Important Dates: Initial Institutional Registration: 15 March 2026 Team Submission Deadline: 20 March 2026 Finale Round: 20 June 2026 at Mahindra University, Hyderabad Interested students are requested to coordinate with their respective faculty members immediately, as the institutional registration deadline is 15 March 2026. Registration Link: https://www.theirmindia.org/game-of-enterprise-risk/college-registration For queries, please contact The Division of International Affairs at +91 9501110446 or visit Block 32-310

title: Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) : LPU/19.4/AN25/2025/001/IC/260226/0001 (2/26/2026)
body: Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy — a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you — as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator — to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel — your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives- 1. Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. 2. Link student efforts to university advancement. 3. Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. 4. Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General Participation Conditions & Guidelines· 1. SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. 2. PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. 3. All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal.· 4. Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program.· 5. The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before.· 6. Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid.· 7. Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution.· 8. Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· 9. Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026.· 10. No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral).· 11. Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity.· 12. University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points.· 13. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: - Minimum 6.0 CGPA - No disciplinary case. - No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives; it is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community. For further information regarding the policy, please refer to the attached document for clarification.

title: Opportunity for Final year Post Graduate Students of Lovely Professional University (LPU) to enroll for Ph.D. Programme for August 2026 session at LPU : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/260226/0001 (2/26/2026)
body: Recent trends in the job market have revealed the desire of the corporate sector as well as government undertaking institutions to hire candidates for various job positions who have research background through pursuance of Doctoral Degree. Looking into this context of new job opportunities which are not only well paid off but also very high in demand, Lovely Professional University (LPU) has brought an excellent opportunity for the final year Post Graduate students to register for Ph.D. programme for the upcoming August 2026 session. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, and research contingency grant. Important Points: 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year PG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student needs to appear for LPUNEST on 4th April 2026 (Saturday) followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Important Dates: LPUNEST Ph.D. Registration 26th February 2026 (Thursday)– 01st April 2026 (Wednesday) Conduct of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 04th April 2026 (Saturday) Result of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 08th April 2026 (Wednesday) Research Proposal Discussion 10 th April 2026 (Friday) - 13 th April 2026 (Monday) Final Result 17 th April 2026 (Friday) Last date of Ph.D. Admission 31st May 2026 (Sunday) 4. Programme Fee and Scholarship: The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 80% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee Applicable per semester 80% Rs 40,000/- Rs 10,000/- 60% Rs 30,000/- Rs 20,000/- 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- How to Apply ? The final year post graduate students can register for LPUNEST through their UMS. The students can register by visiting the following link. Academics --->Research and Development ---->PhD Discipline Preference. The detailed steps to apply for LPUNEST is attached with the announcement. For further information about the benefits and opportunities, please visit Centre of Research Degree Programme (CRDP) in Block 38-406 or reach us out through the following RMS path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department (Ph.D. [Centre for Research Degree Programmes]) -- > Category -- > Sub Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description

Participants will be required to discuss, evaluate, and refine ideas collectively within a limited time, encouraging logical reasoning, perspective-building, and consensus formation. Teams will then present a clear, structured, and well-justified stance. The event mirrors real placement scenarios such as group discussions and case deliberations, helping students develop teamwork, adaptability, reasoning speed, and articulation skills essential for workplace success and leadership readiness. The main objectives of the event are: To develop flexible thinking by training students to analyse a single statement from multiple viewpoints and justify their reasoning logically. To enhance decision-making and reasoning speed by encouraging structured responses under time pressure. To strengthen professional articulation skills by enabling students to present balanced, persuasive arguments with clarity, confidence, and relevance. Students must carry their Admit Card on the day of the examination. 6. Once a student enters the examination block, he/she must proceed directly to the allotted examination room. title: MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260224/0001 (2/24/2026)
body: Description The MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program is an initiative by Myntra Cares, the CSR and Sustainability arm of Myntra, designed to empower students from garment worker and artisanal families by offering financial assistance for their higher education. This scholarship provides annual support for three consecutive years, covering educational expenses for students pursuing graduation courses at recognised State and Central universities. By easing financial barriers, the program enables students to complete their higher education with confidence. The scholarship also extends upskilling programs certified by the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, focusing specifically on upskilling artisans. Eligibility Applicants must have completed Class 12 (any stream) with a minimum of 60% marks. Must be enrolled in any year of a full-time graduation course (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA, BCA, and any technical courses -Tech & Engineering, etc.) in a recognised State/Central university. Annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 5,00,000. The applicant's parent must be employed as a full-time garment worker. Note: Preference will be given to the children of single mothers employed in the garment industry and students from the Scheduled Caste, the Scheduled Tribe and the Other Backward Classes. Benefits Selected students will receive a scholarship of INR 20,000 per year for 3 years. Note: Renewable for up to 3 years for students enrolled in full-time graduation courses, subject to continuation of the program to subsequent years, academic performance, and fulfilment of renewal criteria. Application Deadline Deadline:28-Feb- 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: Apply Now : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/mynvidhya-myntra-cares-scholarship-program#scholarships Google Forms: https://forms.gle/fk6tXKuJKAab7ZZTA NOTE It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in

The main objective of the National Seminar is to promote the Organic and Herbal sector so that this Business can flourish and Farmers can get optimum benefits and Sustainable Livelihood. The major sub-themes in the Seminar Organic Fruits, Vegetables and Milk Production Herbal and Medicinal Plants-Based Traditional Medicine Systems and Healthcare. Integrated Farming System Smart Agriculture and Applications of AI and IoT Carbon Credits Transfer to the farmers practicing Sustainable Agriculture The participants would be the Farmers, Entrepreneurs, Industrialists, Students, Teachers, Research Scholars, Scientists working in Organic and Herbal Sector. The PI co-ordinators working under UBA, can join along with the farmers groups of their region. We are also inviting Research Papers on the given Sub-themes from research scholars, scientists and the practicing farmers. Apart from it we would also like to organise two days Exhibition of Organic and Herbal Products in which the Farmers, Entrepreneurs, Pharmacy Officials, Industrialists working in this Sector can participate. title: Enroll for Skill Development and Competitive Exam Courses : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/260223/0008 (2/23/2026)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 28th February 2026. Time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll SDC Courses: 28th February 2026 Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in

title: Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) meeting : LPU/8.1/LIAC/2024/005/IC/260223/0002 (2/23/2026)
body: This is to inform you that the Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) meeting is tentatively scheduled for the second week of March 2026. If you are planning to undertake research involving human subjects including surveys or questionnaire administration, their biological fluids, radiographic images, data, blood/urine samples, we request you to to submit the necessary documents in hard copy to the Administrative Office (Block 4, Room 203), School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University. The fee receipt should be submitted along with the hard copies of all documents in a closed folder to the Administrative Office before 7.03.2026. List of documents to be submitted (Format attached in Google Drive below) Cover letter Application Form: Application Form for Initial Review (for all applicants) Application form for Interventional Studies (SL No 9 in the Google Drive) / Application form for Survey-Based Studies (SL No 12) Short CV of supervisor (Use attached format SL No 16) Informed consent form and patient/participant information sheet (template attached SL No. 15 & 14) Research protocol GCP training certificate Questionnaire (if applicable) Please note that Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training will be conducted prior to the IEC meeting to ensure proper preparation of all required documents. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with the Department of Communication Skills cordially invites you to join the “PhysioTalk: The Soft Skills Club”. Are you a physiotherapy student passionate about mastering more than just anatomy and rehab techniques? PhysioTalk is your hub for building essential soft skills and communication prowess—skills that turn good therapists into exceptional ones. In today's healthcare world, effective communication with patients, colleagues, and teams can make all the difference in treatment success and patient satisfaction. Whether it's explaining complex exercises clearly, handling difficult conversations, or collaborating in multidisciplinary teams, PhysioTalk equips you with practical tools. Mission of the Club PhysioTalk empowers physiotherapy students to excel in soft skills and communication, bridging the gap between clinical expertise and human-centred care. We foster confident, empathetic communicators who thrive in patient interactions, team collaborations, and professional growth, preparing them to lead in dynamic healthcare environments. Benefits of Joining the Club · Enhanced Patient Outcomes: Master clear, compassionate communication. · Career Edge: Boost resumes with proven skills in interviews. · Real-World Practice: Role-plays and workshops. · Networking: Connect with peers, alumni, and pros for mentorship and opportunities. · Personal Growth: Reduce anxiety in public speaking, teamwork · Fun & Community: Weekly meets with games, events. title: Vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260221/0072 (2/21/2026)
body: The vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 is vivo India’s CSR initiative designed to empower young women from underserved and economically disadvantaged backgrounds across India to pursue education and careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) by providing financial assistance, mentorship and industry connect. The program is open to young women currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses (first or second year). This initiative enables students to continue their studies without financial barriers while building a strong foundation by receiving curated mentoring sessions which help them for corporate readiness for future STEM careers. Selected scholars will receive an annual scholarship renewable for up to three years Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/vivo-kanya-gyaan-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 03-Mar-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in full-time, regular undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) at NIRF-ranked colleges. 2. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. 3. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester. 4. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or vivo India are ineligible. 5. Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible. 6. Preference will be given to the following applicants: •Single-parent children •Children from the Aspirational District •Have deceased parents •Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes •Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalized communities. •Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families •Girls Representing State and National Level Sports Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by a selection panel. Benefits: Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 60,000 per year for up to three years. Note: The scholarship will cover essential education-related expenses, including institution fees, hostel and accommodation, food, transport, equipment, and laptop costs, for which the scholar will submit relevant documents for verification as proof. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-sized photograph 2. Valid Government Identity Proof (PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving License, etc.) 3. Current academic year admission proof (college ID Card or admission letter) 4. Previous semester/class marksheet 5. Parental Income Certificate (issued by the competent authority) 6. Bank Account Details (Copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in student’s name or joint account with parent/s) 7. Complete Fee Structure 8. Disability certificate (if applicable) 9. Caste Certificate (if applicable) 10. Certificate stating that the applicant has represented their State or National level in sports (if applicable) 11. Undertaking by the applicant confirming that they are a First-Generation Learner or belong to a Marginalised Community (if applicable) 12. Certificate of any position of leadership (if applicable) 13. Declaration by the applicant confirming the authenticity of submitted documents and stating that they are not receiving full financial support from any other scholarship or government scheme. 14. Visible Passion & Aspirations expressed through a short essay / personal statement in 200 words — “Why I want to pursue this field” and “How this scholarship support will help me make an impact.” How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. . Log in to Buddy4Study using your registered ID to access the ‘Application Form page’. . If you’re not registered, sign up on Buddy4Study using your Email, Mobile, or Google account. . You will be redirected to the “vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26” application form page. . Click the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload the relevant documents. . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click ‘Preview’. . If all the details are correct in the preview, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete your application. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26-------->- Vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: Administrative-------> Fee and Scholarship System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

This workshop is designed to provide students with foundational knowledge of User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) design, essential skills in today’s digital, technology-driven industry. Participants will gain an understanding of how user-friendly digital products are conceptualised and designed, and how effective design enhances usability and user satisfaction. This session will introduce students to core design principles, user-centred thinking, and the importance of intuitive interfaces. The workshop will bridge the gap between technical development and user needs, helping students understand the practical relevance of design in real-world applications. The main objectives of the event are: To develop awareness of user-centred design and usability principles. To familiarise students with basic design concepts used in digital products. To highlight career opportunities and the industry relevance of UI/UX skills. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: vivo Kanya Gyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260218/0001 (2/18/2026)
body: Description The vivo Kanya Gyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 is vivo India’s CSR initiative designed to empower young women from underserved and economically disadvantaged backgrounds across India to pursue education and careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) by providing financial assistance, mentorship and industry connect. The program is open to young women currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses (first or second year). This initiative enables students to continue their studies without financial barriers while building a strong foundation by receiving curated mentoring sessions which help them for corporate readiness for future STEM careers. Selected scholars will receive an annual scholarship renewable for up to three years. Eligibility Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) at NIRF-ranked colleges; preference will be given to government colleges. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or Vivo India are ineligible. Note Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible. Preference will be given to the following applicants: Single-parent children Children from the Aspirational District Have deceased parents Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalised communities. Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families Girls Representing State and National Level Sports Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by a selection panel. Benefits Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 60,000 per year for up to three years. Note: The scholarship will cover essential education-related expenses, including institution fees, hostel and accommodation, food, transport, equipment, and laptop costs, for which the scholar will submit relevant documents for verification as proof. Application Deadline Deadline: 03 March 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/vivo-kanya-gyaan-scholarship-program Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EchgoWRcGc9HH4r59 It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in

title: BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260217/0055 (2/17/2026)
body: The BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 is a flagship initiative by the BGM Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Bombay Gowrakshak Mandali (BGM). This scholarship is designed to support students enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate (general/professional) courses as well as diploma programs in Agriculture. This initiative empowers meritorious students to overcome financial barriers and pursue their education with confidence, thereby contributing to India’s thriving animal and dairy sciences sector. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/bgm-pashu-seva-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 28-02-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Must be an Indian citizen enrolled in a recognised institution in India. 2. Must be pursuing a full-time undergraduate course (General / Professional) any year in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, Dairy Science, Livestock (Horned Cattle) Management, Para Veterinary, Fodder Management or allied fields. 3. Must have secured a minimum of 50% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the last qualifying examination. (Note: 5% relaxation to students belonging to the preference list.) 4. Annual parental income should not exceed INR 8 lakh (from all sources) 5. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or BGM Foundation are not eligible to apply. Note: Preference will be given to: 1. Girl students, PwD, Single-parent Child, Orphans 2. First-generation college graduates 3. Students from aspirational or rural districts 4. Students who have studied in government schools 5. Students who come from village/rural backgrounds Benefits: Students will receive a fixed scholarship per year: 1. For General Graduation: INR 36,000 2. For Professional Graduation: INR 75,000 Note: The scholarship fund covers tuition fees, accommodation, food, transport, examination fees, and other academic expenses. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-size photograph 2. Proof of admission for the current academic year (admission letter or college ID card) 3. Previous semester/class marksheet 4. Fee receipt or fee structure from the institution 5. Family income certificate (issued by the competent authority) 6. Bank account details (copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in applicant’s name) 7. Declaration by the applicant confirming the authenticity of the submitted documents How can you apply? . Click on the 'Apply Now' button. . Login to Buddy4Study using a registered ID to land on the 'Online Application Form Page. . If not registered, register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile/Google account. . You will now be redirected to the ‘BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 application form page. . Click on the 'Start Application' button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload the required documents. . Accept the 'Terms and Conditions' and click on 'Preview.' . Review the preview screen to ensure that all the filled-in details are correct. . If all the details appear correctly on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26-------->- BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: Administrative-------> Fee and Scholarship System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260212/0128 (2/12/2026)
body: The Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Program 2025–26, an initiative by Tata Capital Limited, is designed to support the higher education of meritorious students from economically weaker sections of society. Under this program, students pursuing General or Professional Graduation, Polytechnic/Diploma courses at recognised institutions in India may receive a scholarship covering up to 80% of their tuition or course fees, subject to a maximum limit ranging from INR 10,000 to INR 1,00,000, depending on their academic level. The scholarship aims to reduce financial barriers and enable students to focus on their studies and achieve their aspirations. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/the-tata-capital-pankh-scholarship-programme The Last date for the scholarship is 15-02-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to Indian nationals only. 2. Students currently enrolled in undergraduate degree programs (e.g., B.Com, B.Sc, B.A, etc.) or Diploma courses at a recognized institution in India. 3. Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in the preceding class, semester, or academic year. 4. The annual family income from all sources must be less than or equal to INR 2.5 lakh. 5. Must be pursuing education from a recognized college, university, or technical institute in India. 6. Children of employees of Tata Capital and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: Selection will be based on a combination of academic excellence and financial background. Benefits: 1. Students scoring 60% – 80%: Up to 80% of tuition/course fees or INR 12,000 (whichever is less) 2. Students scoring 81% – 90%: Up to 80% of tuition/course fees or INR 15,000 (whichever is less) 3. Students scoring 91% and above: Up to 80% of tuition/course fees or INR 18,000 (whichever is less) Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card) 2. Passport-size photograph of the applicant 3. Income proof (Form 16A/income certificate issued by government authority/salary slips, etc.) 4. Proof of admission (college/institution ID card/bonafide certificate, etc.) 5. Current academic year fee receipt 6. body: This is for the information of all students who have been awarded with R grade in Capstone Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses (List attached as Attachment I) that the interface for the registration in R grade is active now. The students can register for the R grade by following the below mentioned steps: Step-I- Filling of the Online Registration Form: All students having R grade in the attached list of courses are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via following UMS Path: - UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 16th February 2026 (without any late fee) and 23rd February 2026 (with a late fee of Rs.2000/-). Important points- i) The detailed process (along with the screen shots) of registering and paying the R grade fee is also attached with this announcement as Attachment No- 2. ii) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 23rd February 2026. In this activity, participants will be shown a picture and will be required to speak on it for one minute. The event aims to assess students’ ability to perceive visual details, organize thoughts quickly, and communicate ideas clearly and confidently within a limited time.This event provides a platform for students to improve fluency, creativity, and critical thinking while expressing opinions, interpretations, and narratives based on visual stimuli. title: MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-7)/IC/260210/0054 (2/10/2026)
body: The MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program is an initiative by Myntra Cares, the CSR and Sustainability arm of Myntra, designed to empower students from garment worker and artisanal families by offering financial assistance for their higher education. This scholarship provides annual support for three consecutive years, covering educational expenses for students pursuing graduation courses at recognized State and Central universities. By easing financial barriers, the program enables students to complete their higher education with confidence. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/mynvidhya-myntra-cares-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 15 Feb 2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Applicants must have completed Class 12 (any stream) with a minimum of 60% marks. 2. Must be enrolled in any year of a full-time graduation course (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA, BCA, and any technical courses -Tech & Engineering, etc.) in a recognized State/Central university. 3. Annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 5,00,000. 4. The applicant's parent must be employed as a full-time garment worker. Benefits: Selected students will receive a scholarship of INR 20,000 per year for 3 years. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. A recent passport-sized photograph of the applicant. 2. College admission or continuing proof (Admission Letter/Institution ID Card, etc.) 3. Class 12th & 10th marksheet 4. Address Proof (Driving License, Electricity bill, etc.) 5. Identity Proof (PAN Card, Driving License, etc.) 6. Family income proof (Form 16A, government-issued income certificate, salary slip, etc.) 7. Applicant’s bank account details 8. Occupational Proof of Parent (Indicating their current employment status) 9. Appointment Letter or Company ID card of the parent for Garment Workers, and a Certificate issued by the relevant authority certifying them as traditional artisans for artisanal families. 10.Caste certificate, where applicable How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. . Log in to Buddy4Study using your registered ID to access the ‘Application Form page’. . If you’re not registered, sign up on Buddy4Study using your Email, Mobile, or Google account. . You will be redirected to the “MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program” application form page. . Click the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload the relevant documents. . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click ‘Preview’. If all the details are correct in the preview, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete your application. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- Myntra Cares Scholarship Program All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

body: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is delighted to announce that Universidade da Coruña (UDC), Spain has officially opened the Call for Scholarships for the International Summer School (ISS) 2026, to be held from 13th to 24th July 2026 in A Coruña, Spain. Scholarship Highlights Selected students will receive a full scholarship that covers: Course tuition fees Accommodation in a university hall of residence Meals during the academic period (12th–25th July 2026) Travel expenses (airfare, visa, insurance) are not covered. Who Can Apply: Eligible applicants: Minimum 6 CGPA. No backlog/ reappear or disciplinary cases. Currently enrolled undergraduate/postgraduate students (preferably 2nd year & above) Valid Passport. Required Documents & Application Steps: 1. Complete the ISS online application form and select the scholarship option. 2.Prepare a 1–2 minute video in English explaining: Why you want to attend ISS Your contribution to the global diversity of the program How it aligns with your goals (Upload on YouTube and paste the link in your application. ) Application deadline: 12th February 2026 (23:59 GMT+1) Scholarship outcomes: 15th March 2026 Program Details: ISS 2026 offers a variety of intensive English-taught courses across disciplines such as AI, sustainability, law, health, communication, and more. Classes take place face-to-face at UDC campus in A Coruña. Explore the full course list: https://udc.es/en/iss/courses-2026/list-of-courses/ To apply register at this link: https://forms.gle/oxKUp315GkkZz1dd6 For More Info Division of International Affairs Email: study.abroad@lpu.co.in Contact: 7986997720 / 9875928583

title: Registration for Tuition Classes (January–April 2026) has been extended. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/260203/0072 (2/3/2026)
body: The University remains committed to supporting your academic progress and helping you overcome academic challenges. In continuation of this commitment, the University is pleased to announce a special initiative of Tuition Classes for selected courses (list attached), scheduled to be conducted during January–April 2026 in online as well as offline mode. This initiative is specifically designed for: 1. Students who feel they have performed below expectations in one or more courses of the First Term (Autumn Term) of Session 2025–26 and wish to strengthen their understanding and improve their academic performance. 2. Students having pending E/G grades, providing them an opportunity to clear these grades and enhance their academic readiness, including preparation for placements. The exams of these course code will be conducted just after the completion of these classes. Key Details of the Tuition Classes Initiative . Tentative Start Date of Classes: 2nd week of February,2026 . Course Duration: 40 hours per course (Maximum 2 hours per day) . Mode of Classes : Online or Offline (depending upon students interest) . Class Timings: 09:00 AM-5:00 PM and after 5:00 PM (Students will be granted duty leaves for classes overlapping with their regular schedule (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). . Course Registration Limit: Maximum two courses per student . Classes for a course will be conducted only if sufficient student registrations are received for that course code. . Registration Fee: Rs.1000 per course(The fee will be charged to the student’s account upon registration.) Fee Policy: Once registered, the fee is non-refundable, and deregistration will not be permitted. . Exam Registration: Students enrolling in tuition classes must separately register for the corresponding E/G grade examinations, wherever applicable, through the designated exam registration portal. Additional Support: . Examinations for G-grade courses of registered students will be conducted after the completion of the tuition classes (tentatively during March–April 2026) This initiative aims to provide focused academic support and help students strengthen their concepts, improve performance, and achieve their academic goals. Eligible students are strongly encouraged to take full advantage of this opportunity. Register using the link Tuition Classes Registration latest by 07th February, 2026 and take a confident step toward your academic success. For Queries / Assistance Students may log an RMS ticket through: UMS Navigation → RMS → Log Request → Student Relationship (DSR) → Academic Support → Additional Tutoring Classes Alternatively, students may contact us at 01824-520150.

body: Purpose and Implementation of Course Coordination (CC/MCC) Meetings: Course Coordination (CC) and Master course Coordination (MCC) meetings are conducted to ensure academic alignment, consistency in teaching–learning processes, and synchronized delivery across multiple sections of the same course. These meetings serve as a structured forum for the Professional Learning Community (PLC), enabling collaborative academic engagement among faculty members. The key objectives of CC/MCC meetings include: . Discussion on Gamified Learning approaches with an AI focus . Deliberations on effective integration of AI tools and methodologies within courses . Academic discussions related to course delivery and pedagogy . Collaborative planning of teaching strategies, best practices, and academic interventions to address the learning needs of both slow and advanced learners CC/MCC meetings shall be conducted for all Theory and Practical courses offered across the University. The Course Coordinator is requested to actively encourage student participation, wherever appropriate, in both CC and MCC meetings to strengthen learner-centric academic practices. body: Master Panel Data Econometrics and Dynamic Modelling with STATA - Join the workshop to elevate your data analysis skills! body: All students are hereby informed that Advitiya 2026 , the Annual Technical Festival of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Ropar, will be organized in February 2026. This three-day fest inspires participants to compete, learn, and innovate through awe-inspiring technology exhibitions and adrenaline-driven challenges, igniting curiosity, creativity, and a deep passion for technology among the brightest minds across the country. Advitiya delivers an unforgettable experience through interactive workshops, high-energy competitions, engaging keynote talks, and global performances, while serving as a dynamic platform for technical excellence. Lovely Professional University invites interested and eligible students to participate and represent the University at this prestigious national-level technical platform. Major Event Categories at Advitiya’26 will feature (but not limited to)- • Aerial & Aeromodelling Competitions: FPV drone races like Flight Fury and precision aerial challenges such as Way Point Dash, • Automotive & Robotics Challenges: Vehicle-based robotics and mechanized competitions including Full Throttle and Gripbot Gauntlet, • CAD & Design-Based Events: Computer-Aided Design and engineering challenges focused on creative and precise modeling including CADvergence, • Coding & Hackathon Battles: Online/offline hackathons such as Advitiya x JPD Hub Hackathon’26, • Problem-Solving & Treasure Hunt Puzzles: Campus-wide treasure hunts and logic quests that test analytical skills and teamwork, • Exhibitions & Showcases: Technical demonstrations, hardware showcases, innovation exhibits celebrating cutting-edge creations and research projects, • Quizzes: Engagements like multidisciplinary quizzes and intellectual challenges. (Detailed event-wise information is available on the official Advitiya website.) Event Date: 6, 7. & 8 February, 2026 Last date to Register 1st Feb 2026 Process of Registration Interested students must strictly follow the registration and approval process mentioned below: 1.Register online on the official Advitiya’26 website, either individually or as a team, for the respective event(s). Registration Link: advitiya.org.in 2.After completing online registration, students are required to fill the internal LPU approval form for participation approval. Internal Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1avKx3_l-2fLEirG4oRFYEo_8hZmkHZgcgaem05BS7As/preview Last date to fill the form: 1st Feb 2026 3. Subsequently, students must meet Mr. Ruhul Choudhury, Block 39, for the further approval process, which includes: •Verification of participation details •Project manufacturing approval (where applicable) •Parent consent •Duty leave approval •Travel and other administrative approvals Participation will be considered confirmed only after completion of the internal approval process. Eligibility •Open to all UG and PG students of Lovely Professional University •CGPA Must be 6 or above. •Students from all disciplines with an interest in technology, innovation, research, and entrepreneurship are encouraged to apply Why Participate •Opportunity to represent LPU at IIT Ropar •Exposure to a competitive national-level technical ecosystem •Hands-on learning and innovation-driven experience •Networking with industry professionals, researchers, and student innovators. •Academic benefit to the Achievers as per Policy For any query kindly Contact: Mr. Ruhul Choudhury at 6284626764 Or Visit Innovation Studio, Block 39

body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club, “Geeks of Hospitality” of School of Hotal Management and Tourism is going to conduct “Read, Reflect, Reveal – A Non-Competitive Event on Reading Comprehension”. This event is designed to help students strengthen their presentation skills, communication skills, time management, analytical reasoning, and critical thinking abilities. This event will provide students with a platform to read a given passage carefully, comprehend its meaning, and share their interpretation in a structured manner. Participants will articulate their understanding, highlight key ideas, and present insights within a limited time frame. The activity emphasizes clarity of thought, confidence in expression, and the ability to analyse and connect textual content to broader contexts. The main objectives of the event are: To strengthen verbal communication and public speaking skills through structured comprehension sharing. To develop presentation skills by organizing and delivering ideas with clarity and confidence. To build confidence in spontaneous expression, a vital skill for academic and professional success. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: Registration for Tuition Classes (January–April 2026) has been extended. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/260121/0068 (1/21/2026)
body: The University remains committed to supporting your academic progress and helping you overcome academic challenges. In continuation of this commitment, the University is pleased to announce a special initiative of Tuition Classes for selected courses (list attached), scheduled to be conducted during January–April 2026 in online as well as offline mode. This initiative is specifically designed for: 1. Students who feel they have performed below expectations in one or more courses of the First Term (Autumn Term) of Session 2025–26 and wish to strengthen their understanding and improve their academic performance. 2. Students having pending E/G grades, providing them an opportunity to clear these grades and enhance their academic readiness, including preparation for placements. The exams of these course code will be conducted just after the completion of these classes. Key Details of the Tuition Classes Initiative . Tentative Start Date of Classes: The classes will start only after the declaration of the end term examination result. . Course Duration: 40 hours per course (Maximum 2 hours per day) . Mode of Classes : Online or Offline (depending upon students interest) . Class Timings: 09:00 AM-5:00 PM and after 5:00 PM (Students will be granted duty leaves for classes overlapping with their regular schedule (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). . Course Registration Limit: Maximum two courses per student . Classes for a course will be conducted only if sufficient student registrations are received for that course code. . Registration Fee: Rs. 1000 per course(The fee will be charged to the student’s account upon registration.) . Fee Policy: Once registered, the fee is non-refundable, and deregistration will not be permitted. . Exam Registration: Students enrolling in tuition classes must separately register for the corresponding E/G grade examinations, wherever applicable, through the designated exam registration portal. Additional Support: . Examinations for G-grade courses of registered students will be conducted after the completion of the tuition classes (tentatively during March–April 2026) This initiative aims to provide focused academic support and help students strengthen their concepts, improve performance, and achieve their academic goals. Eligible students are strongly encouraged to take full advantage of this opportunity. Register using the link https://tinyurl.com/tutionclasses latest by 02nd February, 2026 and take a confident step toward your academic success. For Queries / Assistance Students may log an RMS ticket through:UMS Navigation → RMS → Log Request → Student Relationship (DSR) → Academic Support → Additional Tutoring Classes Alternatively, students may contact us at 01824-520150.

No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 30th January 2026 as on the request of students the last date of registration has been extended. Time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll SDC Courses: 30th January 2026 Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in

body: Dear Vertos! Student Organization Coding Blocks LPU, under the aegis of the Division of Youth Affairs, Student Welfare Wing, Lovely Professional University is excited to announce its recruitment drive! Become a part of one of India’s most dynamic and innovative coding communities, where creativity, collaboration and growth thrive. At CodingBlocks LPU, we take pride in being the driving force behind some of the most iconic events at LPU. From Hosting "Sunburn Campus"— an ultimate four-day fusion of electrifying music, unstoppable energy, and pure celebration featuring Priyanshi Srivastava and DJ Holy C. Additionally, we’ve organized an inspiring session on entrepreneurship with Sanjay Mishra, Harshvardhan Jain, Anubhav Dubey, founder of Chai Sutta Bar and many more. Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and excellence! We are on the lookout for passionate and skilled individuals in the following domains: 1. body: This is in continuation to the announcement “Regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of Spring term 25262” (LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/260112/0057) (1/12/2026).All registered students are now required to select the supervisor of their own choice, one supervisor shall be allocated to each group. The students are required to visit the following UMS path to check the details of available supervisors as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All groups are required to start interaction with available supervisors and should finalize their supervisor with a consent latest by 22nd January 2026. title: Registration Open for Tuition Classes (January–April 2026) : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/260114/0125 (1/14/2026)
body: The University remains committed to supporting your academic progress and helping you overcome academic challenges. In continuation of this commitment, the University is pleased to announce a special initiative of Tuition Classes for selected courses (list attached), scheduled to be conducted during January–April 2026 in online as well as offline mode. This initiative is specifically designed for: 1. Students who feel they have performed below expectations in one or more courses of the First Term (Autumn Term) of Session 2025–26 and wish to strengthen their understanding and improve their academic performance. 2. Students having pending E/G grades, providing them an opportunity to clear these grades and enhance their academic readiness, including preparation for placements. The exams of these course code will be conducted just after the completion of these classes. Key Details of the Tuition Classes Initiative . Tentative Start Date of Classes: The classes will start only after the declaration of the end term examination result. . Course Duration: 40 hours per course (Maximum 2 hours per day) . Mode of Classes : Online or Offline (depending upon students interest) . Class Timings: 09:00 AM-5:00 PM and after 5:00 PM (Students will be granted duty leaves for classes overlapping with their regular schedule (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). . Course Registration Limit: Maximum two courses per student . Classes for a course will be conducted only if sufficient student registrations are received for that course code. . Registration Fee: ?1000 per course (The fee will be charged to the student’s account upon registration.) . Fee Policy:Once registered, the fee is non-refundable, and deregistration will not be permitted. . Exam Registration: Students enrolling in tuition classes must separately register for the corresponding E/G grade examinations, wherever applicable, through the designated exam registration portal. Additional Support: . Examinations for G-grade courses of registered students will be conducted after the completion of the tuition classes (tentatively during March–April 2026) This initiative aims to provide focused academic support and help students strengthen their concepts, improve performance, and achieve their academic goals. Eligible students are strongly encouraged to take full advantage of this opportunity. Register using the link https://tinyurl.com/tutionclasses latest by 20th January, 2026 and take a confident step toward your academic success. For Queries / Assistance Students may log an RMS ticket through: UMS Navigation → RMS → Log Request → Student Relationship (DSR) → Academic Support → Additional Tutoring Classes Alternatively, students may contact us at 01824-520150.

title: Revenue Generation Registration under EDU Revolution is Open for Term 25262 – Application for Academic Equivalence. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)(Vol-1)/IC/260113/0099 (1/13/2026)
body: Dear Students, The Revenue Generation Model is designed to empower students who are eager to explore knowledge beyond the confines of traditional classrooms. The Student Centric Revenue Generation Model (SCRGM) offers students an opportunity to: · Explore Revenue-Generating Ideas: Students can bring forward their innovative ideas and learn how to turn them into viable revenue streams. · Put Curriculum Skills into Practice: Implement and enhance skills learned from their academic courses in real-world scenarios to bridge the gap between theory and practice. · Develop Entrepreneurial Skills: Through practical experience, students can build essential skills in entrepreneurship, such as problem-solving, financial management, and strategic planning. · Craft Their Career Path: Students can tailor their career trajectory by aligning their passions and skills with real-world opportunities. · Gain Practical Experience: By working on projects and initiatives, students gain hands-on experience that enhances their understanding and prepares them for future careers. · Spearhead Ongoing Entrepreneurial Projects: Initiate and manage ventures that create job opportunities for others, driving economic growth and employment. Who Can Participate? All students across all schools can register for SCRGM, either individually or in team Registration Categories: Students can register in the following categories based on their interests and ideas: i. Start-up ii. Part-time Job iii. Freelancer iv. Self-Employed v. OJT/Paid Internship With regard to the above it is for your information that the interface for the registration of Revenue Generation for Term 25262 is open and you can register at the following link: UMS Navigation----- LMS--------- EDURevolution Be the Change-------Apply for EDURevolution-----------Revenue Generation In addition to gaining invaluable entrepreneurial experience, students who participate in SCRGM shall be provided with approved academic equivalence. Student-submitted ideas and projects will be evaluated by an academic committee. Based on the committee's evaluation and recommendations, appropriate academic credit or equivalence will be granted to the students. Register now and make your learning count through real-world impact!! Don’t miss this opportunity to turn your ideas into reality and gain valuable entrepreneurial experience. To assist you with the registration process, a detailed step-by-step guide is available as an attachment. Please review it carefully before initiating your application: For more details on SCRGM, Kindly contact Mr. Sanchit Singla or Dr.Bhanu Priya in 29-404 or you can also RMS on UMS → Relationship Management System → Academics

body: The iF Design Student Award 2026 invites young designers from across the world to showcase future-oriented design concepts that address real-world challenges aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Participation is completely free of charge. Who can participate? Current students of design-related programs Recent graduates (degree/diploma completed within the last 2 years) Participation allowed as: Individual entries Teams of up to 4 members What Can You Submit? Original design concepts such as: Products Projects Applications Communication ideas Service concepts You may submit multiple concepts, but one concept can be entered in only one category. All submissions must be in English Categories & Focus Categories are based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 1–15) Designs should address social, environmental, technological, or economic challenges How to Participate (6 Simple Steps) 1. Create an account on the iF Design portal 2. Choose entry name, category & entry type 3. Upload required media: 2 images 1-page presentation poster (PDF, DIN A1 – Landscape) (guidelines attached as pdf file) Optional video link 4. Write entry description (max. 650 characters) 5. Add team & university details + certification of study 6. Review and submit your entry Submission Portal (Choose IF student design awards category) https://myif.ifdesign.com/login Important Dates Submission Deadline: 28 January 2026 Online Jury: 4 – 13 March 2026 Final Jury (Berlin): 24 April 2026 Winner Notification: From 7 May 2026 Awards Ceremony: 10–11 June 2026 Winner Publication: 11 June 2026 Why Participate? (Benefits for Winners) EUR 50,000 total prize money to be shared amongst top entries Official iF Winner Logo & Certificate Global publication on iF Design website (lifetime) Exhibition showcase in Taipei & other global locations PR & social media promotion by iF Design Invitation to a 2-day international awards ceremony at Berlin SDGs list Following are the SDGs that can be considered for your project: No poverty Zero hunger Goodhealth and well-being Quality education Gender equality Clean water and sanitation Affordable and clean energy Decent work and economic growth Industry, innovation and infrastructure Reduced inequalities Sustainable cities and communities Responsible consumption and production Climate action Life below water Life on land Google form link https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScDuTx1li4I-BXAP5Yit232Jh6zD5eryUZTecXDl4dO_-aV2Q/viewform?usp=header For any queries contact Ms.Ankita Kararia through mail at ankita.kararia@lpu.co.in Please note it is mandatory to register on both links.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-2026 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260112/0002 (1/12/2026)
body: Description Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2025-26 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Benefits A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline Deadline:15- Jan- 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/NZFokKtn6Qey7YpG9 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in

title: Think. Analyze. Innovate. UIDAI Data Hackathon 2026 Awaits You! : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260108/0001 (1/8/2026)
body: UIDAI has invited registration for participation in the Online Hackathon on data-driven innovation for Aadhaar, organised by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) in association with National Informatics Centre (NIC), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). UIDAI has made anonymised datasets of Aadhaar enrolment and updates, available to the participating teams to identify meaningful patterns, trends, anomalies, or predictive indicators and translate them into clear insights or solution frameworks that can support informed decision-making and system improvements. Participation This contest is open to any student enrolled in any accredited Indian university/Institution. Participant(s) must be at least 18 years of age on 1st Jan 2026.Participants can participate individually or form teams – ideally heterogeneous, consisting of people with different skill sets – up to a maximum of five members, including the Team Lead. The team lead must submit his/her student ID card along with those of the team members during project submission. Login and Registration All participants must register/sign up at Janparichay portal. A registered user can directly login at https://event.data.gov.in/ portal and submit required details to participate in the Hackathon. It is expected that the participants would submit accurate and up-to-date details and they have to confirm this before submission. A team leader and each team member can be part of only one team. Any one of the team members can create a team for participation. Steps for Login and Registration 1. Access challenge Page – https://event.data.gov.in/challenge/uidai-data-hackathon-2026/ 2. Existing User Login Click on ‘Login to Participate’ on the challenge page. You will be redirected on the ‘JanParichay’ site. Participant can login using any of the following methods: Username – Login using username and password. Mobile – Login using mobile and password. Others – Login using email id and password. After successful login, you will redirected back to the event site: https://event.data.gov.in. Participants are advised to update their email id in their JanParichay account before proceeding to event site(https://event.data.gov.in). To update the email id in JanParichay account, please follow steps mentioned in Point 4. 3.New User Sign-Up/Register: Participants who are new to JanParichay must first register on ‘JanParichay’ platform. The JanParichay registration process primarily uses a mobile number. Participants are advised to update their email id in their JanParichay account before proceeding to event site(https://event.data.gov.in). To update the email id in JanParichay account, please follow steps mentioned in Point 4. 4.Update Email id in JanParichay account. Follow the below mentioned steps to update your email id: Step 1 – After logging in to JanParichay site, go to Edit Profile page Step 2 – Under ‘VERIFICATION DETAILS’, select ‘Primary Email Id’ from the ‘Select Verification Parameters’ dropdown. Step 3 – Enter your email id in the text field and click on ‘Verify’. Step 4 – Enter the OTP sent to the specified email id and click on ‘Submit’. Step 5 – Log out from the JanParichay service and re-login to the event site using your mobile number or email id. Structure of the Hackathon Event will be conducted online. There would be a time of 15 days from the launch of the Hackathon to register and submit an idea. Interested candidates would access the event registration and submission links at challenge page. Shortlisted teams will be invited to make presentations before UIDAI officials and the Jury Panel. An award ceremony will be organized by UIDAI in either Delhi or Bengaluru (venue to be notified in due course). UIDAI will reimburse the travel expenses incurred by the shortlisted teams. Problem Statement Problem Statement: Unlocking Societal Trends in Aadhaar Enrolment and Updates Identify meaningful patterns, trends, anomalies, or predictive indicators and translate them into clear insights or solution frameworks that can support informed decision-making and system improvements. Prizes 1st prize: 2,00,000 with certificate. 2nd prize: 1,50,000 with certificate. 3rd prize: 75,000 with certificate. 4th prize: 50,000 with certificate. 5th prize: 25,000 with certificate. General Terms and conditions Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully as they apply to the Hackathon. To be eligible to participate and declare as shortlisted or winners in the Hackathon, the participants must accept these Terms and Conditions: Participants must not provide any false information in the registration and team creation process. Participants must keep their contact information accurate and up-to-date. Only a single MyGov/Janparichay/OGD account is permitted for an individual or a team. If more than one account exists for the same candidate, then it will automatically result in the disqualification of the candidate. As a part of the submission, the contestant certifies the originality and ownership of the solution as detailed/described in the documentation uploaded at the time of submission. The participant(s) must ensure that his/her/their work has not been previously published or awarded. The participants will not use this contest to do anything unlawful, misleading, malicious, or discriminatory. The winning submissions must be maintained in working condition by the contestant(s) for a period of one year. No functional enhancements are expected, but all bugs identified according to the description in the documentation should be fixed immediately on reporting. If any participant is determined to have violated the terms of the contest, UIDAI have all rights to disqualify the participant without prior notice. If the Applications shortlisted do not meet the expectations of the Jury, Jury has the discretion and the right, not to confer an award in one or more categories/ subcategories. The Jury’s decision shall be final and cannot be challenged. UIDAI reserves the right to change the terms and conditions, if required. The organizers reserve the right in their sole discretion to withdraw participation of any individual/team from the event or reject any submission at any point of time during the process. Submission and Expectations Participants must submit one consolidated PDF containing the following sections: Problem Statement and Approach: A concise description of the problem being addressed and the proposed analytical or technical approach. Datasets Used: A clear description of the dataset(s) and columns used for the analysis. Participants must use the Aadhaar enrolment and/or update dataset provided by UIDAI. Methodology: A detailed explanation of the methodology adopted, including data cleaning, preprocessing, and any transformations applied before analysis. Data Analysis and Visualization: A description of key findings and insights, and the visualizations or infographics developed. Participants must also include code files or notebooks used for the analysis (in the PDF itself). Note: Shortlisted teams may be asked to submit the code file/notebook separately on GitHub. Jury and Evaluation All applications will be rated on the parameters listed below: Data Analysis & Insights: Depth, accuracy, and relevance of univariate/bivariate/trivariate analysisAbility to extract meaningful findings from the data Creativity & Originality:Uniqueness of the problem statement or solution, innovative use of datasets Technical Implementation:Code quality, reproducibility, and rigour of approach, appropriate methods, tooling, and documentation Visualisation & Presentation:Clarity and effectiveness of data visualizations, Quality of written report or slides Impact & Applicability: Potential for social/administrative benefit, Practicality and feasibility of insights/solutions Google form link https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd5oBqMbG0UodIVUtKg7nslHzJOfew0olSZl-9lDwUJ6wqzcQ/viewform?usp=header For any queries Contact Ms. Ankita Kararia through email at ankita.kararia@lpu.co.in Please note it is mandatory to register at both links i.e. Google form and Government portal.
