title: JN Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship 2026–27 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260107/0001 (1/7/2026)
body: Description: JN Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship Established in 1892 by Jamsetji Nusserwanjee Tata, the promoter of the Tata Group, the J N Tata Endowment awards merit-based loan scholarships to students across India. Every year, more than 100 scholars are selected across disciplines, ranking from the sciences (applied, pure and social), management, law and commerce, and the fine arts. Eligibility: Candidates should be Indian citizen, not older than 45 years as of June 30, 2026, and graduates of a recognised Indian university having scored at least 60% marks on average in their undergraduate or post-graduate studies. Candidates are not eligible to apply if their undergraduate degree is not from a recognised university in India. Candidates who are admitted to the course, must be recognized as a Graduate Program (post-graduate in Indian terminology). Candidates who did not get selected in the previous year/earlier for the J N Tata Endowment loan scholarship and candidates who could not avail of the loan scholarship when they were selected, are eligible to apply afresh. Candidates who are already pursuing post-graduate studies overseas may apply either at the end of their first year of studies or at the commencement of the second year, provided there is a minimum of one full academic year (12 months) remaining to be completed at the time of the loan scholarship award, typically in July of any calendar year. Candidates who are currently on break for CPT or OPT training must have two full semesters or three quarters remaining to complete their program. Candidates in the final year of their degree course and those awaiting results are eligible to apply. Candidates may apply, even if they do not have the admission/offer letter from the universities to which they have applied for the academic year 2026-2027, at the time of filling out the application form. However, they must update their application status with the Endowment once they secure admission by sending an appropriate email to jnteapplication@tatatrusts.org, quoting the reference number that appears on the top left side of the form. J N Tata scholars who have fully repaid their existing loan scholarship amount are eligible to apply. Candidates going overseas for student exchange program, seminars, conferences, training, workshops, paper presentations, undergraduate studies, and any post-graduate degree/diploma/certificates through Distance learning or online mediums are not eligible to apply. Candidates planning to pursue post-graduate and undergraduate studies in India are not eligible to apply. Candidates who are planning to study for a diploma of at least one-year duration, whose entry-level requirement is higher secondary level, are not eligible to apply. Benefits : Loan scholarship of up to 20 lakh. Application Deadline : Deadline:15- March- 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: NOTE : Apply Now: JN Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship 2026-27 [Win loan scholarship up to INR 20 lakh] Google Forms: https://forms.gle/pF9B19M7uuzhBLhc9 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. 2. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. 3. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in

title: The Economic Times AI Hackathon 2026, India’s largest GenAI Hackathon ! : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/260102/0001 (1/2/2026)
body: About the ET GenAI Hackathon The ET Gen AI Hackathon, in partnership with Unstop, is a nation-scale innovation challenge designed to discover and celebrate India’s brightest emerging AI talent. This flagship competition brings students together to solve real-world GenAI problem statements across business innovation, social impact, and open innovation domains. Across a multi-phase journey - beginning with an online GenAI assessment, moving into an intensive prototype build marathon, and culminating in a high-energy offline grand finale - participants ideate, innovate, and present transformative AI solutions. With expert mentorship, structured evaluation, and massive national visibility, the hackathon aims to accelerate India’s GenAI ecosystem. This is the platform where students turn ideas into impactful solutions and establish themselves as the next generation of AI leaders. Eligibility Criteria Open to participants across India - students, professionals, and AI enthusiasts. Participants May Compete Individually Or In Teams Of 1-4 Members Cross-discipline and mixed-background teams are fully allowed. Ideal for passionate innovators, designers, developers, and problem-solvers eager to build real GenAI solutions. Each participant may join only one team. Themes for the participation Choose Any Theme And Create Innovative GenAI Solutions: Media & Digital Media Innovation Stock markets & Financial Analytics Healthcare & Wellness Sustainability & Environment Smart cities & Civic Innovation Education & Learning Transformation FinTech Innovation Open Innovation Phase 1 submission requirements- Online qualifier In phase 1, you need to attempt a Gen-AI MCQ assessment and submit an Idea Presentation (PPT/PPTX) that includes your problem statement, solution approach, target users, GenAI technologies to be used, system architecture diagram, expected impact, and team introduction. Guidelines: Use stable internet with functioning camera/mic for proctoring. Only one attempt allowed; tab-switching may lead to disqualification. Do not refresh or close the test window; complete within allotted time Phase 2 submission requirements- Online Build Marathon Turn your idea into a functional prototype with architecture, code, and demo video You need to submit: System Architecture Diagram (PDF/PNG), Functional Prototype, Public GitHub Repository, 2-3 minute Demo Video, and README/Documentation. All ideation and coding must occur within the 48-hour window. Begin building only after the official start time. Guidelines: Submit all deliverables before the deadline; late submissions will not be accepted Using pre-existing code without disclosure may lead to disqualification Missing or inaccessible submission links will result in disqualification Submitting after the deadline will not be accepted Phase 3 requirements- Grand Finale- Offline Hackathon Refine, build, and pitch your GenAI solutions through technical demos and business presentations What to Expect: Live technical evaluations & coding Presentations & business pitching Networking with mentors & industry leaders Architecture review checkpoints What to Bring: Laptops & chargers Power banks Any hardware required for your solution Valid ID proof Guidelines: All team members must attend in person - virtual participation not permitted Upload final code and pitch deck on Unstop before evaluation Keep presentations crisp, structured, and impact-focused Rules & Guidelines No changes to team members will be allowed after the deadline. All ideas, code, documents, and assets must be original and created during the hackathon. Plagiarism, use of pre-built projects, or unauthorized third-party material will lead to immediate disqualification. Participants may use open-source tools, libraries, and models. Licensed tools/datasets may be used only if the participant/team has valid authorization. All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and ET. Ensure all files and links (GitHub, demo videos, documents) are publicly accessible and properly named. Judging Criteria Solutions will be evaluated on: Innovation & Creativity Technical Implementation Feasibility & Scalability Relevance to the Problem Statement Documentation & Presentation Quality Phase 1 timelines MCQ Assessment – Last Date: January 27, 2026 Idea Submission – Last Date: February 1, 2026 Result Declaration: February 7, 2026 Phase 2 timelines Prototype Submission Starts: February 7, 2026 Prototype Submission Ends: February 15, 2026 Result Declaration: February 23, 2026 Phase 3 Timelines Online Build Marathon Starts: February 23, 2026 Online Build Marathon Ends: March 4, 2026 Result Declaration: March 6, 2026 Grand Finale Presentation: To be announced Rewards & Prizes The Winners from the Grand Finale will win a grand prize of INR 5,00,000. The First Runners-Up Team will win a cash prize of INR 3,00,000. The Second Runners-Up Team will win a cash prize of INR 2,00,000. Top-performing candidates will get the opportunity to secure Pre-Placement Interviews (PPIs) and internships with our partner top tech companies. All participants receive an official Certificate of Participation from The Economic Times, top 3 teams per college earn a Certificate of Merit, and finalists and winners gain national-level recognition across ET platforms and media. Chance to network with experts, founders, and AI practitioners. Registration Fee Nil For Registrations (External Link) https://unstop.com/competitions/1608780/register?utm_source=economictimes.com&utm_medium=et_microsite&utm_campaign=et_microsite Important instructions regarding registration steps If you are unable to verify your phone number during the registration process, Please share a screen recording of the issue at support@unstop.com They will guide you further on this. To verify the team members: Please ask your team members to verify the details by following the steps received by them over the email with the subject line ‘Registration Initiated | Confirmation pending | ABC’.Please ask your team members to click on the ‘Incomplete Details’ button present on the opportunity page. Important instructions regarding Grand finale All team members of the finalist teams must attend the Grand Finale in person. Virtual participation is not permitted. You should bring laptops & chargers, power banks, and any hardware required for your solution. Internal Registration Link (Mandatory To Fill) https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScFygQatOaFSbVbkzel1Z3JN8pTQ_z3qHzuXyUujRG64v5ijw/viewform?usp=publish-editor For any queries Contact Ms. Ankita Kararia at ankita.kararia@lpu.co.in For more details https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/et-ai-hackathon Please note that it is mandatory to register on both the external link and internal link

title: eRaksha Competition- An Official Pre-Summit Event of the AI Impact Summit 2026 focused on AI for safe Bharat : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/251224/0003 (12/24/2025)
body: What is eRaksha? eRaksha is India’s national competition platform that empowers students, educators, institutions and caregivers to express ideas, creativity and innovation around cyber safety, digital responsibility and AI ethics. Launched by CyberPeace with partners like NCERT and Google.org, it encourages safe, ethical and responsible engagement with the digital world. 2025 Theme “AI for Peace & Safety – Building Trust in the Age of Machines” The 5th edition focuses on responsible AI use, raising awareness about deepfakes, online scams, digital privacy, cyberbullying and more. It invites participants to explore how AI can be used creatively, ethically and safely. Who Can Participate? School & college students Educators & school staff Educational institutions Timeline (2025–26): Last Date of Submission: 15 Nov 2025 – 20 Jan 2026 Shortlist Announcement: 25 Jan 2026 Final Showcase & Demo Day: 9 Feb 2026 Award & Policy Brief: 10 Feb 2026 at Bharat Mandapam during India-AI Impact Summit 2026 Competition Tracks: 1. Artcade: Create artworks (drawings, paintings, stickers, memes, slogans, comics) that communicate safe and responsible cyberculture. Artwork must be original with clear messaging. 2. Word Hack: Use writing skills to express ideas on cyber safety and digital ethics through: Short stories (200–250 words) Essays (500–750 words) Articles/Blogs (800–1000 words) Research Papers (4000–5000 words) All entries must be original. 3. AI Creative Video Challenge: Produce original short videos (≤ 60 s) or social-media clips highlighting responsible AI use, such as: Spotting deepfakes Online safety tips Ethical AI narratives Videos are judged on message clarity, creativity, impact and execution. 4. Tech Avishkar: Build innovative tech solutions (software, hardware) addressing real cybersecurity challenges. Participants can submit proofs of concept, prototypes or technical documentation in PDF/PPT. Teams up to 3 allowed. Submission & Awards: All entries must be original and unique. Digital submissions accepted in common formats (PDF, JPG, PNG, video links). Winners receive awards, certificates and visibility on national platforms; all validated participants get participation certificates. Selective participants will be Awarded as ‘Cyber peace ambassadors’ Link for registration: https://www.eraksha.net/registration-form/students Link for google form (mandatory): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeiRzYx737O4trSThD76IQClpcFmu8y17A7QliuYg3Pqgmcxg/viewform?usp=header Important instructions: It is mandatory to fill both forms. For any queries kindly connect with Ms. Ankita Kararia through mail at ankita.kararia@lpu.co.in In your best interest kindly go through the website : https://www.eraksha.net/

title: Workshop on Review Article Writing, Bibliometric Analysis & Qualitative Research Methods : LPU/13.2/AOTP/2024/001/IC/251223/0002 (12/23/2025)
body: Unlock research impact - Master Review Writing, Bibliometrics, and Qualitative Methods in this expert-led Workshop! Registration is invited for Workshop on Review Article Writing, Bibliometric Analysis & Qualitative Research Methods. A six-day workshop is a powerful blend of Systematic Literature Review (SLR), Bibliometric Analysis, Review Article Writing, and Qualitative Research using R Studio and ATLAS.ti —designed to equip researchers with the complete skill set needed for high-quality, publication-ready research. title: Foundation For Excellence Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251220/0249 (12/20/2025)
body: Foundation For Excellence India Trust has introduced the Foundation For Excellence Scholarship for Technical Courses 2025 to empower talented students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, enabling them to pursue higher education in professional fields such as Engineering, Integrated M.Tech, or 5-Year Law programs. Selected scholars will receive a scholarship of INR 50,000 per year for the duration of their course. In addition to financial assistance, FFE scholars will benefit from skilling programs, mentorship, and placement support designed to enhance employability and foster personal growth Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/foundation-for-excellence-scholarship-for-technical-courses The Last date for the scholarship is 31 Dec 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Only Students pursuing BE / B.Tech. Courses are Eligible For Scholarships 2. Only First-Year Applicants Beginning Their Studies In B.E., B. Tech. 3. Applicants Are Expected To Have Passed Their Higher Secondary / Pre-University / Intermediate / CBSE/ISC Or Equivalent Board Qualifying Examination After 2023. 4. Students must have passed Class 12/Intermediate/Higher Secondary/Pre-University/ISC/CBSE later with at least 70% marks. 5. Admission To Professional Degree Courses/Institutions Is Based On The Merit Rank Awarded At The State Or National Level Entrance Exams, Or Through A Counselling Process Conducted At The State Level. 6. Family income should not exceed INR 3, 00,000 from all sources. Financial Criteria: - Applicant’s gross family income, the education and occupation of parents as well as family members including an elder brother(s) and sister(s), the family’s living conditions and the total expenses being incurred by the family on the applicant’s education will be taken into consideration for determining the financial eligibility of an applicant. Annual Family Income should be less than INR 3 LPA. Note: Gross income refers to the income before deductions for taxes or other purposes. Applicants who are the first graduates of the family will be preferred over applicants who are the second or third child of the family taking up graduation. Award information 1. If selected as a recipient, the student will receive a scholarship award of INR 50,000/year until graduation. 2. Awards are renewable each year until a Bachelor’s degree is earned. Renewal is contingent upon the applicant continuing full-time enrolment in an eligible course of study at an accredited four-year college or university, maintaining a good standing with their university and continuation of the program by Info Edge. 3. Along with the financial award, Info Edge will also provide mentorship, skill building opportunities and other networking opportunities. 4. Awards are for undergraduate study only. Selection of Recipients • This FFE – Info Edge scholarship is available to all students, irrespective of the applicant’s caste, community or religion. The only eligibility criteria for the program are academic performance and family income. Selection of recipients is made by Foundation For Excellence. • In no instance does any officer or employee of Info Edge play a part in the selection. All applicants agree to accept the decision as final. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. XII Marksheet 2. Entrance Rank Certificate 3. Counselling Letter For Seat Allotment 4. Family Income Certificate Or Salary Slip (For 3 Months) Or IT Return Form 5. E-Aadhaar Or Scanned Copy Of Your Original Aadhaar 6. Tuition/Hostel/Mess Paid Receipts 7. Bank Passbook Copy For Bank Account Details Confirmation 8. Bonafide certificate issued by college 9. Fee Structure for the course issued by College 10. Parent’s or Guardian’s Declaration Secondary Documents . Bonafide Certificate from College . Statement of Estimated Expenses from College . Bank Passbook Copy (for account verification) Selection process 1. Students apply to FFE – Info Edge Scholarship Program through an online application form. 2. Once student eligibility is determined, students are connected to one of FFE’s distributed network of volunteer “Facilitators” in 27 states. Facilitators meet the prospective student or their family members, virtually, to determine the genuineness of need and financial hardship. 3. After verification of family background and academic credentials, students submit the application form online along with all supporting document and requirement for FFE – Info Edge Scholarship Program. 4. FFE does not discriminate based on caste, creed or religion. Notification . Applicants will be notified latest by March 31st, 2026. Scholarship will be awarded to the eligible scholars post verification and selection. The selection will happen on a merit cum application basis. Not all applicants to the program will be selected as recipients. Payment of Scholarships . Foundation for Excellence processes scholarship payments on behalf of Info Edge. Payments are made in one installment before 31st March of each year. How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. . Log in to Buddy4Study with your registered ID. . If not registered, you can do so using your email, mobile, or Gmail account. . You will now be redirected to the ‘Foundation For Excellence Scholarship for Technical Courses 2025’ application form page. . Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload relevant documents. . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. . If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the ‘Preview Screen’, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. . Once shortlisted, you will be intimated via email or phone for the next steps. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- - Foundation For Excellence Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251220/0248 (12/20/2025)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering,Integrated LLB (5 Years), other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree). Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship?cuid=med_KKGS4_20250624_1 The Last date for the scholarship is 31 Dec 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for meritorious girl students across India. 2. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. 3. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. 4. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2025-26 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering,other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). 5. Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26. Benefits 1. A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. 2. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Disclaimer: Terms and conditions apply. Scholarship selection and amount are based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria and will be at the discretion of Kotak Education Foundation. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Marksheet of previous qualifying examination (Class 12) 2. Income proof of parents/guardians 3. ITR of parents for FY 2024-25 (if available) 4. Fee structure (for academic year 2025-26) 5. Bonafide student certificate/letter from college 6. College seat allocation document 7. College entrance examination scorecard 8. Aadhaar card 9. Bank passbook 10. A passport-size photograph 11. Disability certificate (if applicable) 12. Death certificate of parent (for single parent/orphan candidates) 13. Photographs of the house The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- - Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. title: Mind Merge: A Competitive Event on Blending the Strengths of Readers with Non-Readers : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/251219/0004 (12/19/2025)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “Readers’ Buffer” of School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Mind Merge: A Competitive Event on Blending the Strengths of Readers with Non-Readers”. In this event, participants will be grouped into mixed teams consisting of readers and non-readers. Readers will contribute insights, themes, and knowledge drawn from books or literary texts, while non-readers will bring creativity, imagination, and fresh perspectives to the discussion. Each round will present teams with literary situations, problem-solving tasks, or idea-based challenges that require combined thinking. Teams must quickly analyze the prompt, connect ideas, and propose innovative solutions or interpretations. The competition emphasizes communication, mutual respect, and the ability to value different strengths within a team.The event encourages students to think beyond individual ability and recognize the importance of collective intelligence. The main objectives of the event are: · To promote collaborative learning by bringing together readers and non-readers, enabling participants to value diverse strengths and perspectives. · To enhance critical thinking and problem-solving skills through literary and idea-based challenges that require quick analysis and teamwork. · To foster creativity and innovation by encouraging non-readers to contribute imaginative interpretations alongside readers’ textual knowledge. Target audience: The students of School of Computer Science and Engineering and School of Computer Applications will participate in the event. Date: 23rd. December, 2025 Time: 12:00 Noon Onwards Venue: Block 28-408 Resource Person: Ms. Shikha Bhatti Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/MindMergeCompetitiveEVent

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-2026 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/251216/0002 (12/16/2025)
body: Description Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2025-26 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 Benefits A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Application Deadline: Deadline:31-Dec-2025 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/rNwoppVEi5TJFxJo8 Note: 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. 2. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. title: Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship Program 2025-26. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251211/0016 (12/11/2025)
body: The Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship Program 2025-26 is an initiative by Aadhar Housing Finance Limited (AHFL), dedicated to supporting students with physical disabilities who are pursuing any year of general or professional undergraduate studies across India. Through this scholarship, selected students will receive financial assistance ranging from INR 10,000 to INR 50,000, helping them continue their academic journey with dignity and confidence. The program strives to create equal access to education for every learner, regardless of their physical challenges, geographical background, or financial circumstances Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/aadhar-kaushal-scholarship-program-for-youth-with-disabilities?cuid=api_AKSP1_20251201_1 The Last date for the scholarship is 13 Jan 2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to students with physical disabilities pursuing any year of general or professional undergraduate courses. 2. Applicable for students across all regions of India. 3. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the previous academic year. 4. Candidates from families with a gross annual income of up to INR 3 lakh are eligible to apply. NOTE: Preference will be given to students from Tier 2 and 3 cities. Benefits Selected students will receive a scholarship amount between INR 10,000 to INR 50,000 based on the actual fee of the college. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Applicant's photograph 2. Applicant's Aadhaar card 3. Proof of current enrollment in undergraduate (general and professional) courses for the current academic year 4. Documentation of expenses related to course fees, including tuition fees, exam fees, etc. 5. Previous year mark sheets/Class 12 mark sheets 6. A certificate indicating annual family income, along with supporting documents such as ITR/Salary Slips, etc. 7. Valid government proof of disability 8. A declaration from the applicant, family, or institution confirming that the student is not currently availing of any other scholarship How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. . Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and navigate to the ‘Application Form Page’. . If you haven't registered yet, please sign up on Buddy4Study using your email, mobile number, or Gmail account. . You will now be redirected to the ‘Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship Program 2025-26’ application form page. . Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload relevant documents . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview”. . If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- - Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: LPU Signs MoU with University of North Texas, USA : LPU/11.2/IRC(UNTC)/2025/003(3.39)/IC/251210/0002 (12/10/2025)
body: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University and the University of North Texas (UNT), USA. This collaboration aims to strengthen mutual cooperation in areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer and winter programs, and other academic initiatives. Founded in 1890 and located in Denton, Texas, the University of North Texas is one of the prominent public research institutions in the United States. It serves a large and diverse student community and offers more than 240 academic programs across multiple disciplines. Ranked in the QS 901 to 950 range for 2026, the university is widely recognized for its excellence in music and the arts, supported by one of North America’s largest music colleges and the nation’s first jazz studies program. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science Engineering is going to conduct “Verbal Mastery Challenge – A Quiz Competition Focused on Verbal Aptitude for Placement and Entrance Exams”. The event will aim to build confidence and improve accuracy in areas that are crucial for placements, higher studies and competitive exams. Verbal aptitude is a key part of most assessments, yet many students struggle with vocabulary, comprehension and verbal reasoning under time pressure. This competition will give students a chance to test their skills, understand their level and identify areas for improvement in a structured and engaging format. title: EDU Revolution Continues: Learn Beyond the Classroom and Into the Real World. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)(Vol-1)/IC/251204/0105 (12/4/2025)
body: Dear students The EDURevolution, a student-centric academic initiative, has already demonstrated remarkable impact over the past two terms. Through this transformative journey, thousands of students have enhanced their skills, gained meaningful hands-on learning experiences, strengthened their industry readiness, and even emerged as market-ready entrepreneurs. With gamification, real-world learning, flexible choices, and experience-based achievements, EDURevolution ensures your skills and accomplishments are clearly reflected in your Academic Transcript. The University hereby announces the opening of nominations for the EDURevolution for the upcoming term, i.e., the Spring Term of Session 2025–26. In this term, EDURevolution opens broader avenues for students with the introduction of the flexible 50-50-50 Academic Model, designed to integrate experiential learning into every student’s journey. 50% learning outside the classroom 50% attendance outside the classroom 50% grading from real-world outcomes beyond the classroom Hence, every student is invited to be part of this transformative academic movement and unlock limitless learning and career-building opportunities. The EDURevolution benefits can be taken from the following categories: Categories* Core courses Non-Core Courses Course Equivalence (Full or Partial) Through . NPTEL/MOOC/Certifications . Projects . Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) . Internships beyond the curriculum Through . Revenue Generation . Social Media Presence . Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) . Internships beyond the curriculum . Co-curricular/Extracurricular Sports and Cultural activities . Community Service Projects Grade Upgradation Through . Technical Competitions/Hackathons . NPTEL MOOCs/Certification. . Industry based Projects. . Publications/Patents . Recruitment/Competitive Examination Through . Revenue Generated . Social Media Presence . Community Service Projects . Internship beyond the curriculum . Co-curricular/Extracurricular Sports and Cultural activities . Full Term Paid Internship/Placement Attendance Outside the Classroom through Duty Leave Through . Recruitment/Competitive examination . Technical Competitions . Industry and Field Projects . Free lancing and Entrepreneurial projects . Skill Development Workshop/Short Term Courses Value Addition in Academic Transcript Through . Activities beyond the regular curriculum that enhances a student's knowledge, competencies, and employability . These activities shall be recognized and be reflected in the academic transcript to showcase holistic development “Any Other” Category: Propose Your Own Option If you have a new option for any course, beyond the ones already listed, that aligns with real world learning or flexible academic enhancement and is currently not available on the EDURevolution portal, you may submit it under the “Any Other” category (available across all categories) for all courses. * Detailed category-wise tentative criteria are provided in the annexures attached with this announcement How to Nominate: Your Ideas, Your Interface, Your EDURevolution: By the Students, For the Students As part of the EDURevolution initiative, an interactive and user-friendly interface has been designed by university students Gangireddy Vishnu Vardhan Reddy and Ashish Kumar Singh from the School of Computer Science and Engineering, and Abir Mahanta from School of Computer Application and has been refined based on valuable feedback received from students. The interface is now open for nominations submission through the following link: UMS --> LMS ---> EDURevolution: Be the Change ---> Apply for EDURevolution Important Guidelines for submitting the nominations: 1. A new feature called the “EDURevolution Cart” has been introduced in the nomination interface 2. This cart functions similarly to a shopping cart — allowing you to add, review, modify, or remove the options you wish to nominate before final submission. 3. Students are advised to carefully review all course-wise options available to them in the interface and generate their preferred cart. 4. All options you select under different categories will be collectively displayed on a single page within the “EDURevolution Cart.” 5. Once you finalise and submit your cart, no changes can be made to the options submitted in that attempt. 6. Each submitted cart will be assigned a Unique Number. Students can use this unique number to track the status and progress of their submitted nominations at any time. 7. If, at a later stage, a student wishes to add more options under the EDURevolution initiative, they may generate a new cart and make a second submission after careful review. Options submitted during the first attempt will remain locked and cannot be edited. However, additional new options may be added in the second submission. 8. Student can create the cart twice in a term and only two online submissions are permitted in a term. 9. If a student wishes to nominate for any category after exhausting both online submission attempts, they may do so by visiting the EDURevolution Query and Assistance Zone located at Block 27–102. 10. All submitted nominations will undergo a verification process by the Standing Committee (at the school level). The committee may contact students directly, request supporting documents, or call them for an in-person interaction, if required. 11. For your nominations to be processed by the Standing Committee, it is mandatory to upload all relevant supporting documents at the time of submission. Any submission that is incomplete or lacks the required documents may be disapproved or placed on hold by the Standing Committee. Note: . Submitting a nomination does not guarantee approval of benefits. . The Standing Committee holds full authority to approve, reject, increase, or decrease the proposed benefits. . The best possible decision will be taken based on merit, relevance, and supporting evidence provided. Following do’s and don’ts must be considered while submitting your nomination Do’s Don’t Read the eligibility criteria carefully before applying Don’t submit fake, edited, or unverifiable documents. It may call for Unfair Means Case Upload clear and valid proofs (certificates, screenshots, bank statements, reports, etc.) Don’t sign and submit the undertaking form without properly reading and understanding Keep all supporting documents ready in case the Standing Committee asks for verification. Don’t submit incomplete/invalid/blank applications and proofs Track deadlines for MOOCs, Projects, internships, exams, competition and submissions Don’t assume approval is guaranteed after submission—committee’s decision shall be final. Fill the mandatory undertaking wherever required Make the Most of Your Winter Break: The winter break offers an excellent opportunity for students to complete the listed activities, allowing them to return better prepared for the upcoming term. Students are encouraged to make the most of this time and submit their nominations to avail the benefits in the upcoming term. Details provided in the attachments: Annexure I: Flow Chart of EDURevolution Nomination Annexure II: Detailed criteria for Student Centric Revenue Generation, NPTEL/MOOCs, Grade Upgradation, 10 % Attendance, Internship beyond curriculum, Recognition of Prior Learning Annexure III: Other relevant policies In case of any query, kindly raise it through the following RMS path: UMS Navigation ---- Relationship Management System ---- EDURevolution be the change

title: Frames of Thought: A competitive event on Picture Perception and Story Craft : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/251202/0006 (12/2/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Liberal and Creative Arts Social Sciences & Languages is going to conduct “Frames of Thought: A competitive event on Picture Perception and Story Craft”. We are excited to announce the event is a creative writing competition focused on observation and writing! This event will help in creating the thoughts as per the observations of the images on the screen. Participants will be shown one or more images for a limited time and asked to note key observations (characters, setting, mood, possible actions). They then present a short, structured story, followed by individual narration. The main objectives of the event are: · To sharpen visual observation and interpretation skills using ambiguous pictures. · To construct clear, logical, and positive narratives based on visual prompts. · To practice quick thinking, written communication and eye on details. title: Inference-A workshop based on counting of figures : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/251202/0003 (12/2/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Inference – A workshop based on counting of figures” a stimulating and skill-oriented session designed to enhance your logical reasoning, visual analysis, and critical thinking abilities. This workshop focuses on mastering techniques to identify patterns, break down complex shapes, and accurately count figures—an essential component of reasoning sections in competitive examinations. Through interactive problem sets, smart shortcuts, and structured strategies, participants will strengthen observation skills and boost analytical speed. This session will help students to prepare for banking exams, SSC, GATE, or other competitive tests. The main objectives of the event are: · To develop strong logical reasoning skills through the concept of counting figures and visual pattern recognition. · To enhance analytical thinking by breaking complex diagrams into simpler components for accurate evaluation. · To introduce effective strategies and shortcuts for solving counting-of-figure and enhance speed and accuracy in solving visual reasoning problems. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, the Club 'Bosch' of the School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct 'InsightArena: A Competition of Analysis and Articulation.' It is an intellectually charged, case-study inspired event that celebrates problem-solving, teamwork, and persuasive communication. This competitive experience invites student duos to step into the role of strategic consultants. Each team will draw a surprise case study from a bowl, ranging from real-world business dilemmas to technology-driven challenges, and will be given time to analyze, brainstorm, and craft their solutions. Teams will then present their findings, with evaluation based on the strength of their solution as a group and the clarity of their presentation as individuals. title: Registration Open for MEDHA 2025 -Medical Device Hackathon : LPU/18.4/CAPB(EBGB)/2024/001(1.2)/IC/251124/0001 (11/24/2025)
body: We are thrilled to announce MEDHA 2025, a premier hackathon dedicated to driving innovation in medical devices. This exciting event is organized by BETIC(Biomedical Engineering and Technology Innovation Centre), IIT Bombay and aims to bring together diverse talents to create impactful solutions in the medical field. ABOUT BETIC- BETIC is a multi-disciplinary and multi-institution translational R&D network with 14 partner institutes (engineering and medical) across Maharashtra State, each of them connected to local institutes and industry. The core vision is to create global success stories of indigenous medical devices by providing the necessary guidance and support to med-tech innovators. They face four ‘valleys of death’ between concept, proof-of-concept, prototype, product and market. Crossing them requires expert inputs from multiple disciplines including medical, mechanical, materials, manufacturing and management. Required skill set and background: 1.Medical: Biomedical, Medicine, Physiotherapy, Pharma 2.Design: Industrial Design, Product Design. 3.Engineering-I: Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Chemical. 4. Engineering-II: Electronics, Communication, Instrumentation, Software 5. Management/ marketing- Optional Each team must include at least one member from each of the above backgrounds Eligibility: 1. Minimum CGPA-6 2. Regular student of Lovely Professional University 3. Must fulfill the skill set requirement as mentioned above Team formation: A team must comprise of minimum 4 members and not more than 5 members. Event Date: 2nd and 3rd Decemeber , 2025 Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/MEDHA-2025 Problem Statement: http://tiny.cc/Medha-PS Last Date of Registration: 30th November (till 3pm) , 2025 Team Formation/Verification Date: 30th Nov 2025 from 5 pm onwards at Innovation Studio, Block 39 , Room 101 No Registration Fee. title: Call for Applications – CRISP Fellowship 2026 for Ph.D. Scholars. : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/251122/0087 (11/22/2025)
body: The Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) invites applications from Ph.D. scholars to apply for the CRISP Fellowship 2026, offered by the Centre for Research in Schemes & Policies (CRISP), India. This prestigious two-year, full-time Fellowship places selected candidates within State and Central Government departments, enabling them to work on real-time governance and reform initiatives. Key Features 1. Duration: 2 years (full-time) 2. Fellowship Amount: Rs. 75,000 per month 3. Additional Support: Travel reimbursement for field visits, continuous mentoring by senior IAS officers 4. Team Structure: Fellows work under a State Team Lead with direct supervision by CRISP leadership. Eligibility Criteria 1. Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher (any discipline). 2. Professional Experience (Mandatory): Minimum 2 years of certified social work or development sector experience, supported by valid certificates or letters. 3. Skills: Analytical and research skills; proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; familiarity with AI tools, proficiency in English and at least one local Indian language. Application & Selection Timeline Applications Open: 7th November 2025 Last Date to Apply: 30th November 2025 2. Selection Process Includes: AI-Proctored Written Test (?750 per attempt) → Shortlisting of Candidates → AI-Based Interview Round → Final Interview with CRISP Leadership 3. Mandatory Joining Date: 2nd March 2026 Application Process Apply exclusively through the official CRISP Fellowship portal: https://fellowship.crispindia.net Official Website: www.crispindia.net For Assistance For guidance, Ph.D. scholars may contact Dr. Gaganpreet Kaur Marwah (Block 38–406) or raise a request via RMS: UMS → Relationship Management System → Log Request → Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes) → International Research Exchange Program An orientation session for this CRISP Fellowship will be held on Monday, 24th November 2025 at 11:00 AM in Block 38–401. Interested scholars are requested to join the session. For complete details, kindly refer to the attached CRISP Fellowship Brochure and Application Instruction PDF.

title: Registration Open MEDHA - Medical Device Hackathon : LPU/18.4/CAPB(EBGB)/2024/001(1.2)/IC/251121/0001 (11/21/2025)
body: We are thrilled to announce MEDHA 2025, a premier hackathon dedicated to driving innovation in medical devices. This exciting event is organized by BETIC(Biomedical Engineering and Technology Innovation Centre), IIT Bombay and aims to bring together diverse talents to create impactful solutions in the medical field. ABOUT BETIC- BETIC is a multi-disciplinary and multi-institution translational R&D network with 14 partner institutes (engineering and medical) across Maharashtra State, each of them connected to local institutes and industry. The core vision is to create global success stories of indigenous medical devices by providing the necessary guidance and support to med-tech innovators. They face four ‘valleys of death’ between concept, proof-of-concept, prototype, product and market. Crossing them requires expert inputs from multiple disciplines including medical, mechanical, materials, manufacturing and management. Required skill set and background: 1.Medical: Biomedical, Medicine, Physiotherapy, Pharma 2.Design: Industrial Design, Product Design. 3.Engineering-I: Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Chemical. 4. Engineering-II: Electronics, Communication, Instrumentation, Software 5.Management/ marketing- Optional Each team must include at least one member from each of the above backgrounds Eligibility: 1. Minimum CGPA-6 2. Regular student of Lovely Professional University 3. Must fulfill the skill set requirement as mentioned above Team formation: A team must comprise of minimum 4 members and not more than 5 members. Event Date: 2nd & 3rd November , 2025 Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/MEDHA-2025 Problem Statement: http://tiny.cc/Medha-PS Last Date of Registration: 29th November (till 3pm) , 2025 Team Formation/Verification Date: 30th Nov 2025 from 5 pm onwards at Innovation Studio, Block 39 , Room 101 No Registration Fee. Note: Participation teams will bring their own identified hardware as per the problem statement. All the tools will be made available on the site during the hackathon.

body: We are happy to inform you that our university has formally collaborated with Aspire For Her, a nationally recognized organisation committed to empowering young women through mentorship, skill-building, and career growth initiatives. title: CHANGE OF PROGRAM FOR THE FRESHER STUDENTS : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251117/0089 (11/17/2025)
body: This is to notify all Fresher students that they can now apply for a Change of Program using the online interface available at the following link: UMS Navigation -->Change of Program--> Request for Change of Program. However, the students should meticulously go through the guidelines (attached with this communication) before applying for the same. Timelines for change of Program:- Phase Processing Fee From To I Rs.1000/- 18th November, 2025 6th January, 2026 II Rs.3000/- 7th January, 2026 28th January, 2026 III Rs.5000/- 29th January, 2026 10th February, 2026 No program change option will be allowed after the last date i.e. 9th February, 2026 under any circumstances. Important Note:- 1. All students who apply for change of program shall be required to pay the “processing fee” online after submitting their request (Screenshot attached) along with the parent’s consent letter (Note: - The processing fee is non-refundable even if the change of program request of student is not approved by competent authorities) 2. The program of the student shall be changed for the notified students(ie. Cases approved by Equivalence committee) after the payment of change of program fee (Rs 4000/-) within the given timelines. 3. In case student fails to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for the Change of Program shall stand cancelled and he/she would be required continue in the ongoing program only. 4. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program. 5. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program, he/she will have to register the courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee (per course) with scholarship plus examination fee Rs. 500/-. In case of MBA backlog Fee will be 7.5% of the tuition fee (per course) with scholarship plus examination fee Rs. 500/- 6. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for the change of program before the start of the term. 7. The attendance shall be calculated from the date of registration of courses to student in new program. Note: Choose New Program carefully, once request is submitted then processing fee will not be refunded Any queries from students can directly login an RMS following the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)---->Log Request Master category: Academics Category: Academics Sub Category: Change of Program

title: Ericsson Empowering Girl Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251115/0062 (11/15/2025)
body: The Ericsson Empowering Girl Scholarship Program 2025-26 aims to provide financial aid to meritorious female students from underprivileged sections of society. Under this scholarship program, female students in the 2nd year of their graduation in the Information Technology, Computer Science, Information and Communication Technology or Telecommunication engineering fields across India will receive benefits of INR 75,000 to help cover their academic expenses, including accommodation, tuition fees, etc. Link for Appling Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/ericsson-empowering-girl-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 30 Nov 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for female students across India only. 2. Applicants studying in the 2nd year of an engineering program in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information and Communication Technology, and Telecommunication streams at state/UGC recognized colleges in India. 3. Applicants must have scored at least a 6.5 GPA or equivalent marks in the previous final examination. 4. The annual family income of the applicant from all sources must not exceed INR 6,00,000. 5. Preference to applicants with disabilities/single parents/orphans. 6. Children of Ericsson and Buddy4Study employees are not eligible. Benefits: Fixed scholarship of INR 75,000 Note: The scholarship amount can only be utilized for the following: · Academic Expenses - Tuition fee, admission fee, exam fee, books · Living expenses - Hostel fee, mess fee, uniform · Devices - Laptop, mobile, equipment · Monthly Allowance Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Proof of Identity 2. Current year admission proof (Admission Letter, ID Card, Bonafide Certificate) 3. Marksheet of Classes 10, 12 and First Year (1st/2nd semester marksheets) 4. Fee receipt 5. Family income proof (Income certificate issued Gram Panchayat or the State Government, ITR and salary slips) 6. Bank account details of the applicant (or parent) 7. Recent passport-size photograph 8. Documents proof of disability, orphans/single parents (if applicable) The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- Ericsson Empowering Girl Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251115/0056 (11/15/2025)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from December 2025. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is finalization of : a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for SAS registration: a. The research scholar must have cleared the course work or must be exempted for the same due to M. Phil. b. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration c. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy Note: Research scholars from the Agriculture who have cleared the first term of coursework may request for registration at: rdc.sas@lpu.co.in The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation: All eligible research scholars are required to register for SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 15th November 2025 to 10th December 2025. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis: All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the attached guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->SAS-- >Click to Submit report. All the research scholars are required to completely register for SAS evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the synopsis followed by the verification of synopsis by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 15th November 2025 to 10th December 2025. 3. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluations --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --->SAS. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the SAS synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 15th December 2025. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co Supervisor/ Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 10th December 2025, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS. d) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from June 2026 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. e) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of SAS synopsis will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of SAS synopsis, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of SAS synopsis. i) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. j) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. k) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI & VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding SAS registration, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: Student Services --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

title: Final Report Submission timelines for Project, Dissertation and similar courses for Autumn Term 25261. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-6)/IC/251114/0111 (11/14/2025)
body: This is for the information of all the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines mentioned in Annexure-III (Attached). 1. Uploading the soft copy of final report. All students need to prepare the final report of their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in four parts i.e., PDF File-1, PDF File-2, PDF File-3 and PDF file-4 (details of pdf files are given in Table 1) via their UMS as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation Table 1- Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) PDF File 1* PDF File 2 PDF File 3 PDF File 4 (Applicable only for final stage Master Dissertation) Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload "only Content Report" which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student's Name, Reg. Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone Project-II, Dissertation-II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the UGC guidelines. Student need to submit graphical abstract from Thesis/Dissertation work at Master's Level) Please ensure that PDF File 1 contains student as well as supervisor signatures on the declaration certificates before uploading the same on the UMS interface. Important Note- 1. It is advised that the student(s) must ensure timely uploading of their final report before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report before final submission of the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office by the students. 2.In Extreme cases if the final report is not ready and requires more time, student can request for an extension of maximum 60 days with a fee of Rupees 1000/- in 30-310 by filling the hard copy Extension form. 3.The guidelines (Annexure-II) attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done. 4.Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-III. 2. Online Report Recommendation from Supervisor: The soft copy of the final report uploaded by each student should be recommended by the supervisor in order to be eligible for the final ETP viva. In case report is not recommended by supervisor then final ETP viva for the student(s) shall not be conducted. 3. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative office (A.O. Office) Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, two hard copies, either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. While submitting the hardcopy of project report the AOs must write the E-Receipt Number, sign and put their UID along with the University stamp on hardcopies carried by the student. One Signed and stamped copy of the report should be returned to the student and the same must be carried by the student at the time of ETP viva. Respective School AO’s can generate an online report submission number via the following UMS path. UMS Navigation-- >Administrative Task-->Report Submission Important Points: 1. For students working in groups, any one member of the group can make the submission in AO office and it will be considered for all. Whereas, the supervisor must recommend the uploaded soft-copy via UMS interface for all students in-order to enable hard-copy submission for the whole group. 2. In case a student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be awarded. 3. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III In case of any query, student may log an RMS request using the below mentioned UMS path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)--->Log Request Select Category: Examination Select Sub Category: Training/ Dissertation/ OJT / Thesis / Seminar / Capstone & Viva

body: We are thrilled to announce MEDHA 2025, a premier hackathon dedicated to driving innovation in medical devices. This exciting event is organized by BETIC(Biomedical Engineering and Technology Innovation Centre), IIT Bombay and aims to bring together diverse talents to create impactful solutions in the medical field. ABOUT BETIC- BETIC is a multi-disciplinary and multi-institution translational R&D network with 14 partner institutes (engineering and medical) across Maharashtra State, each of them connected to local institutes and industry. The core vision is to create global success stories of indigenous medical devices by providing the necessary guidance and support to med-tech innovators. They face four ‘valleys of death’ between concept, proof-of-concept, prototype, product and market. Crossing them requires expert inputs from multiple disciplines including medical, mechanical, materials, manufacturing and management. Required skill set and background: 1.Medical: Biomedical, Medicine, Physiotherapy, Pharma 2.Design: Industrial Design, Product Design. 3.Engineering-I: Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Chemical. 4. title: Institutional Ethics Committee Meeting : LPU/8.1/LIAC/2024/005/IC/251112/0001 (11/12/2025)
body: This is to inform you that the Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) meeting is tentatively scheduled for the Third week of November 2025. If you are planning to undertake research involving human subjects, their biological fluids, blood/urine samples, any questionnaire or survey-based studies, we kindly request you to submit the necessary documents in hard copy to the Administrative Office (Block 4, Room 203), School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University. Additionally, you are required to submit the details of your research proposal in both the links mentioned below Link 1: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QLn7pp8OgGp6AyJBJrBsQpcHzHVUTFQq469dejHAzHg/edit?usp=sharing Link 2: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSctLct237ImMx6s-m8OTYkzNEY58zsURKRft5C1cYVwGZjWPw/viewform?usp=dialog A fee of Rs. 200 (for LPU-affiliated candidates) must be paid at Block 30, Ground Floor. The fee receipt should be submitted along with the hard copies of all documents in a folder to the Administrative Office before November 18, 2025. List of documents to be submitted (Format attached in Google Drive below) 1. Cover letter 2. Application Form: i) Application Form for Initial Review (for all applicants) ii) Annexure I for Interventional Studies / Annexure II for Survey-Based Studies 3. Short CV of supervisor (Use attached format sl no 16) 4. Informed consent form and patient/participant information sheet (template attached SL No. 15 & 16) 5. Research protocol 6. GCP training certificate 7. Questionnaire (if applicable) Please note that Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training will be conducted prior to the IEC meeting to ensure proper preparation of all required documents. A GCP certificate, which is mandatory as per the guidelines, will be issued upon completion of the training. Participants must submit the finalized documents to the Ethics Committee after the training session. All document templates can be accessed here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CccjTRDl_WDu-b5wBwGL_ZCaVmCXb-rs/view?usp=sharing After the 18th of November, an initial internal review of the submitted application will be done, and suggestions will be provided to the applicants. The applicant must incorporate the suggestions in the document within two days and submit the corrected documents (1 copy), duly signed by the supervisor and forwarded by the respective head of the department/Institution. Candidates also need to prepare and present a PowerPoint presentation on the day of the IEC meeting: For any query, please contact: Dr. Navneet Khurana, Member Secretary, Professor, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University, Punjab, India. E-mail: ms_ieclpu@lpu.co.in; Mobile: 7888850093 Dr. Biplab Pal, Asst. Professor, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University, Punjab, India. body: Reliance Industries Limited is organizing T.U.P XI [The Ultimate Pitch-XI], a national-level competitive program aimed at fostering innovation and strategic thinking among university students. The initiative provides participants with the opportunity to apply academic knowledge to real-world business challenges, enhance problem-solving and analytical capabilities, and gain meaningful exposure to industry practices. Outstanding teams will be eligible for cash rewards, pre-placement interview (PPI) opportunities, and national-level recognition, supporting their professional development and future career prospects. Eligibility: T.U.P XI is open to B-School students in India from all streams and academic years, provided they are pursuing a full-time degree. Only full-time postgraduate and executive MBA students can participate. Each team shall consist of 1–4 members, with one designated team leader. All team members must be from the same institute. A student cannot be part of more than one team. There is no restriction on the number of teams from a single institute. Submission Rules: Plagiarized ideas or submissions will be disqualified. Last Date to Apply: 20-Nov-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards & Recognition: Pre-Placement Interviews (PPI) for all Semi-Finalists. The Ultimate Winner: INR 6,00,000 . The Ultimate Runner-Up: INR 3,00,000. Popular Choice Award: INR 1,00,000. Elimination Round Winners: INR 50,000 & Runners-Up: INR 25,000, along with exciting T.U.P merchandise. National Finalists: Receive mentorship from in-house Reliance experts. Certificates of Achievement for outstanding contributions. How to Register: Link 1:- https://unstop.com/competitions/reliance-tup-xi-reliance-industries-limited-ril-1566159?ref=TUPmEGP0 Link 2:- https://forms.gle/Wji2htcq19VXQKXeA Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. body: Dear Aspirants, The Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) is pleased to announce that Industry Grade Assessments are being scheduled in coming weeks for all 2027 batch placement-registered students for Engineering and Hotel Management programs. These assessments will be held in the upcoming weeks through renowned national platforms—AMCAT, CoCubes, and Mercer Mettl—recognized by top recruiters across industries. These assessments are a crucial part of your placement readiness journey, designed to evaluate your aptitude, technical, and employability skills on parameters similar to actual company recruitment process. Why These Assessments Matter Mandatory for Placement Eligibility: Participation is compulsory for all listed students. Non-participation will result in debarment from placement services. Direct Visibility to Recruiters: Scores will be shared with companies visiting for campus placements. Performance-Based Training: Your results will determine your eligibility for advanced industry-specific training sessions.
