title: Baba Gurbachan Singh Scholarship Scheme 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/251101/0070 (11/1/2025)
body: The Baba Gurbachan Singh Scholarship Scheme 2025-26 is an initiative of the Sant Nirankari Mandal to support students pursuing degree and diploma courses. The selected students will receive a scholarship award of up to ?50,000 per year towards tuition fee or annual fee payable each year, whichever is less. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/scholarship/baba-gurbachan-singh-scholarship-scheme The Last date for the scholarship is 30 Nov 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Have secured a minimum of 60% marks in Class 10 and 12 or equivalent examinations 2. Have an annual family income below ?3,50,000 3. Be pursuing a diploma in Engineering or a degree in one of the following courses offered by a recognised institution in India. a. B.A./B.A. (Hons) b. B.Com./B.Com. (Hons) c. B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy) d. B.Ed. (Bachelor of Education) e. B.Sc. f. Hotel Management g. B.B.A. (Bachelor of Business Administration) h. B.C.A. (Bachelor of Computer Applications) i. M.Com. (Master of Commerce) j. M.Sc. (Master of Science) k. M.A. (Master of Arts) l. M.C.A. (Master of Computer Applications) m. Degree in Instrumental Music, or Vocal Music The following students/applicants shall not be eligible for a grant of financial assistance under this scholarship scheme: . The students who have been admitted through the management/convener quota or any other quota of the university/educational institution. . Students who have failed in any of the subjects in any of the previous semesters/years. . Applicants who have been detained in any semester/year examination due to a shortage of attendance. . Applicants who have been penalized by the university or the institute for any act of indiscipline during the course. . Students who have taken scholarships from any other source. Benefits . All the applications shall be scrutinised by the Sant Nirankari Mandal to prepare a list of eligible students who will then have to apply for an interview before the Education Committee. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: Application form Qualified exam mark sheet Passport-size photo & signature Copy of Aadhaar card University registration order copy Bank passbook (Note: - All documents that are attached should be self-attested.) How can you apply? . Eligible applicants can apply by following these steps: . Step 1: Click on the 'Apply Now' button. . Step 2: Click on the 'Register' button and fill in the required registration details (Note:- If already registered, log in using Gmail/Mobile number/Email ID). . Step 3: Scroll down and click on the ‘Form of the Scholarship Scheme’ button. . Step 4: Fill in all the required details, attach the necessary documents, and submit it only through speed post to the Member Incharge, Education Department, Sant Nirankari Mandal on or before 30 November 2025. Postal address: Education Department, Sant Nirankari Administrative Block, Nirankari Chowk, Burari Road, Delhi 110009 (India) Selection Criteria . All the applications shall be scrutinised by the Sant Nirankari Mandal to prepare a list of eligible students who will then have to apply for an interview before the Education Committee. Terms and Conditions . The applicants must not leave any column of the application form blank. . 25% of the course fee will be paid only upon receipt of the final year marksheet of the course and the feedback form sent by Sant Nirankari Mandal. . The decision of the Education Committee shall be final in all respects, and no further requests for reconsideration of the recommendations shall be entertained. . The students are required to produce the documents at the time of the interview. Contact Details Joginder Sukhija Secretary, Sant Nirankari Mandal The Education Department Sant Nirankari Administrative Block, Nirankari Chowk, Burari Road, Delhi - 110009, India Email ID: feedback@nirankari.org | Phone Number: (011)-47660200 The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- Baba Gurbachan Singh Scholarship Scheme 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Neuron CoE at STPI Mohali- Call for Applications – GENESIS EiR Program Cohort 2 : LPU/18.4/CAPB(ENGB)/2024/001(1.1)/IC/251031/0002 (10/31/2025)
body: NEURON - Centre of Entrepreneurship, STPI Mohali, invites Applications for the MeitY Startup Hub-GENESIS EiR Program Cohort 2. In collaboration with the MSH, NEURON Centre for Entrepreneurship is happy to invite applications under the MSH GENESIS—Entrepreneurs in Residence (EiR) Program Cohort 2, which offers grants of up to Rs.10 Lakhs to transform innovative ideas into impactful solutions. Introduction: The Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups (GENESIS) scheme, backed by a ?490 Crore budget over five years, is designed to strengthen the startup ecosystem in Tier II & Tier III cities by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) through MeitY Startup Hub (MSH). The initiative aims to support 1,600 tech startups by fostering innovation, building capacity, and driving meaningful solutions (https://msh.meity.gov.in/). Entrepreneurs in Residence (EiR): The EiR program Cohort 2 aims to support early-stage startups by providing financial assistance. Innovators only from Tier II and Tier III cities are encouraged to apply for the scheme and avail grants of up to Rs.10 lakhs to transform their ideas into viable technologies or startups. Only Indian citizens may apply. Applicants must be full-time UG/PG students with entrepreneurial pursuits or founders/co-founders of DPIIT-registered startups(≤ 2 years old). The EiR will have to be physically incubated at Neuron CoE. Only applicants from Tier II & III cities are eligible. Must not have received significant external funding (exceeding Rs. 10 lakh, including government grants). Must not have been previously supported under any MeitY Schemes. Applicants must be working on innovations at the stage of Ideation, Concept Development, Validation / Problem-Solution Fit, Proof of Concept (PoC), or Prototyping/Working Prototype to be considered for support under the GENESIS EiR Cohort 2 program. The applicant must be committed to working full-time on the proposed startup idea during the EiR program duration. Program Benefits: Grant Support: Up to Rs. 10 Lakhs per EiR (Disbursed in two tranches) Dedicated mentorship: Technical and business mentoring from domain experts Incubation supports: Access to NEURON’s state-of-the-art Labs and networks. Program duration: 12 Months (Ideation to prototype stage) at :https://forms.gle/RVjGTW3B7AaX8BnF9 Registration for university purpose: https://forms.gle/2SwEQJw2Hk9M8KUD7

title: SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/251028/0001 (10/28/2025)
body: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26, one of India's largest scholarship programs, is an initiative of the SBI Foundation. This program aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families across India, ensuring the continuity of their education. This scholarship is open to students, who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses from the top 300 NIRF universities/colleges. Selected students can receive a scholarship of up to INR 75,000 for UG and up to INR 2.5 lakh for PG to support their educational endeavors. Eligibility for Undergraduates Applicants: Applicants should be Indian nationals. Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate course (any year) from a premier university/college in India, as listed in the Top 300 Institutes according to the latest NIRF rankings. Students must have secured 7 CGPA / 75% marks or above in their previous academic year. The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 6,00,000. Eligibility for Postgraduates Applicants: Applicants should be Indian nationals. Applicants must be pursuing a postgraduate course (any year) from a premier university/college in India, as listed in the Top 300 Institutes according to the latest NIRF rankings. Applicants must have secured 7 CGPA/75% marks or above in their previous academic year. The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 6,00,000. title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/251014/0099 (10/14/2025)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from October 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after every 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of ETP registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy for that term. c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-ETP Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 15th October 2025 to 6th November 2025 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-ETP--Click to Submit report. Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 15th October 2025 to 6th November 2025 3. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --->ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 10th November 2025. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. d) Research scholars are also required to bring a hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation, failing which the scholar will not be allowed to appear for the evaluation. e) Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. f) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. g) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. h) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process/appear for the evaluation after registration will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". i) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. title: This World Mental Health Day - pause, breathe, and care for yourself : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/251013/0041 (10/13/2025)
body: Dear All, Today, as we observe World Mental Health Day, We want to take a moment to remind you that your well-being matters deeply. Between classes, projects, and the constant buzz of notifications, it’s easy to lose sight of yourself. But in the middle of all this motion, remember: it’s okay to pause. It’s okay to breathe. It’s okay to care for your mind as much as your ambitions. Even small acts of mindfulness can help taking a walk across campus, sharing a laugh with a friend, or simply sitting in silence for a few moments. These are not pauses in progress; they are essential parts of it. Let this day be a gentle reminder that caring for your mental health is not a sign of weakness, but of awareness and strength. When you nurture your mind, you create space for clarity, compassion, and courage to grow. As part of our ongoing efforts to promote well-being, our partners at YourDOST are hosting a special session “Learn the Art of Balancing Your Brain” to explore simple, practical ways to support your mental health and stay centered. Be a part of this enriching experience, you are warmly invited to join by clicking the link below: https://yourdost-com.qmailroute.net/x/d?c=48219155&l=ea91ac2a-38cb-4e5b-82b9-7414351e1af2&r=f06f193c-ac3d-474f-85a1-222a5c220cb0 Date: Oct 16, 2025 Timing: 04:00 PM Because caring for your mind isn’t an option — it’s essential.

title: U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/251008/0047 (10/8/2025)
body: The U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26, an initiative by U-Go, is designed to provide financial assistance to young women pursuing professional undergraduate courses. This scholarship aims to support academically bright students enrolled in professional graduation courses in teaching, nursing, pharmacy, engineering, architecture, law, etc. This financial assistance will be provided throughout the duration of their undergraduate course, enabling them to complete their education, reduce dropout rates, and build a pathway to empowered and self-reliant futures. Recipients of this scholarship will receive up to INR 60,000 ($750) per year for a duration of up to four years. U-Go, a non-profit organization based in California, USA, offers this scholarship to help ambitious and promising young women in India pursue higher education. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/ugo-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 31 Oct 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Young women pursuing professional graduation courses in teaching, pharmacy, medicine, engineering, architecture, law, etc., are eligible. 2. Applicants must be studying in any year (except the last year) of their graduation program. 3. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in the Class 10 and 12 examinations. 4. The annual family income of the applicants from all sources must be less than INR 5 lakh. 5. Students from across India can apply. Benefits: The selected scholars will receive the scholarship as specified below: 1. For Teaching Courses - INR 40,000 ($500) per year for two years 2. For Pharma Courses - INR 40,000 ($500) per year for four years 3. For Three-year courses such as BCA, BSc, etc. - Up to INR 40,000 ($500) per year for 3 years 4. For Engineering, Law, Architecture Courses, etc. - INR 60,000 ($750) per year for four years. Note: Scholarship to cover 100% of educational expenses, including academic expenses (tuition fee, admission fee, exam fee, books, etc.), living expenses (hostel fee, mess fee, uniform, etc.), devices (laptop, mobile, equipment, etc.), monthly allowance, etc. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: The applicants are required to attach the following documents during the U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26 application process. 1. Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets and passing certificates 2. A government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar card/ Voter ID card/Driver’s license/PAN card) 3. Current year admission proof (fee receipt/admission letter/institution identity card/Bonafide certificate) 4. Family income proof (ITR, Form-16/income certificate issued by a competent government authority/salary slips) 5. Payment receipts for funds spent on academic pursuits Bank account details of the applicant 6. A recent photograph of the applicant How can you apply? Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and navigate to the ‘Application Form’ page. If you're not yet registered, sign up on Buddy4Study using your Email, Mobile number, or Google account. You will now be redirected to the ‘U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26’ application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online application form. Upload relevant documents. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/251008/0046 (10/8/2025)
body: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26, one of India's largest scholarship programs, is an initiative of the SBI Foundation. This program aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families across India, ensuring the continuity of their education. This scholarship is open to students from who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses from the top 300 NIRF universities/colleges. Selected students can receive a scholarship of up to INR 20 lakh to support their educational endeavours. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-asha-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 15 Nov 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for Indian nationals. 2. Applicants must be studying or pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses from the top 300 NIRF universities 3. Applicants must have secured 75% marks or above in their previous academic year. 4. The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 3,00,000. Note: There is a provision of 10% relaxation for students belonging to SC/ST (Percentage of marks – 67.50%, CGPA – 6.30). 50% of slots are reserved for females. 50% reserved for SC/ST (25% SC, 25% ST). Benefits Scholarship up to INR 15,000 (*T&C Applied) Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Marksheet from the previous academic year (Class 10/Class 12/Graduation/Postgraduation, as applicable) 2. Government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar card) 3. Current year fee receipt 4. Proof of current year admission (admission letter/institution identity card/bonafide certificate) 5. Bank account details of the applicant (or parent) 6. Proof of income (Form 16A/income certificate from a government authority/salary slips, etc.) 7. Photograph of the applicant 8. Caste Certificate (Wherever Applicable) How can you apply? Click the ‘Apply Now’ button. Login to with your registered ID and land on the ‘Application Form Page’. If not registered, register with your Email/Mobile number/Google account. You will now be redirected to the ‘SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26’ application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online application form. Upload relevant documents. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Call for applications for ICSSR Doctoral Fellowships 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/251006/0093 (10/6/2025)
body: Empower Your Research Journey – Apply for ICSSR Doctoral Fellowships 2025–26! The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) invites applications for its Doctoral Fellowship Schemes 2025–26 to support high-quality doctoral research in various domains of social and human sciences. This is a golden opportunity for PhD scholars to receive financial assistance, academic recognition, and institutional support. Various types of ICSSR Doctoral Fellowships Fellowship Type Duration Fellowship amount/ Contingency grant Eligibility Full-Term doctoral Fellowship 2 years Rs. 20,000/month + Rs. 20,000/-contingency/year Min. 55% marks in post-graduation, Full-Time Ph.D. scholar, SAS completed Short-Term Fellowship Maximum 6 months or till thesis submission whichever is earlier Equivalent to 6 months of full-term doctoral fellowship grant + contingency grant Min. 55% marks in post-graduation, Full-Time Ph.D. scholar, SAS completed, Atleast three years of research work completed Contingency Grant One-time Rs. 62,500 for advanced stage of Ph.D. research Min. 55% marks in post-graduation, Full-Time Ph.D. scholar, SAS completed, Atleast three years of research work completed, advanced stage of Ph.D. research Important Dates Start of online application Sept 22,2025 Last date of online application Oct 21,2025 How to Apply . Applicants can submit an online application by visiting the website https://app.icssr.org/. For more details regarding broad domain, priority areas of social and human sciences for ICSSR doctoral fellowship, eligibility, steps to apply, and other conditions, please refer the attached guidelines. For any Queries, visit CRDP in 38-406 and meet Ms.Tanu Mahajan for guidance. OR Log RMS request through UMS → Relationship Management System → Log Request → Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] → Category (Govt. Fellowship)]

title: Registration Open for Prototype Marathon Season 3: Road to AIU'S International Anveshan 2025-26 : LPU/18.4/CAPB(EBGB)/2024/001(1.2)/IC/251006/0001 (10/6/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Project under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing presents "Prototype Marathon-Season 3: Gateway to AIU’s International Anveshan," . The motto of the event is to identify the projects that demonstrate exceptional creativity and ingenuity. These selected projects will be nominated to represent our university at the prestigious AIU's International Anveshan 2025-26 AIU INTERNATIONAL ANVESHAN is a global, annual research & Innovation competition launched by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) to identify, nurture, and promote the research talents of young and budding students from universities worldwide Registration Link: https://projectset.com/anveshan Registration Start Date : Oct 4, 2025 Last Date of Registration : Oct 15, 2025 Event Date: 27th October, 2024 Venue: Innovation Studio, Block 39 Registration Process: Put University name as Lovely Professional University , then only you will be allowed to get nominated from University. Team Formation: Students can participate individually or in a team of Maximum 4 members Categories for participation: Agriculture, Basic Sciences, Engineering & Technology, Health Sciences and Allied Subjects Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law Interdisciplinary Research. Awards: Top 6 Projects will be Nominated for AIU’s Anveshan 2025-2024(National Level Competition) The Top 6 project will be funded by the university Certificate of Participation will be provided to all participants. Highlights : 1. Team Annadata from our University Won AIU's International Anveshan under Social Science Category. 2. Guided by Dr. Meenakshi Jaswal, the session aims to introduce young learners to the essentials of the stock market and the transformative concept of compounding — empowering them to think long-term about saving and investing. Led by Student Representative Amritveer, this campaign seeks to build early financial awareness among Class XI and XII students, helping them make informed money decisions and develop responsible financial habits. body: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) and Student Exchange Agreement between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod, Russia. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Established in 1916, Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod (UNN) stands as one of Russia's most prominent public research institutions. Located in Nizhny Novgorod, the university offers a diverse range of programs across its 15 faculties and institutes, catering to over 30,000 students, including a significant international community. UNN is renowned for its pioneering contributions to scientific research, particularly in fields such as radio physics, mechanics, and neuroscience, and maintains strong collaborations with top scientific centers globally. If you are interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with the Lobachevsky State University, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration!

body: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell), LPU, is pleased to announce an outstanding opportunity for LPU Master’s and PhD scholars in Bio Sciences, Biotechnology, and Bioengineering to pursue a full-time PhD program at National Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology (NKUST), Taiwan. title: OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/250929/0006 (9/29/2025)
body: OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme is an initiative from OakNorth to provide financial assistance to underprivileged women seeking to pursue higher education in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) subjects. Under this scholarship, female students from Haryana, Uttarakhand, and Bihar who have passed Class 12 and are pursuing a degree (any graduation year) in STEM-related subjects at government colleges/universities will be provided with a scholarship of ?30,000 to continue their education. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/oaknorth-stem-scholarship-program Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to students domiciled in Haryana, Uttarakhand and Bihar. 2. Only female candidates are eligible. 3. Applicants must be pursuing a degree (any graduation year) in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) subjects at government universities or colleges across India. 4. Candidates must have secured an aggregate of 75% or above in Class 12 (or equivalent) and at least 65% in the previous class/semester/year (if applicable). 5. The applicant's annual family income must be less than ?3 lakhs. 6. Children of employees of Buddy4Study and OakNorth are not eligible to apply. Benefits A scholarship of ?30,000 (fixed amount) will be offered to the selected students for one time only. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. CV/resume of the applicant 2. Copies of Class 10 marksheet, Class 12 marksheet, and previous semester marksheets (if applicable) 3. Copy of Aadhaar Card 4. Family Income Proof (e.g., a letter from the SDM, DM, Tehsildar, or equivalent authority/proof of income tax returns/an affidavit, etc.) 5. Provisional allotment/admission letter from the university 6. An essay on “Why You Should Be Given This Scholarship?” 7. A letter of recommendation (from College/University) HOW TO APPLY: 1. Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. 2. Log in to Buddy4Study using a registered ID to land on the ‘Online Application Form Page’. 3. If not registered, please register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile number/Google account. 4. You will now be redirected to the ‘OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme 2025-26’ application form page. 5. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. 6. Fill in the required details in the online scholarship application form. 7. Upload the required documents. 8. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. 9. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

body: L'Oréal India invites applications for the L’Oréal For Young Women in Science Program 2025-26 from Class 12th passed girls aspiring to pursue higher education in science. The program supports talented young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds by providing scholarships of up to Rs 62,500 for Undergraduate (UG), up to Rs 1,00,000 for Postgraduate (PG), and for PhD studies across diverse fields including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more at recognised Indian institutions. Since its inception in 2015, the initiative has empowered over 550 women to pursue careers in science. Eligibility for Under-graduate Students: Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12th (Science Stream). Applicants’ annual family income should not exceed Rs 6,00,000. Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field (except those who are in their final year). Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Students: Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in their undergraduate course. Applicants’ annual family income should not exceed Rs 6,00,000. Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. (except those who are in their final year). Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: The final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last Date of Registration: 03-Nov-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Under-graduate Students: Fixed scholarship of Rs 62,500 Rewards for Post-graduate Students: Scholarship up to Rs 1,00,000 Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/LR6rFRcBYPCDSJ8a9 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. title: LPU Signs MoU with Soongsil University, South Korea : LPU/11.2/IRC(SUSK)/2024/001(1.219)/IC/250927/0001 (9/27/2025)
body: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and Soongsil University, South Korea. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Founded in 1897, Soongsil University is South Korea’s first modern university, originally established in Pyongyang. Today, Soongsil is recognized for its rigorous academic programs and selective admissions, with competitive majors in business, economics, and information technology. It is particularly noted for its computer science department, which ranks second nationally after Seoul National University, and its business school, which has produced a significant number of certified public accountants. The university has educated numerous prominent figures, including former South Korean President Kim Dae-jung, who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. With over 16,000 students, Soongsil continues to uphold its legacy as a pioneer in Korean higher education. If you are interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with Soongsil University, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration!

title: DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/250924/0102 (9/24/2025)
body: DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2025-26 is an initiative by DXC Technology aimed at supporting the educational expenses of students from marginalized groups. Under this national-level scholarship program, women and transgender students pursuing STEM courses are eligible to receive a one-time scholarship of INR 50,000 to continue their education. To apply, the family income of the student must be less than or equal to INR 4,00,000. Preference is given to persons with disabilities Link for apply Scholarship: www.buddy4study.com/page/dxc-progressing-minds-scholarship The Last date for the scholarship is 30 Sept 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Women and transgender students pursuing graduation in any year of a STEM-related field are eligible. 2. Applicants must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks in their previous class/semester. 3. Applicants’ annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 4,00,000. 4. Students from PAN India are eligible to apply. 5. Children of employees of DXC Technology and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. 6. Students with disabilities will be given preference. Benefits INR 50,000(Fixed Amount) Note: The scholarship amount covers education-related expenses, which include tuition fees, hostel fees, mess charges, travel expenses, books, stationery, devices/data, medical insurance, etc. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Applicant’s photograph 2. Institution admission proof (Admission Letter/Institution ID Card, etc.) 3. Previous year’s marksheet 4. Payment receipts for education-related expenses, such as tuition fees, hostel fees, books, mess charges, etc., along with the fee structure for the whole academic year 5. Class 12 marksheet 6. Proof of family income such as ITR, salary slips, letters from a concerned government authority, etc. 7. Proof of identity (Pan Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, etc.) 8. Bank Passbook 9. Document proof for transgender and physical disability (if applicable). HOW TO APPLY: Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. Log in to Buddy4Study using your registered ID. You will be navigated to the ‘Online Application Form’ page. If you are not already registered on Buddy4Study, register using your email ID/mobile number/Facebook/Gmail account. Once logged in, you will be redirected to the “DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship for Graduation Students in STEM 2025-26” application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online scholarship application form. Upload the required documents. Click the ‘Accept” button to agree to the terms and conditions. Please ensure you have read the terms and conditions before accepting them. Click the ‘Preview’ button. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correct on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- - DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

body: Reliance has been providing scholarships to meritorious students for over 25 years. The aim of this scholarship is to nurture and empower meritorious students and work together to generate robust, vibrant and engaged alumni networks, enabling scholars to pursue higher education, emerge as young professionals, and drive India’s growth. The Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships aim to support up to 5,000 meritorious students based on a merit-cum-means criteria. (Refer Annexure – 1) Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Be a resident Indian citizen 2. First year PG Students who secured a score of 550 - 1,000 in the GATE Examination. 3. Students who have scored 7.5 or above in their Undergraduate CGPA (or % normalised to CGPA) 4. Eligible degree programmes – Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics & Computing, Electrical/or Electronics Engg., Chemical Engg., Mechanical Engg., Renewable & New Energy, Material, Science & Engg. and Life Sciences. Important Dates and Timelines APPLICATIONS OPEN - 21-Aug 2025 APPLICATIONS CLOSE - 04-Oct-2025 REFERENCE LETTERS DEADLINE -11-Oct-2025 APTITUDE Test: - 10th to 15th Oct 2025 VIRTUAL INTERVIEWS – Nov-Dec 2025 Benefits Up to INR 6,00,000 over the duration of the degree programme. They will become part of a vibrant community of scholars who will be at the forefront of creating and building a new India. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Applicant’s photograph (passport size) 2. Address proof (permanent address) 3. Current resume 4. Marksheets of Class 10 and 12 board examinations 5. Marksheet of GATE Entrance Examination (if applicable) 6. Official transcript/marksheet of undergraduate degree 7. Bonafide Student Certificate from the current college/institution of enrollment 8. Two essays: Personal Statement and Statement of Purpose 9. Two reference letters: One academic and one character 10. Experience certificate/letter(s) from work experience/internships (if applicable) 11. Official Disability Certificate issued by the relevant 12. Government authority (if applicable) 13. Family income proof issued by Gram Panchayat/Ward Counsellor/Sarpanch/Income Proof issued by SDM/DM/CO/Tehsildar 14. Fill out the online Eligibility Questionnaire on the Reliance Foundation website. 6. If you fulfil the eligibility criteria, you will be sent an email invitation with log-in information to apply through Reliance Foundation’s application portal. 7. Scores will be sent directly to Reliance Foundation once the test is submitted. Applicants will not be notified about their scores. · The Reliance Foundation does not charge any application fees to apply for this scholarship program. body: FOSSEE, IIT Bombay invites applications for its Semester-Long Internship, Autumn 2025. This is a remote internship with mentorship and support. Students get to work with FOSSEE on real open source / educational / engineering projects Key Details Mode: Remote (with continuous support & mentoring). Topics include: . eSim . System Administrator tools (SSO etc.) . OpenFOAM (CFD modelling etc.) . DWSIM (custom models, process-modelling) . Artificial Neural Network in Chemical Engineering / AI/ML for distillation . OpenModelica . FOCAL (creative arts / graphics / animation) . Python-based screening tasks . Submit the task by the deadline. Tasks are evaluated by FOSSEE mentors. Who Should Apply? . Engineering / Science / Arts students who are interested in open-source tooling or simulation, modelling, etc. . body: This is to inform you that the IAEC meeting for the pre-clinical study will be held shortly. You are requested to submit your proposed Form B (attached herewith) by 15th October 2025 in 5-101. Please note that submissions received after this date will not be entertained. Please note that the IAEC meetings are conducted only three times a year (October, December, and February). Important Instructions for Form B Submission, Presentation, and Animal Work: 1. Guide Evaluation: Form B must be evaluated by the respective guides. The guide/co-guide and students are solely responsible for this. 2. Submission Protocol: Form B must be submitted by the guide only. 3. Correction Process: If corrections are suggested, the corrected Form B must be resubmitted along with the earlier version within 1-3 days. Late submissions will not be accepted. 4. Meeting Attendance: Attendance at the pre-IAEC (if held) and IAEC meetings is mandatory for both guides and students. Non-attendance will result in the non-approval of Form B, which will then be deferred to the next meeting. 5. IAEC Certification: Certificates will be issued upon submission of Form D and the summary report, duly signed by guides and authorized personnel. 6. Faculty Involvement: Faculty/Guides must visit the animal house to assist their respective students. 7. Instructions Review: Please read the instructions for the invigilator in Form B before signing. 8. Personnel Responsibility: Ensure that only the names of the concerned persons responsible for work in the animal house (research scholar/co-guide, if any) are listed in Form B, as they will be the only ones permitted to work with the animals. 9. Form Integrity: Do not alter the format of Form B. Any tampering will result in the form being rejected for presentation. Please adhere strictly to these guidelines to ensure a smooth and timely approval process. Contact: Dr. Bimlesh Kumar (M. Pharm., Ph.D.) Professor and Head Animal House Mobile: +91-9872260354

title: HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India 2025 : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/250915/0081 (9/15/2025)
body: The HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India 2025 program extends financial assistance to PwD female engineering students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, facilitating their pursuit of education. This scholarship program was established in 2019. With a strong emphasis on inclusion in the engineering sector, the initiative is open to first-year PwD female engineering students across India. Selected candidates are awarded financial assistance of INR 50,000 per year, along with individual mentoring by industry professionals for the full four years of their engineering program, enabling them to excel academically and grow into the next generation of engineering leaders. Link for apply Scholarship https:// https://www.buddy4study.com/page/hope-engineering-scholarship-by-schaeffler-india The Last date for the scholarship is 23-09-2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to PwD female students across India enrolled in the first year of an engineering program at any state or UGC-recognised college. 2. Applicants must have secured at least 40% marks in Class 12 (Science stream) in the academic year 2024–25. 3. Preference will be given to students pursuing the following engineering branches: a. Automobile b. Mechanical c. Mechatronics d. Electrical and Electronics e. Electronics and Communication f. Production g. Instrumentation h. Computer Science Engineering i. Information Technology 4. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 5,00,000. 5. Children of employees of Schaeffler India or Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for this scholarship. Benefits INR 50,000 per year for four years Note: Opportunity to receive mentorship from 35 Schaeffler India employees for 6 months, enabling selected scholars to learn from their valuable experience. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Passport-size photograph 2. Aadhaar Card 3. Family income proof 4. Disability Certificate (If applicable) 5. Bank passbook 6. title: Participation in India Skills Competition 2025. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)(Vol-1)/IC/250913/0090 (9/13/2025)
body: Dear students, The University Grants Commission (UGC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE), is promoting India Skills Competition 2025 — a national-level skill competition to identify, nurture, and reward young talented individuals in various technical and vocational skills. Why Participate? Showcase your skills at a national platform, and compete for recognition and prestige. Get a chance to represent India in the World Skills Asia Competition 2025 and World Skills Competition 2026. Benefit from specialised training, mentorship, and exposure to world-class skill standards. Enhance your employability prospects and gain recognition in industry & academia for your exceptional skills. India Skills 2025 – Key Details: Topic Details Eligibility (Age Criteria) for all Indian nationals Minimum age: 16 years Maximum Age: (i) Competitor must be born on or after 1 January 2004, in general; (ii) Competitor must be born on or after 1 January 2001 for the 13 Skills i.e., Digital Construction, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, ICT Network Infrastructure, Additive Manufacturing, Industrial Design Technology, Industry 4.0, Mechatronics, Optoelectronic Technology, Robot Systems Integration, Water Technology, Dental Prosthetics, and Aircraft Maintenance. Please note: Age Criteria may change subject to the notification/ announcement by World Skills India (WSI). Skills covered All skills are divided in the following six categories: 1. Construction & Building Technology 2. Creative Arts & Fashion 3. Information & Communication Technology 4. Manufacturing & Engineering Technology 5. Social & personal Services 6. Transportation & Logistics For details of skill categories, please refer to Annexure-I given in the UGC guidelines attached with this communication. Registration Mode & Portal Via Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) portal https:/www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/home You can also follow the following link: https://www.mygov.in/task/india-skills-competition-2025 Last date to register 30 September 2025 Selection / Competition Process Please go through the multi-tiered selection process as mentioned in the attached UGC guidelines for India Skills Competition 2025 UGC Notification link For further details you can go through the UGC notice and guidelines for India Skills Competition 2025 as per the following link or go through the UGC notice attached with this communication. https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/2710131_IndiaSkills-Competition-2025.pdf Please note: Students who demonstrate outstanding performance in the above-mentioned competition shall also be considered for inclusion under the Edu-Revolution academic benefit category, subject to due evaluation. They can apply as per the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --> LMS --> MOOC Certification Alternatively, students can also submit their certificates at Block 29-Room no. 404 or Assistance Zone in Block 27-Room no. 102. In case of any other query, students can visit the Assistance Zone in Block 27-Room no. 102.

title: Participation of students in Research Activities in AI-CoE and CSS, LPU : LPU/9.1/PMOU/2024/023/IC/250910/0002 (9/10/2025)
body: Artificial Intelligence-Centre of Excellence (AI-CoE) and Centre of Space Science (CSS) are jointly seeking for student participation in challenging and real-life project-based research works dealing with "AI-Augmented Resource Mapping of Battlefield Equipment with Offline Communication Capabilities". The detailed topics are as follows. A. Real-Time Location Tracking using NavIC + Inertial Navigation Systems Objective: Develop a rugged and power-efficient GPS+INS system using NavIC receivers and IMU sensors without using internet. Deliverables: 1. Microcontroller-based hardware prototype (e.g., ESP32, NavIC Module, MPU6050/ICM20948) 2. Location accuracy testing in GPS-denied or low-signal environments (Field testing) 3. Data buffering and synchronization for offline operations B. Decentralized Mesh Communication System (No-Internet Data Relay) Objective: Build a self-forming wireless mesh network (LoRa, Zigbee, MANET-style) for secure battlefield communication. Deliverables: 1. Deployable mesh nodes (eg. LoRa-enabled MCUs like Heltec/RAK, Zigbee, MANET etc.) 2. End-to-end encrypted communication 3. Multi-hop, fault-tolerant packet relay between field units and command center C. AI-Based Resource Allocation and Repair Suggestion Engine Objective: Develop a lightweight AI model to allocate nearest functional repair resource based on fault type, priority, and availability. Deliverables: 1. Decision engine trained on synthetic repair fault datasets (using tools like Python, Scikit-learn, Decision Trees/Neural Networks) 2. Optimized routing algorithm 3. Service time + risk-aware allocation decisions 4. Fault-based prioritization system, resource allocation map D. Command Center Dashboard and Visualization Interface Objective: Develop an intuitive interface to monitor all resources, fault locations, and suggested responses. Deliverables: 1. UI dashboard for Rea-time GIS-based visualization for field monitoring 2. Live plotting on offline GIS maps (MapBox/QGIS tiles, Google Earth Engine, Leaflet.js, etc.) 3. Visual alerts for downtime, risk, or supply needs (asset tracking interface) E. Secure Data Transmission and Encryption Layer Objective: Implement a lightweight cryptographic protocol (ECC or AES) to secure field data without internet dependency. Deliverables: 1. Embedded-side encryption/decryption 2. Time-bound keys or One-time password schemes 3. Command center decryption tool for trusted access only F. Portable Power System and Field Deployable Hardware Design Objective: Create rugged, low-power enclosures with solar/rechargeable battery modules for all edge units. Deliverables: 1. Power Supply Unit (Foldable Solar-array, Swappable Battery Pack, etc.) 2. Power management circuit with DC/DC converters to support multiple voltages (3.3V, 5V, 12V). 3. Compact enclosure designs (3D-printable/cut, IP67, shock/dust/water resistant etc.) 4. MIL-grade connectors and ruggedization study Note: 1. This initiative is part of a real-time, mission-driven project with defined deliverables and timelines. Due to its critical nature, only students demonstrating a strong sense of responsibility, technical competence, and commitment will be considered. Non-performance or lack of active participation may lead to reassignment or withdrawal from the project. 2. Interested and expertise students can take the above topics as capstone projects also under the supervision of AI-CoE and CSS. For any details, you can contact Prof. Rahul Saha (Block 38-207, Cabin 3) or Dr. Jaisukh Paul Singh (Block 30-603,604)

title: Apply for Passport: The First Step to Global Opportunities : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/250908/0001 (9/8/2025)
body: LPU offers a wide range of international opportunities — from the International Credit Transfer Program (2+2 / 1+1) to semester exchange, summer schools, global internships. Many of the opportunities are available on 100% Scholarship. To participate, students must be passport-ready and keep essential documents updated. A valid passport is the first requirement to apply for any international program. Why act now? ? Applying early avoids last-minute delays. ? Passport processing requires police verification at your permanent address — you must be present at home during that time. ? International opportunities can arise anytime, and being prepared ensures you don’t miss out. What you need for a passport application: ? Aadhaar Card (Identity & Address proof) ? 10th Marksheet / Birth Certificate (Date of Birth proof) ? College ID Card (Recommended for students) ? Passport-size photographs (if not opting for on-spot service) How to apply: ? Register at passportindia.gov.in ? Fill application form & pay fees online ? Book appointment at nearest Passport Seva Kendra (Jalandhar / Ludhiana / Amritsar) ? Visit with required documents ? Track application status online Apply for your passport in your first year itself. Many students lose opportunities due to delays in passport readiness — don’t let that happen to you. Take the first step towards your global journey today.

title: LPU Signs MoU with University of West of England (UWE Bristol), UK : LPU/11.2/IRC(UOWE)/2024/001(1.150)/IC/250906/0001 (9/6/2025)
body: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the University of West of England (UWE Bristol), UK. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Founded in 1595 and based in Bristol, England, UWE Bristol is a modern public research university with origins in the Merchant Venturers’ Navigation School. It is one of the largest universities in South West England, recognised for its practice-oriented teaching and strong industry links. Ranked in the 601–800 band globally in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2025, the university is especially known for excellence in robotics, data science, creative industries, and politics, and for impactful, internationally recognised research. If you are interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with the University of West of England, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration!

body: The NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship Program 2025 is offered by NVIDIA, a prestigious fellowship supporting outstanding PhD students engaged in research that drives innovation in accelerated computing and its applications. Selected students will receive a scholarship award of USD 60,000 (Approx 524,630.00) along with an opportunity to work closely with leading NVIDIA researchers through a mandatory summer internship. Eligibility for Applicants: Have completed at least one year of PhD studies at the time of application. Be majoring in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, System Architecture, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Be enrolled as a full-time PhD student during the 2026–2027 academic year (not graduating before May/June 2027). Be actively engaged in research as part of their PhD thesis. Be available for an in-person summer internship at one of NVIDIA’s global research offices. Not be an immediate family member of a current NVIDIA employee. Last of Registration: 15-Sept-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Up to USD 60,000 funding for stipend, tuition, and fees. Mandatory internship at NVIDIA before the fellowship year. Access to NVIDIA products, technology, and research teams. Opportunities to conduct cutting-edge research and build an industry network. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/scholarship/nvidia-graduate-fellowship-program Link 2 : https://forms.gle/T1DiB4afpZytLmwC8 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. title: U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250905/0001 (9/5/2025)
body: The U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26, an initiative by U-Go, is designed to provide financial assistance to young women pursuing professional undergraduate courses. This scholarship aims to support academically bright students enrolled in professional graduation courses in pharmacy, medicine, engineering, architecture, law, etc. This financial assistance will be provided throughout the duration of their undergraduate course, enabling them to complete their education, reduce dropout rates, and build a pathway to empowered and self-reliant futures. Recipients of this scholarship will receive up to INR 60,000 ($750) per year for a duration of up to four years Eligibility for Applicants: Young women pursuing professional graduation courses in pharmacy, medicine, engineering, architecture, law, etc., are eligible. Applicants must be studying in any year (except the last year) of their graduation program. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in the Class 10 and 12 examinations. The annual family income of the applicants from all sources must be less than INR 5 lakh. Students from across India can apply. Last of Registration: 31-Oct-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: For Pharma Courses - INR 40,000 ($500) per year for four years. For Three-year courses such as BCA, BSc, etc. - Up to INR 40,000 ($500) per year for 3 years. For Engineering, Law, Architecture Courses, etc. - INR 60,000 ($750) per year for four years. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/ugo-scholarship-program Link 2 : https://forms.gle/d29yxbPgBpToc37q7 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Mittal School of Business presents an exciting opportunity to join “Verbal Juggernauts” – a dynamic community for enthusiastic speakers, debaters, and communicators. This initiative is designed to sharpen articulation, foster critical thinking, and build confidence in public speaking. Members will engage in debates, role plays, group discussions, and speech presentations, while also refining their non-verbal communication and persuasive skills. Mission of the Club The mission of Verbal Juggernauts is to empower students with strong verbal communication and presentation skills while enhancing their ability to think critically and respond effectively in diverse situations. The club also aims to prepare members for placements and real-world scenarios by simulating professional interactions and encouraging confidence in expression. Benefits of Joining the Club · Develop persuasive speaking and impactful communication. · Strengthen active listening, confident speaking, and expressive writing. · Improve confidence, clarity, and fluency in discussions and interviews. · Gain opportunities to participate in competitive speaking events. · Engage in interactive communication activities, boosting personal and professional growth. Target Audience: The Students of all Schools at Lovely Professional University. Last Date to Register: 8th September, 2025 Resource Person: Ms. Shally Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/RegistrationVerbalJuggernauts

title: Concern for Your Well-being — Have You Explored the Student Mess Facilities Yet? : LIT/07/MELO/2024/015/IC/250829/0001 (8/29/2025)
body: Dear Student, We’ve noticed that you haven’t become part of our student mess family yet — and we just wanted to reach out with a warm hello, because we truly care about your comfort and well-being while you’re here. University life can be demanding, and we understand how easy it is to overlook the importance of regular, balanced meals — especially when juggling classes, assignments, and personal responsibilities. That’s exactly why the Student Mess is here — to support your health and comfort with food that feels like home. Why Choose the Student Mess? We provide more than just meals. We offer a community dining experience designed with your needs in mind: 1. Nutritious & Balanced Meals — Freshly cooked breakfast, lunch, and dinner to support your daily health. 2. Packed Breakfasts — For early risers or students with off-campus commitments. 3. Lunch Box Delivery — Conveniently delivered near the Academic Block, ideal for students with tight schedules. 4. Soft Food Options — Gentle meals for students recovering from illness or in need of light diets. 5. Special Fasting Meals — Custom-prepared meals for religious and cultural fasts such as Navratri, Ramadaan, or specific weekly fasting days (e.g., Monday, Thursday, Saturday) etc. 6. Satvik Meals — Pure, wholesome, and freshly prepared Satvik meal options are also available on campus. 7. Hygienic, High-Quality Food — Clean kitchens, branded ingredients, and strict quality controls. 8. Air-Conditioned Dining Hall — A comfortable space to relax and dine in all seasons. 9. Cultural Connection — Share meals and experiences with peers from across the country and globe. 10. Rotational Menus — A variety of cuisines and dietary options to keep meals exciting. 11. Special Event Dining — Celebrate with themed dinners, festive meals, and occasional treats. 12. Monthly Birthday Celebrations — Every birthday deserves to be special and no one should celebrate alone! 13. Affordability — A cost-effective alternative to eating out regularly. We truly believe that good food contributes to better focus, health, and overall student success. If you have any dietary preferences, timing issues, or personal concerns, we’re here to help. Please feel free to visit us at: Division of Vendors & Contractors Management Block 29, Room 301 Let’s talk about how we can support your needs — because your well-being matters.

DELNET database is to facilitate access to a vast range of bibliographic resources, enhancing the availability of knowledge and information. You can access millions of resources through DELNET like 4,00,00,000+ Books available for loan, 1,12,000+ list of Journals, 5,000+ Full-text E-journals and 1,45,000+ Thesis/Dissertations. The access to DELNET resources can be availed through 2 modes: 1. Direct Web Search: If a user is connected to the university WiFi, the subscribed e-resources are automatically accessed through IP-based institutional access. 2. Through Remote Access system (MapMyAccess: www.lpu.mapmyaccess.com). For accessing the DELNET through the MapMyAccess Portal, please refer to the attachment “Manual to access DELNET”. The DELNET is an essential platform for students, particularly in academic research and higher education, offering access to a wide variety of resources across different subjects. Through its network of libraries, interlibrary loans, digital content, and specialized materials, DELNET provides a powerful tool to help students and researchers access knowledge and stay ahead in their academic pursuits. We encourage you to make the most of this valuable resource to enhance your academic experience. If a student, faculty, or staff member is facing any sort of difficulty in accessing the same through this portal, they may log an RMS request at: - UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Transactions ---> Log Request Select: - Message Type: Assistance Category: Library Sub-category: Online Database/E-Resources To find out more about LPU library services and resources or for any feedback please visit at: https://www.lpu.in/academics/libraries.php.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250829/0003 (8/29/2025)
body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and pursuing professional graduation courses like Engineering and other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) will be provided scholarship of Rs 1.5 lakh per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree). Eligibility for Applicants: Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than Rs 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2025-26 for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26. Last of Registration: 31-Aug-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: A scholarship amount of Rs 1.5 lakh per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Link 2 : https://forms.gle/H9TeUrUTYijjjxRF8 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Enroll in Skill Development and Foreign Languages Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250829/0006 (8/29/2025)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. Moreover, students can also join Foreign language courses. Numerous students have cleared the Foreign Language Exams for French, Spanish, German and Japanese Languages. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31st August, 2025, as on the request of students the last date of registration has been extended. Time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll SDC Courses: 31st August, 2025. Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in Last Date to Enroll Foreign Language Courses: 30th August, 2025 Enrollment Link for Foreign Language Courses: https://www.lpu.in/admission/short-term-courses.php

title: Bhutan Ambassador’s Scholarship for session 2025-26. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-5)/IC/250828/0106 (8/28/2025)
body: Registration process for applying for the Ambassador’s Scholarship for the session 2025-26 for Bhutan students has been opened for students pursuing undergraduate and Post Graduate courses in India. Link: - https://www.indembthimphu.gov.in/scholarship_2025-2026 Last date of applying for the scholarship is 15th September 2025. Important notes for Students: 1. Applicants are advised to read the FAQs on the link: https://www.indembthimphu.gov.in/public_files/assets/pdf/bhutan_11aug2025_faq.pdf, before filling the online application. 2. Students may fill up the online Ambassador Scholarship form for 2025 through a computer/laptop. Please do NOT try to submit application through Mobile Devices. 3. Please compress the documents to the required size. Also ensure that the uploaded documents are CLEAR and READABLE. Finally upload the documents in the requisite format only for successful submission of the application. 4. All applicants must type in their first names and surnames in CAPITAL letters. 5. Only Bhutanese students who are studying in Indian institutions (not already passed out) and NOT in receipt of any Government of India or Royal Government of Bhutan (ICCR, DAHE, RCSC, Ministry of Education and Skills Development Scholarships) are eligible to apply. 6. Successful submission of the application does not imply that the Scholarship will be awarded. 7. The bank account should be in a Bhutanese bank only and in the name of applicant. Bank account in the name of mother, father, brother, sister or any other relatives or friend’s account will NOT be accepted. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Bhutan Citizenship ID card (both front and back side). 2. Passport size Photograph. 3. University ID Card 4. Scanned copy of first page of saving bank account passbook or online login page screenshot in PDF. 5. Marksheet of previous year or last semester (In case of fresh applicants/students) 6. Bonafide Certificate from the University 7. Attested copies of fee slips/receipts. 8. Attested copy of Academic Transcripts (In case of renewal applicants/students) 9. Application Form for Bhutan Ambassador Scholarship for the session 2025-26. ( Refer Annexure – 1) A) In Details of College / Institute option students have to fill the below mentioned details: 1. Are your taking online classes from your college/University: No 2. Name of the University: Lovely Professional University 3. Name and Address of College /Institute: Lovely Professional University Jalandhar Delhi GT Road Phagwara Punjab District Kapurthala 144411. 4. College Id/College Registration No.: (Student Reg. No.) B) Name and Telephone No. of College/ Institute official dealing with foreign students: Name: Mr. Anil Dhawan Designation: Deputy Registrar Mob No.: 8146100818 Landline No.: 01824-444519 E-mail Id of the University official dealing with foreign students – anil.11928@lpu.co.in C) In Education Details option, students have to fill below mentioned details: 1. Name of course for which scholarship sought: Students have to enter course in which he/she is studying. 2. Duration of the course in Years: - Students have to enter full course duration. 3. Date of Joining the Institute: - Students have to enter 01.08._____ (Students have to fill the year of their admission (e.g. if student admitted in 2019, the date of Admission will be 01-08-2019). 4. Year/ Semester in which studying last year: - Students have to select year option from drop down. (i.e. 2024) 5. Year/ Semester in which studying present year: - Students have to select present year option from dropdown.
