title: Registration Open for NASA’s Human Exploration Rover Challenge : LPU/18.4/CAPB(EBGB)/2024/001(1.2)/IC/250828/0001 (8/28/2025)
body: Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. This year, the competition is going to be held in 2 categories: i.Human powered ii.RC controlled No. Of Seats: 20 ( 10 for each team) Eligibility Criteria: Age: 18 or older, Student must be a regular student of Lovely Professional University CGPA: Student must have minimum CGPA of 6.5 (not applicable for freshers students). Passport: Should have a valid passport with at least 2 years of validity considering 30th November as final date of submission of documents. Language Skills: Good proficiency in English communication. The Total Expense for the event which include (Team registration fee, Air fare/ticket (both way), hotel stay, local travel for competition at Alabama- USA. Technical Skills: Expertise in any of the following . Designing- CAD and CAM software Fabrication Coding Robotics and Automation Content writing Video creation, editing and promotion Sponsorship STEM engagement Selection criteria: I. Students will be selected on the basis of eligibility criteria, previous experience, skill set followed by personal interview/interaction through an expert committee. II. After selection, only 20 students will be shortlisted for final participation and representation at USA. Previous Experience: At least 1 year of domain experience in the relevant skill. We encourage all eligible and interested students to take advantage of this incredible opportunity. For more information and to apply, click on the following link: Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/NASA-HERC-LPU . Last Date of Registration: 31st August, 2025 Contact- Mr. Ruhul Choudhury-6284626764 For any further information, please contact us at Department of Student Research and Project, Innovation Studio, Block 39- Room no-111B

The students can register for the R grade by following the below mentioned steps: Step-I- Filling of the Online Registration Form: All students having R grade in the attached list of courses are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via following UMS Path: - UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 1st September 2025 (without any late fee) and 07th September 2025 (with a late fee of Rs.2000/-). The supervisor can recommend the final report/publication proof online from their UMS. The last date to recommend the soft copies of the reports is 09th September 2025. body: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to announce an enriching opportunity for CSE and Computer Application students to participate in the Dubai Global Immersion Program 2025. This 5-day international academic exposure is designed to blend cutting-edge tech learning with practical industry experiences and rich cultural exploration in one of the world’s most dynamic cities — Dubai. As part of the program, students will also get the exclusive chance to engage with international experts during a hands-on AI/ML workshop at local University, known for its innovation and diverse academic community. Accommodation (Twin/Three sharing). Meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner). Transportation to the Airport and Pick up. Round-trip flights from Amritsar/Delhi. Private A/C Transport in Dubai. Student kit. Corporate tech workshop and city tours. AI/ML workshop at local University. Visit to Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Desert Safari, Dubai Frame. Certificate of Participation included. Exclusions: Personal expenses (tips, shopping, minibar, calls, etc.). SIM card/International roaming. Health/travel insurance and incidental costs. Early check-in or late check out charges. title: Clarifications Regarding Academic Schedule, Fractal Mode Implementation, and Related Matters for specific programmes of Computer Science and Engineering. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)(Vol-1)/IC/250825/0127 (8/25/2025)
body: In response to the queries raised by students of the School of Computer Science and Engineering regarding the UMS announcements: “Commencement of Classes for specific programmes of Computer Science and Engineering in Fractal Mode (2nd Year::Term-3)/ (3rd Year::Term-5)”, the following clarifications are being issued. The adoption of the Fractal mode is necessitated by inclement climatic conditions leading to extraordinary heavy rains and widespread waterlogging and floods in nearby regions. This restructuring ensures both student safety and continuity of learning without any disruption. Academic Schedule & Fractal Mode: . The academic term is not reduced in duration; instead, it has been carefully reorganized into two fractals with no compromise on academic quality and content delivery. . Fractal 1 (September 2025): Some courses will be taught in online synchronous learning mode, and you will be fully engaged for the day. Each course will have the complete set of 40–42 lectures, ensuring full academic coverage as per Instruction Plan (IP) . Fractal 2 (October 2025–January 2026): All the remaining courses will be taught in offline mode during this period. These will also be delivered with the full number of lectures, exactly as per the Instruction Plan (IP). . Further, the classes of courses running in Fractal 1 will also be conducted in offline mode during Fractal 2. Students who wish to improve their grade in Fractal 1 courses may attend the offline classes and/or appear for the corresponding offline improvement examination without any additional fee. . To ensure there is absolutely no compromise in academic quality, the term duration has been extended by 15 days. Further, no winter vacation will be given this year so that the complete syllabus is accommodated in time. 2. Choice of Mode of Classes for Fractal 1: . Students have the freedom to attend Fractal 1 classes either online (through synchronous live sessions on My Class) or offline in campus classrooms, as per their choice. . For the students reporting in the university for Fractal 1, the classes will be conducted in the offline mode. Also, the Continuous Assessment (CA) and End Term Exam (ETE) will be conducted in offline mode only. . Those who wish to attend offline must register through the UMS link : UMS Navigation > Examination System > Mode Preference- Fractal 1 online classes . Separate timetables and sectioning will be arranged for online and offline group of students. 3. Mode of Examination: Fractal Mode CA Mid Term End term exam Fractal 1 Online 1 CA-Online Not applicable Online Fractal 1 Offline Offline Not applicable Offline Fractal 2 Offline CAs as per course IP- Offline Offline Offline The question paper pattern for End Term online examinations for Fractal 1 will follow below mentioned pattern: S No. Question Paper pattern Total no. of questions Marks per question Total marks Time allocated per question Total exam time 1 All MCQ 45 1 mark for correct answer, 0.25 negative marking for wrong answer 45 2 minutes 90 minutes 2 All Subjective 5 10 marks per question 50 24 minutes (20 minutes to attempt the question + 4 minutes to upload the photograph of answer sheet) 120 minutes 4. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) a. For students who have applied for RPL in the courses running in Fractal 1: No RPL Provision is applicable. b. For students who have applied for RPL in the courses running in Fractal 2: The RPL examination will be conducted in the offline mode, within first week of the start of fractal 2 classes. 5. Hostel Fee Adjustments . For students availing university residential facilities, one month’s refund is being processed. . Proportionate hostel fee in lieu of Fractal 1 online classes will be also adjusted against the next term fee. . Hence the students will be eligible for total hostel fee refund of 20% which will be adjusted towards fee of next session. The refund shall be made on all types of hostel fee including Mess , gym , laundry etc. 6. First Week attendance Bonus The first week bonus will be applicable for students who have successfully completed the prescribed online certifications. The students should submit their mode preference for attending the Fractal 1 classes at the below mentioned link latest by 26th August 2025 so that the sectioning can be initiated accordingly. Link: UMS Navigation > Examination System > Mode Preference- Fractal 1 online classes The University reaffirms that there will be no compromise in your academic quality. title: Registration Open for NASA’s Human Exploration Rover Challenge : LPU/18.4/CAPB(EBGB)/2024/001(1.2)/IC/250823/0001 (8/23/2025)
body: Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. This year, the competition is going to be held in 2 categories: i.Human powered ii.RC controlled No. Of Seats: 20 ( 10 for each team) Eligibility Criteria: Age: 18 or older, Student must be a regular student of Lovely Professional University CGPA: Student must have minimum CGPA of 6.5 (not applicable for freshers students). Passport: Should have a valid passport with at least 2 years of validity considering 30th November as final date of submission of documents. Language Skills: Good proficiency in English communication. The Total Expense for the event which include (Team registration fee, Air fare/ticket (both way), hotel stay, local travel for competition at Alabama- USA. Technical Skills: Expertise in any of the following . Designing- CAD and CAM software Fabrication Coding Robotics and Automation Content writing Video creation, editing and promotion Sponsorship STEM engagement Selection criteria: I. Students will be selected on the basis of eligibility criteria, previous experience, skill set followed by personal interview/interaction through an expert committee. II. After selection, only 20 students will be shortlisted for final participation and representation at USA. Previous Experience: At least 1 year of domain experience in the relevant skill. We encourage all eligible and interested students to take advantage of this incredible opportunity. For more information and to apply, click on the following link: Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/NASA-HERC-LPU . body: The registration interface for the improvement of Re-appear Examination (September to November 2025), to be conducted in offline mode, is now open. Students with an 'E' grade in any course for all previous term or those wishing to improve their grades in passed courses may register through the following link. UMS Navigation ---> Examination System ---> Exam Registration ---> Re-Appear Registration Students can register for reappear/improvement in the following two modes: Mode Description Fee per course mode Mode A: Without CA improvement Re-appear examination has weightage of MTT+ETE Rs. 500/- Mode B: With CA improvement Re-appear examination has weightage of CA-30 and ETE-70 Rs. 3000/- For more clarity on Mode B, refer to UMS announcement titled “Registration for Re-appear courses with a provision to improve CA component marks. The last date of registration is 1st September 2025. No Re-appear registration shall be allowed after 1st September 2025. body: The Infosys Foundation launched the Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship Program 2025–26 to help female students who want to pursue an undergraduate course in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). For the duration of the STEM course, the scholarship offers full financial support of up to ?1,00,000. This covers living expenses, tuition, and the price of study materials Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/infosys-stem-stars-scholarship The Last date for the scholarship is 15 Sept 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Candidates must be Indian female students. 2. Candidates must have completed Class 12 3. Students must be enrolled in first-year undergraduate courses at reputable (NIRF-accredited) institutions in STEM-related courses. Also, students pursuing second-year B.Arch or five-year Integrated/Dual Degree courses are eligible to apply. 4. Applicants must have an annual family income of less than or equal to ? 8,00,000. Note: Girl students who will be taking admission in engineering and medical courses in government colleges not listed in the NIRF rankings can also apply. Benefits Selected applicants will receive a scholarship of up to ?1,00,000 per year for the duration of the course (For a maximum of four years), covering their actual expenses. Note . The scholarship will cover tuition fees, study materials, and living expenses. . This scholarship commitment is for a maximum of four years of the STEM course. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. A current passport-sized photograph 2. JEE Main/CET/NEET scorecard, and Class 12 marksheet and passing certificates 3. Government-issued ID (such as Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport, Ration Card, etc.) 4. Proof of current year admission (fee receipt, admission letter, institution identity card, or bonafide certificate) 5. Family income proof certificate issued by the appropriate government authority /BPL, or similar card/Ayushman Bharat card 6. Electricity bills for the past 6 months are to be provided as an additional supporting document 7. Receipts of academic-related expenses such as course fees, hostel fees, mess fees, stationery, books, etc. 8. Bank account details of the applicant (bank passbook/cancelled cheque) The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->- Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. body: Dear Aspirants, The Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled the AMCAT SVAR Assessment for all MBA students of the 2027 graduating batch, to be held on 23rd and 24th August. This assessment carries significant importance from a placement perspective. A strong performance will not only boost your confidence but also create valuable career opportunities. We encourage you to take the assessment seriously and approach it with full enthusiasm and commitment. About SVAR: SVAR is an IVR-based Spoken English Test designed to assess Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Comprehension, Grammar, and Vocabulary. title: Registration Open for NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026 : LPU/18.4/CAPB(EBGB)/2024/001(1.2)/IC/250818/0001 (8/18/2025)
body: Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. title: UNESCO Youth Hackathon 2025 : LPU/9.1/PMOU/2024/023/IC/250814/0001 (8/14/2025)
body: UNESCO has launched the 2025 edition of its Youth Hackathon, a central initiative of Global Media and Information Literacy (MIL) Week, aimed at empowering young people to address pressing challenges in today’s complex digital information ecosystem. The Hackathon provides a platform for youth to design and present innovative solutions that promote media and information literacy, digital rights, and civic engagement. Participants will be guided through a mentoring program and invited to co-create practical, youth-led responses to issues such as AI ethics, disinformation, online hate speech, platform monopolies, and threats to information integrity. Eligibility: 1. Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years of age at the time of registration. 2. Participate either individually or as part of a team (teams may include up to five members). 3. Demonstrate an interest in media literacy, digital ethics, information access, civic technology, or related fields. Participants will follow a structured process: 1. Registration: Applicants must complete an online registration form with accurate team or individual details. 2. Mentoring Phase: All registered participants will receive access to a free online mentoring program in August 2025, conducted by international experts in digital media, technology, education, and civic engagement. 3. Proposal Submission: Final project proposals must be submitted by the designated deadline. Submissions will be evaluated by an international jury on criteria such as originality, feasibility, impact, and alignment with the theme. Final Selection: Winning teams will be invited to showcase their projects at the Global MIL Week Conference in Cartagena, Colombia, on 23–24 October 2025. UNESCO will cover travel and accommodation expenses for the selected teams. UNESCO encourages solutions that are: Innovative: Combining new approaches or technologies to solve persistent MIL challenges. Scalable and Sustainable: Designed for replication or adaptation in other contexts or communities. Community-Driven: Centered around local needs and involving diverse stakeholder input. Ethically Sound: Aligned with human rights, freedom of expression, and digital inclusion. Examples might include mobile apps, toolkits, educational games, media campaigns, policy frameworks, or digital platforms that improve access to reliable information, counter disinformation, promote fact-checking, or enhance civic engagement through media literacy. How to Register Interested individuals or teams must submit their registration via UNESCO’s designated online portal. All team members must be listed at the time of registration to qualify for the mentoring phase. Link: https://www.unesco.org/en/weeks/media-information-literacy/youth-hackathon-2025 For any clarification and discussion, you can contact Prof. Rahul Saha, Coordinator, AI-CoE, Research and Development Cell, Block 38, Room 207, Cabin 03.

Other students are encouraged to draw inspiration from their efforts and actively contribute their skills towards expanding their academic horizons beyond the classroom. The LPU Live is now officially active and available for use with new features and enhanced safety and security. You can access the platform through the following link: https://lpulive.lpu.in. LPU Live is the university’s official communication platform designed to support both academic and personal interaction among students and faculty in an organized and secure manner. Some of the noteworthy features of the revamped LPU LIVE platform is: . Chat and Connect: Join university groups, create your own personal groups, and initiate one-on-one chat with others. . Share Easily: Send messages, share documents, assignments, and images directly in chats. . Smart Reply Options: Choose between public replies (visible to all) and private replies (visible only to the intended person). . Safe and Secure: LPU Live automatically blocks inappropriate content. Your profile picture stays hidden for privacy. . Coding Made Easy: Use the built-in code editor to write, run, practice and share code in various programming languages. . Find Files Fast: All shared files are stored in one place within each group for quick access. . Use Anytime, anywhere: Accessible on both desktop and mobile browsers with real-time sync across devices. Quick Help Available: For any queries or issues, use the Bug Report feature available within the platform. To help you understand how to use LPU Live, a detailed user guide is attached with this announcement. Additionally, you can also watch the detailed video regarding usage of LPU LIVE through the link provided below- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5wR-yb3XLsQ Access LPU Live today to start connecting with your academic community. Students are also advised to regularly check UMS Announcements and My Messages for the latest updates. Note: Ensure that you keep your password strictly confidential. This is the first phase of the LPU Live launch, and more features will be integrated in due course.

title: LPU Signs MoU with Saint Petersburg State University, Russia : LPU/11.2/IRC(SPSU)/2025/003(3.11)/IC/250808/0001 (8/8/2025)
body: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the Saint Petersburg State University (SPbU), Russia. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Founded in 1724 and based in St. Petersburg, Russia, SPbU is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Eastern Europe. It consistently ranks among Russia’s top institutions and is recognized globally for its rigorous academic environment and strong research output. Ranked #375 in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the university is especially known for excellence in mathematics, physics, international relations, political science, and linguistics, and has produced a number of Nobel laureates, presidents, and prominent scholars over its long history. If you're interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with the Saint Petersburg State University, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration!

title: Celebrating NPTEL MOOC Achievements of our students – Academic Equivalence & Performance Badges (Session 24252). : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)(Vol-1)/IC/250806/0081 (8/6/2025)
body: Through the NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning), online courses (MOOCs) the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, recognizes students across the country for their academic excellence through certified MOOCs and distinguished Gold, Silver and Elite badges. These honors not only validate subject mastery but also enhance students’ academic and professional profiles. Performance Badges Awarded by NPTEL: 1. Gold Badge – Awarded to students who scored 90% and above, reflecting exceptional academic excellence. 2. Silver Badge – Awarded to students with a score of 75% to 89%, reflecting strong academic performance. 3. Elite Badge – Awarded to students who scored 60% and above, signifying noteworthy course completion with distinction. We are delighted to announce that several students of our university have successfully completed NPTEL MOOCs mapped to our curriculum under the Academic Equivalence Framework, and have been granted corresponding academic benefits. Heartfelt congratulations to all the achievers! The attached document contains the list of all our achievers. This achievement is a testament to your dedication and pursuit of academic excellence through self-paced learning. We encourage other students to explore the vast learning opportunities offered by NPTEL MOOCs and strive for similar accomplishments. For any further clarifications regarding the evaluation or award process, students may visit the Query and Assistance Zone located at Block 27-102A. Students may also reach out through RMS as per the path specified below: UMS---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Log Request . Select Department: Academics . Category: Academics . Subcategory: MOOCs In case students who have successfully completed MOOC courses offered through NPTEL/SWAYAM but have not yet submitted the course details are requested to submit the completed MOOC certifications latest by 10 August 2025 at Feedback.daa@lpu.co.in. Further, students intending to enroll in NPTEL MOOCs for the upcoming academic term are advised to take note of the course registration deadlines and complete their registration through UMS > LMS > MOOC Certification by 18th August 2025. (Details of the course and course mapping for above MOOC certifications has been provided in the attachment) We commend your efforts in taking proactive steps toward academic growth and wish you continued success in all future endeavors.

body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. This program is designed to empower emerging Indian artists and collectives by supporting innovative and socially impactful art projects. Interested students from disciplines such as Fine Arts, Performing Arts, Design, Media, Photography, Literature, Fashion and allied fields are highly encouraged to apply. What is Art for Hope? “Art for Hope” is a corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiative that provides financial support and professional mentorship to young artists and creators from across India. The aim is to foster a culture of creativity and change, where art is used as a tool to inspire hope, raise awareness, and bring communities together. This year’s edition is focused on community-based art, encouraging projects that engage with social, cultural, or environmental themes. Selected applicants will get to bring their ideas to life and contribute meaningfully to society through art. Who can apply? Visual artists, performing artists, craft practitioners, digital creators, photographers, and other creatives · Applicants must be 18 years or older as of the application date. Open to both individual artists and collectives What Will You Receive? Financial grant of Rs 1,00,000 (individual). Mentorship and guidance from industry experts and curators. Recognition and visibility through public art engagement and national-level platforms Application Deadline: August 31, 2025 Application is FREE of COST Apply at: https://hyundaiartforhope.com For More details: https://hyundaiartforhope.com/faqs For details of all the terms and conditions: https://hyundaiartforhope.com/terms_conditions Please fill the mandatory Google form along with the main application: https://forms.gle/EUVXP8MWiJEw9XUi9 IMPORTANT NOTE: All selected grantees will be required to sign a letter of intent with Hyundai Motor India Foundation. In addition, they will be required to attend the capacity building sessions which will be held during the tenure of the grant. In-person participation to the exhibition and felicitation ceremony at the program closure is mandatory. Don't miss this chance to take your creative vision to a national platform and receive professional support for your projects! For any assistance or information, please drop your queries at ankita.kararia@lpu.co.in

title: Destination Dr. Reddy's 2.0 - Management Track : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250801/0001 (8/1/2025)
body: Destination Dr. Reddy's 2.0 - Management Track invites first-year MBA students to solve real-world business problems from the pharma industry, focusing on impactful, patient-first solutions. This challenge not only offers a chance to work on life-changing problems but also provides recognition, mentorship, and career opportunities for the top performers. If you’re ready to make a difference and revolutionize healthcare, register now to take the first step towards a transformative career with Dr. Reddy's. Eligibility Criteria :- 1st-year full-time (2 years) flagship MBA students across all B-Schools from HR, Finance, Marketing and Operations Specialisation. All team members must have scored a minimum of 75% marks in class X and class XII and scored a minimum of 60% marks in graduation. All students must participate with the right spirit. Each participating team must consist of 3 members. One person can be part of only one team. Changing team members will not be allowed after the Registration Deadline. MBA students can choose from three domains with below team composition. HR (All the members should be from HR specialization) Finance (All the members should be from Finance specialization) Marketing and Operations (Recommend a team comprising mix of members from Marketing and Operations specialization) Any deviation from the above-mentioned guidelines will result in the immediate disqualification of the entire team. Last Date to Register:-16-Aug-25 - 11:59 PM Rewards:- All winners will be offered PPIs for an internship with Dr. Reddy’s which can convert to a PPO to join the flagship, Dr. Reddy’s Young Leaders Program. Members of all the Teams shortlisted for Round 3 stand a chance to grab PPIs for Internships with Dr. Reddy’s. All finalists will receive some cool, sustainable goodies from Dr. Reddy’s. title: Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250730/0001 (7/30/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon:The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. title: Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250729/0002 (7/29/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon:The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co

title: Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250726/0001 (7/26/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon: The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co

title: Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250724/0001 (7/24/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years.The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon: The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co

title: Speak Up 4.0: A workshop on Mastering the Art of Group Discussions : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250723/0003 (7/23/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Speak Up 4.0: A workshop on Mastering the Art of Group Discussions.” The event focuses on eliminating the fear of public speaking and fostering platform skills that enhance interpersonal abilities such as communication, critical thinking, public speaking, problem-solving, and more. The event will bring together participants from different backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints, and will ultimately help students for articulation of thoughts. The core objective of this workshop will be to encourage student participation and assist them in conquering their fear of speaking in public. title: Pitch Fest @ LPU : Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250723/0001 (7/23/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon: The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co

title: Instructions for Summer Term (SAS) : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-4)/IC/250722/0074 (7/22/2025)
body: This is in reference to the Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from August 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for the summer term classes in May-June 2025 and have successfully completed their attendance criteria are required to appear for Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is as follows: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation: All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars who can register for summer term SAS evaluation with subject to eligibility criteria) are required to register for summer term SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics - Research & Development Registration of Upcoming Activity SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 22nd July 2025 to 29th July 2025. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis: All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the attached guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics Research & Development- Registration of Upcoming Activity Submit SAS synopsis All the research scholars are required to completely register for SAS evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the synopsis followed by the verification of synopsis by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 22nd July 2025 to 29th July 2025. 3. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation Division of Examination Department of Ph.D. Evaluation Ph.D. Seminar File Verification SAS. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the SAS synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 31st July 2025. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 29th July 2025, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS. d) If a research scholar registers for the summer term SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from Dec 2025 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. e) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of SAS synopsis will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of SAS synopsis, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of SAS synopsis. i) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. j) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. k) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI &VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: Student Services --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation (Summer Term only). : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-4)/IC/250721/0086 (7/21/2025)
body: This is in reference to the Summer Term Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from August 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for the summer term classes in May-June 2025 and have successfully completed their attendance criteria are required to appear for Summer Term Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of Scholars who can register for summer term evaluation with subject to eligibility criteria) are required to register for summer term ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: Academic services ---> Research and Development --> Registration of Upcoming Activity --> ETP Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 22nd July 2025 to 29th July 2025. 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the attached guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academic services ---> Research and Development --> Registration of Upcoming Activity ---> Click to Submit report All the research scholars are required to completely register for ETP evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the file followed by the verification of file by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 22nd July 2025 to 29th July 2025. 3. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --->ETP If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 31st July 2025. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The scholars must attach all the previous results (SAS, SAS ATR and ETP evaluations) at the end of ETP report. d) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. e) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of ETP report, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of ETP report. f) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. g) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. h) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". i) In case the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation and he/she does not appear for the same, then he/ she will be marked absent and the result shall stand as 'Unsatisfactory' j) The ETP evaluation will be scheduled in offline mode only. Thus, if the scholar fails to appear in the offline mode, he/she will be considered as absent and the result will be declared as “Unsatisfactory”. No request for online mode will be entertained. k) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI &VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). l) A scholar must have at least one mandatory research publication communicated in Scopus-indexed journals to be eligible to appear in ETP3 evaluation and accepted/published to appear in ETP4 and onward evaluations. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear for the ETP presentation in front of the Research Advisory Committee rather, the case will be forwarded to the Research Mentorship Committee for evaluation of the progress for which a separate schedule will be shared with the scholars. m) In case the scholar has communicated/accepted/published a research/review article, the scholar is required to select the log request ID while registering for ETP evaluation. A log request can be generated through the supervisor’s UMS via following path: Academic Services-------Research and Development Cell--------Research and academic contributions------------Monthly status of research achievements/log request For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1.The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1.For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: Student Services --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) -->Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor submit RMS by following the path: Student Services --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes)

title: MANDATORY ONLINE CERTIFICATION FOR CONTINUOUS UPSKILLING FOR SELECTED PROGRAMMES OF SCHOOL OF COMPUTER SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING: : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/250719/0114 (7/19/2025)
body: In today’s competitive landscape, certifications play a vital role in upskilling and enhancing employability by adding significant value to a student's CV. To help students stay ahead in their academic and career journey, certain programmes under the School of Computer Science and Engineering, as listed in Annexure-1, have been identified for a mandatory 20 days online certification at the beginning of Autumn Term 2025-26. This certification aims to build a strong conceptual foundation and broaden students’ understanding of key foundational concepts. Some key points of information related to the certification are given below: i. The certification will be conducted entirely in online mode during the initial 20 days of the term. These concepts will be further reinforced through offline teaching when the students report physically to campus for continuation of regular Autumn Term classes (1st Sept. 2025 onwards). ii. The students will follow the below mentioned timelines for Autumn Term 2025-26: Activity Schedule Start Date of Autumn Term 2025-26 11 Aug 2025 Online Certification start date 11 Aug 2025 Online Certification End date 31 Aug 2025 Travel Days for reporting physically to the University 28 Aug- 31 Aug 2025 Start of offline classes in University 1st Sept. 2025 onwards iii. This online certification has to be completed by the students from their home. In case any student wants to pursue the certification in the University labs then he/she needs to register on the link mentioned below latest by 25th July 2025. Link: UMS Dashboard--- Academics --- Examination System ---- Hostel Fee Adjustment Request iv. Students who have registered for University residential facilities and opt to complete the certification from their home will receive a proportionate adjustment of hostel fees (equivalent to 1 month i.e. to the tune of 10% of the hostel fee submitted for current session), into their fee account which will be ultimately adjusted towards the fee of next session. v. The eligible students may apply for adjustment of the hostel fee through the link mentioned below latest by 25th July 2025. Link: UMS Dashboard--- Academics --- Examination System ---- Hostel Fee Adjustment Request vi. Guidelines for pursuing online certification: a. The online certification course will be offered on the Infosys Springboard platform which aims to enable students and associated communities from early education to lifelong learners by imparting digital and life skills through curated content & interventions. b. The online certification course will be provided free of cost to the students. c. The students will be required to login the Infosys Springboard platform using the University e-mail Id (ending with @lpu.in). Login credentials including username and password will be shared with students via “UMS My Messages” latest by 24 July 2025. d. Upon successful completion and submission of the certificate to the University, students will receive the following academic benefits. I. Attendance credit will be given for the first 20 days of Autumn Term 2025–26. II. The certification will be equated with one Continuous Assessment for one course registered in Autumn Term 2025–26. III. If a student wishes to avail benefit of Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) under Edu-Revolution, then the students can apply for the RPL Exam. If the students earn B+ or above grade in the examination will be offered full course exemption for a course registered to him/her in Autumn Term 2025-26. IV. Details of the courses in which the student can earn the above stated academic benefits has also been mentioned in Annexure 1. Note: The hostel fee adjustment will be initiated in student’s account only after clearance of complete hostel dues by the student. Hence to ensure timely fee adjustment the students are advised to clear their pending hostel fee latest by 31st July 2025. For students registered in all other programmes (except those listed in Annexure-1), the classes of Autumn Term 2025-26 shall commence in the University as per the dates already mentioned in the Academic Calendar. The students should ensure their travel arrangements accordingly. For any query students can contact at 01824-520150 or submit an RMS through the link: UMS Navigation -- Relationship Management System -- Log Request – Student Relationship (DSR) --- Online Certification for CSE---- Online Certification for CSE

title: Habit Reengineering Through Science and Meditation. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/250718/0072 (7/18/2025)
body: There are some habits we deeply wish to break—and others we genuinely want to build. Yet, despite repeated efforts, we often find ourselves stuck in the same loop, unable to make lasting change. Why does this happen? What keeps us from changing, even when we want to?This workshop will help you uncover the science behind habits and explore meditation practices. You’ll learn to take control, break old patterns and create the lasting change you've been aiming for. In 5 Days, You Will Learn: . Understand how habits are formed—and why they’re hard to break . Identify and interrupt your personal habit loops . Use meditation to enhance self-awareness and long-term habit transformation . Learn simple brain-based strategies like neuroplasticity and dopamine triggers to replace unhelpful habits . Build a step-by-step action plan to create new, lasting habits . Explore daily meditation practices to stay consistent and motivated over time COURSE DETAILS: . Duration: 5 Days (21st - 25th July 2025) . Time: 5:15 PM- 6:15 PM . Venue: Rajyoga Thought Lab, Block 8, Room No. 201 . Registration Link: https://forms.gle/EVdiaHDuFTJHUdMV7 For further information, please contact on 01824-444018 This course is offered free of charge by Department of Counseling and Happiness under the aegis of Division of Student Relationship.

title: Pitch Fest @ LPU : Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250709/0001 (7/9/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defense to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defense Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon: The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 14.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co

title: Registration for Special Chance Re-Examination – July 2025. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-4)/IC/250707/0110 (7/7/2025)
body: The interface for registration of the special chance re-examination scheduled for July 2025 has been opened. Students who have been awarded an “I” grade in Spring Term 2024-25 or who have previously been informed via UMS My Messages about their eligibility for this special chance are permitted to apply. This opportunity is being provided to students without any additional fee; however, registration in the online interface is mandatory. Students who do not register will not be allowed to appear for the examination. If you fail to appear in the special chance exam due to incomplete pre-requisites arrangements or are found using unfair means, no additional chance will be given further, and an ‘E’ grade will be awarded in the concerned courses. Students who do not wish to take this special chance re-examination in the online mode may choose to appear in offline mode at the University Campus either in July 2025 or upon their return to campus in the Autumn Term 2025–26 (august 2025 onwards). At the time of registration, it is mandatory for students to select the mode and schedule in which they wish to take the re-examination. (For students choosing to appear in the Autumn Term 2025–26, registration is still mandatory). Registration link: UMS Navigation → Examination System → Exam Registration → Re-Appear Registration The last date for registration is 14th July 2025; no registrations will be entertained thereafter. Important points for reference: 1. The re-examination will be conducted in online mode on the LPU MyClass platform tentatively starting from 3rd week of July 2025. 2. The latest syllabus of the respective course will be applicable for all registered students. 3. The date sheet will be displayed to registered students in due course. Before appearing for these online examinations, please ensure: . You have all pre-requisites ready (laptop/desktop, stable internet, functional camera and microphone). . You have watched below-mentioned videos carefully to understand the online exam process. . Your device does not have malicious software, blacklisted applications, or virtual machines (see list mentioned below). For any lecture that falls during the examination time slot, duty leave will be provided for those lectures only. Additionally, duty leave will also be granted for classes scheduled one hour before and one hour after the examination time. Note: For any further query, students can also log RMS via the following UMS path: - UMS Navigation --- Relationship Management System (RMS) ---- Log Request ----- Examination---- Reappear Registration / Re-evaluation / Scrutiny It is reiterated that in case you don’t have proper pre-requisites for online examination then you should appear for re-examination in the offline mode as no extra chance shall be given after this. Important Links: . Video on how to attempt exam: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5adgUnKEQzO1ZK1rIB_cy0pVQ5YlVF7q . How to install SEA: https://youtu.be/twZ1x8HkFS4 . Unpermitted software and applications list: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KLmiKS6j_byXFvN8tmg1AiO4K7CFitEH/view?usp=drive_link The detailed procedure for registration is attached for reference.

title: Golden opportunity for availing the Teaching Assistant (TA) position for academic term (Aug-Dec 2025) for the full-time Ph.D. research scholars. : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/250707/0094 (7/7/2025)
body: In line with the university’s commitment to fostering academic excellence and enhancing teaching-learning experiences, Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) invites the applications from the full-time Ph.D. scholars for the position of Teaching Assistant (TA) for academic term (Aug-Dec 2025). This opportunity aims to provide valuable teaching exposure to research scholars while supporting academic activities of the University. Selected scholars will be allocated a weekly teaching load of 6-10 hours and attractive monthly remuneration of Rs. 21,600/- . The recruitment process will be as per the HR rules and regulations. Eligibility Criteria: a) The scholar must be enrolled in Ph.D. programme in full-time mode. b) The scholars must have completed coursework for applying for teaching assistantship positions. c) The scholar’s research area or academic background must align with the subject/course they are expected to teach. d) Strong proficiency in English and effective communication skills are essential. How to Apply? All the interested full-time Ph.D. scholars are advised to fill the Google form through https://forms.gle/o31KEaus9p4gpwgTA with updated CV by 9th July 2025. For any further queries, contact Dr. Sandeep Kumar/Dr.Vishal Narula, CRDP, Block 38, Room-202 or raise RMS by using the following path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request---> Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] -- > Category [Centre for Research Degree Programmes] -- > Sub Category [PhD. title: Udaan- A Workshop on Defence Exams (7/7/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Udaan- A Workshop on Defence Exams”. This intensive workshop is designed to guide and prepare students for various defence entrance exams such as CDS & AFCAT with a strong focus on developing the right strategy, skillset, and mindset required for success. The workshop will provide a structured learning environment where students can build core competencies in Aptitude, Reasoning, General Awareness, and English, which are crucial for cracking defence exams. In addition to academic preparation, the workshop will also focus on personality development and officer-like qualities (OLQs) essential for SSB interviews. Other equally important abilities that will be covered are how to communicate effectively, maintain composure under pressure, and be confident. The main objectives of the event are: To Familiarize Students with Exam Patterns and Syllabus. To build up brain-stimulating exercise which improves cognitive abilities and reasoning skills. To Develop Strategic Problem-Solving Skills. Target audience: The students of all the Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 8th July, 2025 Time: 11:00 AM Onwards Venue: Online Resource Person: Mr. Inderjeet Singh Head Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: Voices from the Page: A Workshop on Tone and Delivery (7/7/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to organize a workshop “Voices from the Page: A Workshop on Tone and Delivery”. In this workshop, there will be an interactive reading-aloud activity where students bring written texts to life using their voice. Participants will be given powerful excerpts from literature, speeches, workplace scenarios, or TED Talks. Each student or group will be asked to read a passage aloud, focusing on tone, emotion, and clarity of delivery. The main objectives of the event are: To enhance vocal expression and reading fluency by practicing tone, pace, and emphasis while reading aloud. To build confidence in public speaking through controlled reading of powerful excerpts. To develop awareness of tone and emotion in communication. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 8th July, 2025 Time: 12:00 Noon Onwards Venue: Block 38-909 Resource Person: Ms. Resham Gupta Head Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250703/0002 (7/3/2025)
body: About the Program: The HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India 2025 program extends financial assistance to female engineering students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, facilitating their pursuit of education. This program offers financial support to female students nationwide who are enrolled in their first year of engineering studies, with preference given to students with disabilities (PwD) who belong to economically weaker sections of society and need financial assistance to pursue their education. They can receive financial aid worth Rs 50,000 to support their academic endeavours and nurture their potential as future leaders in engineering. Eligibility for Applicants: Open to female students across India enrolled in the first year of an engineering program at any state or UGC-recognised college. Preference will be given to students with disabilities. Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in Class 12 (Science stream) in the academic year 2024–25. For PWD applicants, the minimum required marks are 40% in Class 12 (Science stream). Preference will be given to students pursuing the following engineering branches: Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering . The family income of the applicant should not exceed Rs 5,00,000 annually. Children of employees of Schaeffler India or Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for this scholarship. Last Date of Registration: 30-July-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Rs 50,000. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/hope-engineering-scholarship-by-schaeffler-india Link 2 : https://forms.gle/84XAa2hTpo2AmDcu7 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. Opportunity to receive mentorship from 35 Schaeffler India employees for 6 months, enabling selected scholars to learn from their valuable experience. In case of a query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.
