title: IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship 2025-27 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250703/0001 (7/3/2025)
body: About the Program: The IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship is a need-based scholarship program by IDFC FIRST Bank that financially supports students with family incomes of less than Rs 6 lakh per annum. The purpose of this scholarship is to make postgraduate studies in business management accessible to meritorious students who are unable to pursue higher studies due to financial constraints. Under this scholarship, students enrolled in the first year of a two-year full-time MBA course in the academic session 2025-27 will receive Rs 2 lakh for two years of their MBA program (Rs 1 lakh/year). Eligibility for Applicants: Open to Indian nationals residing in India only. Students must be enrolled in the first year of a 2-year full-time MBA program or its equivalent for the class of 2025. The gross annual family income from all sources should be less than or equal to INR 6 lakh. Applicants must have a valid mobile number linked to their Aadhaar number. Last Date of Registration: 20-July-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: The selected MBA students will be awarded a scholarship sum of Rs 2,00,000 for two years of full-time MBA studies (Rs 1 lakh per annum, subject to terms and conditions). Under this scholarship, students currently studying in the first year of BBA, B.Com., B.A. (Economics), or any other finance-related degree courses stand a chance to receive financial assistance of up to Rs 5,50,000 per year for three years to complete their education. Eligibility for Applicants: Students enrolled in the BBA, B.Com., B.A. (Economics), or any other finance-related degree courses are eligible. Applicants must have secured at least 80% marks in Classes 10 and 12 (For PwD students, the minimum percentage required is 70% marks). The annual family income of the applicants should be less than Rs 6 lakh. Open for Indian nationals only. The children of employees/contract employees of Hero FinCorp, Raman Kant Munjal Foundation, and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Last Date of Registration: 31-July-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Scholarships ranging from Rs 40,000 to Rs 5,50,000 per year will be awarded to each scholar for three years to complete their education. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/raman-kant-munjal-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/ZwiUGGurcecy1RRL7 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program 2025-2026 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250626/0002 (6/26/2025)
body: About the Program: The Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program, an initiative of Bharti Airtel Foundation, aims to support deserving students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds, with a focus on girl students, to become future technology leaders. This merit-cum-means-based scholarship program has been designed for deserving students enrolled in technology based engineering undergraduate and 5 year integrated courses. This fully funded scholarship aims to remove financial barriers that prevent deserving students from accessing quality education. It covers 100% annual fees, including meal and accommodation charges. Additionally, all Bharti Scholars are provided a laptop in their first year to aid in their academic journey. Eligibility for Applicants: Confirmed admission or enrollment in the first year (academic year 2025-2026) of the undergraduate/5 year integrated courses in fields of Electronics & Communication, Telecom, Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Data Sciences, Aerospace and Emerging Technologies (AI, IoT, AR/VR, Machine Learning, Robotics). Must be a citizen and resident of India.Parents’/guardians’ annual income from all sources should not exceed Rs 8.5 lakhs. Preference shall be given to students who are girls, persons with disabilities, have single /no parents and transgender. Applicants should not be recipients of any other scholarships/ grants for the same purposes as being supported by the Bharti Airtel Foundation. Last Date of Registration: 31st July 25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Scholarship covers 100% of annual fees as per the course fee structure of the respective university/institute. Scholarships are for the full duration of the UG courses, including integrated courses for up to 5 years (subject to meeting the renewal criteria as detailed in subsequent FAQ section). The hostel and mess fees shall be given to all eligible students who apply for it. For students staying in PG/outside hostel, the funds will be released as per the hostel/mess charges of the university/institute (whichever is less). A laptop will be provided to all Bharti Scholars during the first year of the course. (Responsibility for the safety/security of the laptop will be with the student. No replacements will be provided.) Upon successful graduation and subsequent gainful employment, Bharti Scholars will undertake to voluntarily support at least one student at the school or college level on a continuous basis. This commitment aims to foster a culture of giving back, ensuring the continued empowerment of future generations through education with the community. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/bharti-airtel-scholarship Link 2 : https://forms.gle/3VW3sxiXnwhvFyDq8 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250626/0001 (6/26/2025)
body: About the Program: The Kotak Kanya Scholarship, an initiative by the Kotak Mahindra Group and Kotak Education Foundation, aims to empower meritorious girls from low-income families by supporting their pursuit of professional higher education after Class 12. In 2025, eligible students planning to pursue courses like Engineering, Design, Architecture, and similar fields at reputed institutes (accredited by NAAC/NIRF) will receive a scholarship of Rs 1.5 lakh per year to cover their educational expenses until they complete their degree. Eligibility for Applicants: Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than Rs 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2025-26 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering and professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26. Last of Registration: 31-Aug-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: A scholarship amount of Rs 1.5 lakh per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Link 2 : https://forms.gle/XCJpWoGwXaCZzgV89 In case of a query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

body: The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET) invites undergraduate engineering students across India to apply for the IET India Scholarship Award 2025 — one of the country's most prestigious scholarship programmes for future engineering leaders. This prestigious award aims to recognize and support the brightest engineering minds in India. Eligibility: All 1st to 4th- year undergraduate engineering students from all programs of Engineering of Lovely Professional University are eligible to apply. Selection Process (4 Stages): 1. Step 1: students shall be evaluated and shortlisted based on number of criteria performance and participation in extracurricular activities. 2. Step 2: Online Test - to test technical knowledge of core engineering subjects science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) 3. Step 3: Regional Rounds Students who score above the minimum required marks shall be then invited to the regional rounds where they get to innovate and present their unique technological solution to a pertinent societal challenge that impacts their region. 4. Step 4: National Finals Regional winners finally battle it out in the national finals to win the IET India Scholarship Award. The winner gets to participate in a series of IET-organised activities centred around sharing knowledge, encouraging new ideas and innovative collaboration with expert engineers and technologists. To be held in Bengaluru, September 2025 Prize Structure Regional Rounds: . Winner: ?60,000 + Trophy + Certificate + 1-Year IET Membership . title: Final Onboarding Call - LPU Summer School 2025 : LPU/18.1/STEV(COSE)/2024/003(3.1)/IC/250613/0002 (6/13/2025)
body: Final Onboarding Call - LPU Summer School 2025 The Student Welfare Wing is pleased to announce LPU Summer School 2025, a dynamic and experiential learning initiative curated for students of Grades 6 to 12, including wards of LPU faculty members. Dates: 16th June to 27th June 2025 Venue: Lovely Professional University Campus This two-week residential/non-residential program is designed to promote creativity, confidence, and real-world learning through an engaging mix of academic, technical, cultural, and sports-based sessions. title: LPU Global: Last call for applications under the credit transfer (2+2) option for Jan 2026 intake : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/250612/0002 (6/12/2025)
body: The Division of International Affairs brings an exciting opportunity for students to earn an international degree through LPU’s Credit Transfer Program. Under this program, students begin their academic journey at LPU, upon successful completion of the initial phase, transfer to one of our esteemed partner universities in countries such as the U.K., USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Latvia, Lithuania, or France. This unique program lets you experience the best of both worlds — students will study the initial part of their degree at LPU and transfer to a foreign university to complete the remaining coursework — ultimately earning a degree from the international partner university. Why Choose the Credit Transfer Program? Cost-Effective: Save up to 40% on tuition fees by studying just 2 years abroad instead of 4. Global Exposure: Immerse yourself in international academic and cultural experiences. Support Your Stay: Cover your living expenses through part-time jobs. title: Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program 2025-2026 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250605/0001 (6/5/2025)
body: About the Program: The Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program, an initiative of Bharti Airtel Foundation, aims to support deserving students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds, with a focus on girl students, to become future technology leaders. This merit-cum-means-based scholarship program has been designed for deserving students enrolled in technology based engineering undergraduate and 5 year integrated courses. This fully funded scholarship aims to remove financial barriers that prevent deserving students from accessing quality education. It covers 100% annual fees, including meal and accommodation charges. Additionally, all Bharti Scholars are provided a laptop in their first year to aid in their academic journey. Eligibility for Applicants: Confirmed admission or enrollment in the first year (academic year 2025-2026) of the undergraduate/5 year integrated courses in fields of Electronics & Communication, Telecom, Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Data Sciences, Aerospace and Emerging Technologies (AI, IoT, AR/VR, Machine Learning, Robotics). Must be a citizen and resident of India. Parents’/guardians’ annual income from all sources should not exceed Rs 8.5 lakhs. Preference shall be given to students who are girls, persons with disabilities, have single /no parents and transgender. Applicants should not be recipients of any other scholarships/ grants for the same purposes as being supported by the Bharti Airtel Foundation. Last of Registration: 31st July 25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Scholarship covers 100% of annual fees as per the course fee structure of the respective university/institute. Scholarships are for the full duration of the UG courses, including integrated courses for up to 5 years (subject to meeting the renewal criteria as detailed in subsequent FAQ section). The hostel and mess fees shall be given to all eligible students who apply for it. For students staying in PG/outside hostel, the funds will be released as per the hostel/mess charges of the university/institute (whichever is less). A laptop will be provided to all Bharti Scholars during the first year of the course. (Responsibility for the safety/security of the laptop will be with the student. No replacements will be provided.) Upon successful graduation and subsequent gainful employment, Bharti Scholars will undertake to voluntarily support at least one student at the school or college level on a continuous basis. This commitment aims to foster a culture of giving back, ensuring the continued empowerment of future generations through education with the community. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/bharti-airtel-scholarship Link 2 : https://forms.gle/3VW3sxiXnwhvFyDq8 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. title: IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship 2025-27 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250602/0001 (6/2/2025)
body: About the Program: The IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship is a need-based scholarship program by IDFC FIRST Bank that financially supports students with family incomes of less than Rs 6 lakh per annum. The purpose of this scholarship is to make postgraduate studies in business management accessible to meritorious students who are unable to pursue higher studies due to financial constraints. Under this scholarship, students enrolled in the first year of a two-year full-time MBA course in the academic session 2025-27 will receive Rs 2 lakh for two years of their MBA program (Rs 1 lakh/year). Eligibility for Applicants: Open to Indian nationals residing in India only. Students must be enrolled in the first year of a 2-year full-time MBA program or its equivalent for the class of 2025. The gross annual family income from all sources should be less than or equal to INR 6 lakh. Applicants must have a valid mobile number linked to their Aadhaar number. Last of Registration: 30-June-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: The selected MBA students will be awarded a scholarship sum of Rs 2,00,000 for two years of full-time MBA studies (Rs 1 lakh per annum, subject to terms and conditions). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/idfc-first-bank-mba-scholarship Link 2 : https://forms.gle/NEmWSeBxdxZhNQxL6 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: LPU Global – National Theatre Screening of Small Island : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/250530/0001 (5/30/2025)
body: LPU Global – National Theatre Screening of Small Island The Division of International Affairs is pleased to announce a special opportunity for students to attend the National Theatre (UK) screening of Small Island, hosted by the British Deputy High Commission in collaboration with Alliance Française. This acclaimed adaptation of Andrea Levy’s award-winning Windrush novel brings to life the powerful and moving stories of three individuals navigating the journey from Jamaica to Britain, against the backdrop of World War II and the post-war immigration wave of 1948. “A spectacular adaptation of Andrea Levy’s Windrush novel” – The Observer The play follows: Hortense, who dreams of a better life in Britain Gilbert, with ambitions of becoming a lawyer Queenie, seeking freedom from her rural English life Their interwoven stories explore themes of hope, identity, and colonial legacy, brought to the stage by a cast of 40 actors on the Olivier Stage of the National Theatre Event Details: Venue: Alliance Française, Sector 36, Chandigarh Date: Friday, 6 June 2025 Time: 10:15 AM Duration: 3 hours 20 minutes (including a 20-minute interval) Limited seats available – 10 participants on a first-come, first-served basis. Interested students must submit their names by 12:00 PM on Tuesday, 2 June 2025 Register here: https://forms.gle/DuBvLydVkzRfN9bG7 For more information, please contact: Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310) Mobile: +91 7986997720 Email: study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Important information related to Community Development Project (CDP) (Autumn Term-25261). : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-4)/IC/250530/0002 (5/30/2025)
body: Community Development Project aims toward understanding the society related issues/problems and then working towards the solutions to these problems for betterment of the society. Thus, community development project is included as a core course in the curriculum of the students. All students who are required to undergo a community development project (CDP) during June-July 2025 as per their program scheme (tentative list of students is attached as Annexure I) are hereby informed that the students can complete their CDP by choosing any NGO/local organizations involved in community development tasks allowing physical reporting so that student can work on real time problems existing in the society. Important Points: 1. Minimum duration required to complete the community development project should be at least 30 hours or at least 4 weeks. 2. Student must identify/choose an NGO/Organization that qualifies for tax exemption under Section 80G. 3. It is mandatory for students to include day wise “GEO-TAGGED PICTURES” in their final report and presentation demonstrating the live work done by students related to CDP (for 30 hours or for 4 weeks). No Presentation/Report shall be acceptable without “Geo Tagged Pictures”. i.e. Every report should have minimum 6 Geo Tagged pictures. 4. The students are required to obtain the certificate from the NGO/ local organizations involved in community development areas describing the topic and number of hours the student has worked with the NGO/local organization to complete the project. The certificate should be included in the final report, to be eligible for appearing in the ETP. 5. For evaluation parameters and report submission details, kindly go through the guidelines for Community Development Project (Annexure-II). 6. The final ETP viva voce for Community Development Project shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 25261. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days prior to the date of ETP evaluation. 7. Lastly all the students are required to submit the name and address of their finalized NGO to the university latest till 10th June 2025 for the verification purpose. For the same soon UMS link shall be shared with all the students via UMS my message. In case of any query, students may log an RMS request via the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Message Type: Enquiry Category Type: Academic and Administrative Issues Category: Examination Sub-Category: Seating Plan and VIVA- Capstone/ Dissertation/ Thesis/ CDP/ Summer Training

body: Registration is invited for the Certificate course on Product Engineering using 3D Printing, FEA, and AI. Certificate course on Product Engineering using 3D Printing, FEA, and AI is designed to equip mechanical engineering professionals, faculty members and students with cutting-edge skills in smart product development. With a primary focus on additive manufacturing (3D printing), followed by simulation through Finite Element Analysis (FEA), and integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) for process optimization in Manufacturing, the course delivers a comprehensive hands-on experience that aligns with Industry 4.0 standards. Human Resource Development Center with School of Mechanical Engineering invite registrations for Certificate course on Product Engineering using 3D Printing, FEA, and AI. Details of the course are appended below: Title Certificate course on Product Engineering using 3D Printing, FEA, and AI Course Outcomes After completion of the course, participants will be able to: 1. Apply design considerations for developing CAD models for 3D printing. 2. Apply boundary conditions for FEA on designed product for simulation Analysis and optimization of the design. 3. Prepare data (preparing error-free. STL file, understanding the effect of Orientation, Slicing) for 3D printing. 4. Understand the effect of process parameters on the printed part 3D printing of the developed design. 5. Work efficiently in the field of additive manufacturing (3D printing), FEA- based product validation, and AI/ML integration in smart product design Resource Persons Dr. Vishal Francis, Associate Professor, School of Mechanical Engineering, LPU Dr. Akash Gupta, Assistance Professor, School of Mechanical Engineering, LPU Program Date 09 Jun 2025 to 18 July 2025 Program Schedule Refer Brochure Attached Timings 06.30 PM to 8.30 PM Venue Online mode: (My Class platform) Participants 1. title: Ratio Wizardry - A workshop on ratio and mixtures : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250517/0005 (5/17/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Ratio Wizardry - A workshop on ratio and mixtures”. Understanding ratios and mixtures is a fundamental part of mathematical reasoning and real-world problem-solving. These concepts play a crucial role in various day-to-day scenarios such as sharing resources, cooking recipes, financial planning, and scientific experiments. This workshop will guide students in applying ratio-based logic, interpreting mixtures, and solving problems with clarity and confidence. By mastering these concepts, learners will be better equipped to handle more complex mathematical challenges in academics and practical life. The main objectives of the event are: · To help students develop a clear understanding of ratio and mixture concepts through real-life applications, enhancing their mathematical thinking and logical reasoning skills. · To build confidence in solving complex word problems by introducing structured methods, step-by-step strategies, and visual aids related to ratios and proportions. · To encourage active participation through hands-on activities and collaborative problem-solving, making math more engaging, enjoyable, and relevant to everyday life. Target Audience: Only the students whose names are mentioned in the attached list will participate in the event. Note: Joining link will be shared one day prior to the event through My Message on UMS to the students as per the attached list. title: Mirae Asset Foundation Scholarship Program : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250517/0001 (5/17/2025)
body: About The Program The Mirae Asset Foundation Scholarship Program, an initiative of the Mirae Asset Foundation, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from underprivileged sections of society across India. Under this scholarship, students currently pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses in the country can apply and stand a chance to receive a scholarship of up to Rs 50,000. About Mirae Asset Foundation Mirae Asset Foundation, established in 2018, is the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) arm of Mirae Asset Financial Group in India. Guided by the vision of its parent organisation, the Mirae Asset Park Hyeon Joo Foundation in Korea, the Foundation is dedicated to advancing education at all levels. Its initiatives include providing scholarships to students and collaborating with schools, colleges, government agencies, civil society organisations, and other partners to deliver impactful educational programs across the country.Mirae Asset Scholarship Program for Undergraduate. Student Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Open to students who are currently pursuing undergraduate courses in India. Students must have scored at least 60% in the previous academic year. The annual family income of the applicants should be less than Rs 8,00,000 per annul from all sources. Students from PAN India can apply for the scholarship. Children of Buddy4Study employees are not eligible to participate. Eligibility for Postgraduate Applicants:- Open to students who are currently pursuing postgraduate courses in India. Students must have scored at least 60% in the previous academic year. The annual family income of the applicants should be less than Rs 8,00,000 per annul from all sources. Students from PAN India can apply for the scholarship. Children of Buddy4Study employees are not eligible to participate. Last of Registration:- 20-June-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Undergraduate Applicants:- Scholarship up to Rs 40,000 . title: Regarding preference polling of Department Elective Course for the students of School of Computer Science and Engineering. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250516/0036 (5/16/2025)
body: All the Students of School of Computer Science and Engineering (for the Program and batch as per the attached list) must participate in polling preference of the Department Elective Courses (applicable as per their Program Scheme) as per the instructions mentioned below. Amongst all the Department Elective Courses offered, Course Codes (CSE495, INT372) are having limited number of seats. In case, Student selects Course Code CSE495 or INT372 as their 1st preference or 2nd preference, then they need to select one more Course as a 3rd preference. However, if the student selects any other Course, other than (CSE495, INT372) as first preference, then student shall not be required to fill 2nd or 3rd preference. It is for your information that the allocation for Department Elective Courses (CSE495, INT372) will NOT be on First Come First Serve basis. Since these, two Courses are having limited number of seats, therefore, merit list shall be generated according to CGPA. For other Courses, the allocation will follow First Come First Serve criteria. The polling for seeking preferences of the students for Department Elective Course shall be activated in the student UMS login from 16th May 2025, 02:00 pm till 21st May 2025, 09:00 am. The UMS path to participate in Polling is: - UMS Dashboard -> UMS Home -> UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Polling -> Electives Polling Or through LPU TOUCH app at the menu “Electives Polling” For any query, please contact your school Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) Ms. Amandeep Kaur in Block-27, Room No-205 or login RMS following the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)---->Log Request From the dropdown, Select Department: Academics Category: Academics Subcategory: Elective Polling Note: Students will be allocated Department Elective Course (CSE495, INT372) as per merit list prepared (according to allocation criteria) You can reset your preferences if you wish to edit your submitted preferences before expiry of the mentioned last date. title: LPU Global: Start your application under the credit transfer (2+2) option for Jan 2026 intake : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/250516/0001 (5/16/2025)
body: The Division of International Affairs brings an exciting opportunity for students to earn an international degree through LPU’s Credit Transfer Program. Under this program, students begin their academic journey at LPU, upon successful completion of the initial phase, transfer to one of our esteemed partner universities in countries such as the U.K., USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Latvia, Lithuania, or France. This unique program lets you experience the best of both worlds — students will study the initial part of their degree at LPU and transfer to a foreign university to complete the remaining coursework — ultimately earning a degree from the international partner university. Why Choose the Credit Transfer Program? Cost-Effective: Save up to 40% on tuition fees by studying just 2 years abroad instead of 4. Global Exposure: Immerse yourself in international academic and cultural experiences. Work Opportunities: Earn while you learn! Work up to 20 hours per week (as per host country norms). Support Your Stay: Cover your living expenses through part-time jobs. Post-Study Work Rights: Eligible students may receive PSWR after completing their degree abroad. Eligibility Criteria Minimum 6.5 CGPA with no backlogs or reappearances at the time of application. No pending disciplinary cases. IELTS score of 6.5 overall, with no less than 6 in each module. Proof of financial ability (Funds) to support living and study abroad. A valid Passport Open to 2023 batch (Bachelor’s) and 2024 batch (Master’s) students. Last Date to Register: May 30, 2025 Ready to begin your global journey? Apply Now: https://forms.gle/B23kPij538oiMPaQ9 For more details, reach out to the Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310): +91-9780036427 | +91-9875915867 | +91-9888598782 or email at studyabroad@lpu.co.in

title: Opportunity to enrol for Ph.D. Programme 2025 (Schedule 2) with full application fee waiver and exciting scholarships upto 2.8 Lakh per scholar. : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/250515/0077 (5/15/2025)
body: Recent trends in the job market have revealed the desire of the corporate sector as well as government undertaking institutions to hire candidates for various job positions who have research background through pursuance of Doctoral Degree. Looking into this context of new job opportunities which are not only well paid off but also very high in demand, Lovely Professional University (LPU) has brought an excellent opportunity for the final year Post Graduate students to register for Ph.D. programme for the upcoming Schedule 2 - August 2025 session. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, research contingency grant and various annual research fellowships. Important Points : 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year PG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student can appear for LPUNEST on either 11th July/13th July 2025 followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Programme Fee and Scholarship: The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 60% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee Applicable per semester 60% Rs 30,000/- Rs 20,000/- 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- NOTE: a. Students who have already applied through UMS and either appeared or did not appear for the LPUNEST exam held on 22nd April 2025 at LPU (Schedule 1) and wish to avail a second chance can apply through the LPUNEST Admission Dashboard. b. Students who have not applied in schedule 1 due to any reason(s) can apply for LPUNEST 2025 in Schedule 2 by following the steps mentioned below. How to Apply ? Stage 1 Basic Details: Fill out your basic details in the following link: https://forms.gle/3eXW2iMNA2dmddSY7 Stage 2 Coupon Code: After verification of details, a special coupon code will be shared with the student on the registered email id which can be used to complete LPUNEST registration with full application fee waiver. Stage 3 Select Test Centre and Test Date: Visit https://admission.lpu.in/ and use the coupon code shared on the registered email id to avail full application fee waiver and select the test center spread across India for giving the LPUNEST and preferred test date. The student can choose the preferred test date from any one of the following dates 11th July 2025/13th July 2025. For further information about the benefits and opportunities, please visit Centre for Research Degree Programme (CRDP) in Block 38-406 or reach us out through the following RMS path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department (Ph.D. [Centre for Research Degree Programmes]) -- > Category -- > Sub Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description

title: Guidelines regarding online examinations for ETE-Spring Term 2024-25 (Term 2, Session 2024-25). : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250514/0035 (5/14/2025)
body: Dear Students, We are immensely proud of our armed forces, who have provided us with a safe environment and because of whom we are safe and sound in our homes! All academic operations at the university have resumed. The End Term Examinations for the Spring Term 2024-25 (i.e., Term 2 of the 2024-25 session) will be conducted online, starting from Wednesday, 21st May 2025 for all students except for those belonging to School of Pharmacy. Regarding the same the following guidelines must be immediately noted by all the students: 1. Select Mode of Examination: a. In case any student wishes to appear for the ETE examinations in the offline mode at the university campus instead of online mode, then he/she should submit request at the link UMS Navigation --- Examination System --- Consent for Mode of Examination latest by 15th May 2025 (Thursday). For the students opting for offline mode of examination, separate date sheet will be displayed in due course. b. For the students wishing to appear for exams in the online mode, they should also visit the above-mentioned UMS link and select the preferred mode of Examination as “Online” latest by 15th May 2025. In case a student does not select any mode of exam by 15th May 2025, then his/her the examination will be conducted in the online mode by default. c. The online examinations will be conducted through the LPU My Class interface. 2. Date sheet and Question paper pattern for online examination: a. The date sheet for online examination has been made available to students for the upcoming End Term Examination through the UMS portal under the following navigation path: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System --- Exam Seating Plan. All students should refer to the date sheet through the mentioned link immediately. b. The online examination will follow the below mentioned question paper pattern for majority of the courses. Question Paper pattern Total no. of questions Marks per question Total marks Time allocated per question Total exam time Unit wise distribution All MCQ 45 1 mark for correct answer, 0.25 negative marking for wrong answer 45 2 minutes 90 minutes 5 questions each from Unit I, II and III.10 questions from Unit IV, V and VI c. The exam session timings and question paper pattern applicable for each course code will be displayed in the UMS Seating Plan shortly. Students are advised to carefully check their applicable question paper pattern. d. If any course code has a different question paper pattern (other than All MCQ) due to the nature of the course, the details will also be communicated under the “UMS Exam Seating Plan” tab shortly. 3. Instructions to candidates: All students are strictly advised to refer the “Instructions to students for End Term Examination May 2025-Online Mode” attached with this communication. 4. Mock Test: a. To familiarize students with the use of the LPU MyClass platform for appearing in examinations, mock sessions will be conducted for all students from 16th to 18th May 2025. b. The schedule for these mock sessions will also be displayed under the “Exam Seating Plan” tab for all students in UMS login shortly. c. It is mandatory for all students appearing for the online examination to attend and attempt the mock test. 5. Infrastructure requirements: Students are advised to ensure they are equipped with the necessary infrastructure and prerequisites to appear in the online examination. This includes having a laptop or mobile device that meets the specified technical requirements, as well as access to a dedicated room or quiet space for taking the exam. For detailed infrastructure guidelines, please refer to the attached document. 6. Code of Conduct: a. All students are strictly warned to refrain from using any unfair means during the online examination. If any student is found cheating, copying from any online/offline sources or indulging in use of any prohibited/unfair means, then strict penal action will be taken. b. The online examination software is AI-based and continuously captures your screen activity during the examination. If you navigate away from the examination window or engage in any form of malpractice, an Unfair Means Case (UMC) case will be registered against the student immediately. c. Detailed guidelines regarding Unfair Means Cases (UMC) have been attached with this communication. All students should carefully go through these guidelines for reference. For any query, feel free to contact at 01824-520150.

title: Student Contribution & Rewards Initiative : LPU/19.2/DPE/2024/001/IC/250512/0001 (5/12/2025)
body: Dear Students, We are delighted to announce the launch of the Student Contribution & Rewards Initiative - a visionary platform that empowers you to contribute meaningfully to your university’s progress while being rewarded for your efforts. Under this initiative, every student can become a change-maker by participating in various university-building activities. This is your chance to not only earn monetary benefits but also avail benefits of Revenue Generation Model under EdRev. Why Should You Participate? 1. Monetary Benefits and recognition: · Attractive monetary rewards for verified contributions. · Recognition certificates at various levels. · Earn achievements badges 2. EdRev Policy Benefits: · Avail benefits under the university’s EdRev Revenue Model · Contribute to growth initiatives and gain real-world experience Areas Where You Can Contribute Initiative Description Points that can be earned Bonus points Corporate Tie-Ups – NGOs and CSR Foundations Help establish collaborations with NGOs and CSR Foundations like Adani Foundation, SBI Foundation for Training, Internship Research, or Sponsorships, MoUs, and CSR Activities etc. 500 to 1500 points per tie-up depending upon the level of Tie-Ups* 20% additional points of points earned for more than 5 successful partnerships Government Apprenticeship and Other schemes Be a Nodal officer / Manager of various government schemes which can benefit students 100 to 1500 points depending upon the number of students benefitted from such schemes 20% additional points of points earned for more than 5 such successful collaborations. Admission Referral Refer high achiever students in Academics/ Sports/ Cultural/ Research/ Entrepreneurship for admission in the regular programmes. 2000 points for each approved referral 20% additional points of points earned for more than 5 successful referrals Alumni Engagement Connect with alumni for engage them for generating alumni student support funds, start-up seed fundings etc. 5% of total funds raised i.e if funds raised are Rs 1,00,000, points earned will be 5000 5% additional points of points earned for more than Rs. 2,50,000 funds raised Campus Connect Connect schools/colleges/ other educational institutes for conducting activities like counselling sessions, workshops. 500 to 1500 points depending upon the type of institute connected 20% additional points for more than 5 successful partnerships Contribution Levels, Badges & Rewards To encourage progressive participation, different contribution levels have been made: Level Criteria (Minimum points earned) Badge Earned Rewards Level 1 4000 points Contributor Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 10,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Participation Level 2 6000 points Advocate Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 18,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Excellence Level 3 10000 points Ambassador Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 35,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Leadership Level 4 20000 points Champion Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 75,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Distinction 4. Social Media Recognition How to Get Started? · Register for the initiative through the University Portal to show your initial interest (Path: LMS ---- EDU-Revolution:Be the Change ---- Student Referral Program) · The detailed process and conditions for each initiative will be notified shortly through UMS. · Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. · Track your progress, points, and badges via the portal. · Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification! · Awards will be given on the basis of points accumulated till end of semester (Nov. 2025). Make Your Contribution Count! This initiative is not just about rewards — it's about becoming an integral part of your university’s story. Whether you're helping with admissions, representing us online, or bringing in industry voices, your contribution shapes the future of the University. Let’s grow together - as students, as leaders, and as a university

title: IET India Scholarship Award 2025 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250512/0001 (5/12/2025)
body: About The Program:- The IET India Scholarship Award is one of India's most prestigious scholarship programs for undergraduate engineering students. Established by the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), it aims to identify and support the next generation of engineering leaders in India by recognising their creativity, innovation, leadership, and academic excellence. Now in its 9th edition, the program is open to undergraduate engineering students across all years (1st to 4th year), offering a total scholarship fund of Rs 10,00,000. Applications are entirely free of cost, making this opportunity even more accessible to all eligible candidates. About the IET:- The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), one of the world’s largest professional societies for engineers, is headquartered in the UK. It collaborates with industry, academia, and government to advance engineering and technology, supporting engineers at every stage of their careers in its mission to engineer a better world. In India, IET focuses on Future Technologies, Mobility & Transport, and the Future of Work. Its esteemed Honorary Fellows include Shri Ratan Tata, N. R. Narayana Murthy, and T. V. Ramachandran. Through strategic partnerships, practical learning initiatives, and thought leadership, IET aims to enhance engineering skills, drive technology adoption, and address challenges of national importance. Eligibility for Applicants:- Open for students studying in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of a full-time regular undergraduate engineering program (in any field) approved by AICTE/UGC. Applicants must have cleared all credit courses in a single attempt. Applicants must have scored a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate (or 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) in the semesters cleared so far. There is no age limit for the applicants. Applications are entirely free of cost. Note:- Application is open for all IET members and non-members and for all branches of engineering as recognised by the AICTE/UGC.Also, lateral entry students joining a B.Tech. program in the 2nd year can apply too. Last of Registration:- 31-May-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- The selected scholars will receive the scholarship prize as mentioned below – For Regional Round of Selection: the scholarship award will be as follows. Regional round winner – Rs 60,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). Regional round runner-up – Rs 40,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). For National Finals: The winners of the regional round will compete in national finals, and the scholarship award will be as follows . Winner – Rs 3,00,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). 1st runner-up – Rs 1,70,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). 2nd runner-up – Rs 1,50,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). Note: If a student wins the scholarship at regional and national levels, he/she will be awarded a certificate for both levels and the prize money for the national level only. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/iet-india-scholarship-awards Link 2 : https://forms.gle/fgEL4Xo72iuDXQsT6 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. Kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

body: Learn core principles of ethical hacking and cybersecurity and get equipped with the essential skills needed to identify, analyze, and defend against a wide range of cyber threats. Registration is invited for Certificate Course on Ethical Hacking, organized by School of Computer Science and Engineering with the Human Resource Development Center. Details of the course are appended below: Title Certificate Course on Ethical Hacking Course Outcomes After completing this course, participants will be able to: 1. Understand and explore the fundamentals of ethical hacking 2. Learn how to perform information gathering as part of the ethical hacking process 3. Analyze and simulate web-based hacking techniques Resource Persons Ms. Harpreet Kaur (CEH certified), Assistant Professor, School of Computer Science and Engineering, Lovely Professional University Mr. Parambir Singh (CEH certified), Assistant Professor, School of Computer Science and Engineering, Lovely Professional University Program Schedule June 02, 2025 – July 04, 2025 06:30 PM to 08:30 PM For detailed schedule please refer to the attached Brochure Program Fee and Payment Mode Rs. 3000/- Online Payment or Cash to be deposited in Accounts Department Platform MyClass/Googlemeet/zoom (Link will be shared with the registered participants only) Link to Register To register please visit:https://www.lpu.in/HRD/HRDCLogin.php Registration Closes May 30, 2025 Note: As there are limited seats registration will be on first come first served basis. title: Restricted Movement in blocks 28, 33, 34 and 55 due to conduct of External Agency Examination. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250503/0043 (5/3/2025)
body: This is for the information for all Students and Faculty/Staff members that an external agency exam of high repute is being conducted from 04th May 2025 to 08th June 2025. In this regard please note the below-mentioned points for strict adherence. Entry is strictly prohibited at 3rd level of blocks 28, 33, 34 and 55. In case, any class is on 3rd level of blocks 28, 33, 34 and 55 then students and faculty members should not enter the barricaded area and use 4th level corridors to reach the class. Entry of students and staff/faculty members having classes in Blocks 28, 33, 34 and 55 shall be as given below:- Blocks Entry From 28 Entry will be allowed only through gates facing block 38-Division of Research & innovation. 33 & 34 Entry will be allowed only through gates facing the auditorium & central library. 55 Entry will be allowed only through gates facing the food kiosks & canteen. Note: Students and Faculty members should completely restrict their movement in the mentioned blocks allocated for conduct of external agency exam. Faculty members are advised to sit at their allocated locations in the faculty rooms so as to avoid any kind of disturbance in the conduct of the examination. Faculty members with classes in Blocks 28, 33, 34 and 55 are requested to instruct their students to maintain silence when entering and exiting the classrooms, ensuring minimal noise in the corridors. Most importantly the students and faculty/staff members should not use their mobile phones in the corridors of the block during their any kind of movement. Important: During the conduct of examination, representatives from the testing agency as well as Punjab Police shall be deputed at the examination venues. Therefore all students and faculty/staff members shall observe restricted movement at the venue and avoid any arguments with the staff on-duty. Although the barricading would be in-place, the above is being pre-intimated so as to avoid any inconvenience.

body: Lovely Professional University is thrilled to offer students an exciting opportunity to participate in a 4-week Summer School Programme at the Transport and Telecommunication Institute (TSI), Riga, Latvia. body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “Visionary Minds” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct “Boardroom Chronicles: A Competitive Event on Role Play Rendezvous”. Participants will engage in high-energy, intellectually stimulating scenarios that simulate real-world corporate and business environments. title: Typing with Tact: A session on Formal Writing in the Digital Age (5/3/2025)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club ""Language Booster"" of School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct an online session ""Typing with Tact: A session on Formal Writing in the Digital Age"" designed to guide students through the nuances of formal writing in an increasingly digital academic environment. As online exams and submissions become the norm, the ability to communicate ideas clearly, professionally, and persuasively through typed responses has never been more important. In this session, students will explore the essential elements of formal writing, and this webinar will provide practical tips to help them write with precision and confidence, all while maintaining the formal standards expected in academic work. The main objectives of the event are: To equip learners with a comprehensive understanding of the nuances of formal writing in the context of online exams. To empower participants to enhance their language proficiency and expand their vocabulary, thereby improving the quality of their written communication. To provide participants with actionable strategies for achieving clarity, coherence, and conciseness in their written responses. Target audience: The students of School of Computer Science and Engineering will participate in the event. Date: 9th May, 2025Time: 07:00 PM OnwardsVenue: Online Resource Person: Ms. Poonam Bala Head Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: Research Fellowship Opportunity: BARC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) 2025 : LPU/9.1/PMOU/2024/023/IC/250502/0005 (5/2/2025)
body: The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), under the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), Government of India, invites online applications for 105 Junior Research Fellowships in the areas of Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, and Life Sciences. Areas of Research· Physical Sciences: Nuclear Physics, Atomic and Molecular Physics, Condensed Matter Physics, Spectroscopy, Laser Physics, Accelerator Physics. Chemical Sciences: Nuclear Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Radiation Chemistry, Radio pharmaceutical Chemistry. Life Sciences: Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Genetics, Biochemistry, Structural Biology, Biotechnology, Plant Sciences, Environmental Biology. Eligibility Criteria M.Sc. or equivalent degree (after B.Sc.) in relevant disciplines with at least 60% marks in B.Sc. and 55% marks in M.Sc. Candidates awaiting final M.Sc. results may also apply.· Qualifying Examinations (at least one required): UGC-CSIR-NET (JRF), GATE, JEST, ICMR/ICAR/DBT-JRF, JGEEBILS (for Life Sciences) Age Limit: Not more than 28 years as on 01 August 2025, Relaxation of 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and 10 years for PwBD candidates. Fellowship and Benefits· Initial Fellowship: Rs. 37,000 per month (JRF)· Upgraded Fellowship: Rs. 42,000 per month (Senior Research Fellow) after two years, subject to review· Contingency Grant: Rs. 60,000 per annum. Hostel Accommodation: Provided as per availability; else HRA admissible Important Dates: Online Application Open: 28 April 2025 Application Deadline: 19 May 2025 (up to 23:59 hrs) Interview Period: June–July 2025 Apply online at: https://recruit.barc.gov.in or for queries: jrf@barc.gov.in If you are a student, faculty, or scholar from Lovely Professional University and have applied for this fellowship: Please fill the following form after applying: https://tinyurl.com/lpufellowship This helps us record your application, offer institutional support, and maintain a centralized record for follow-ups and future opportunities. For inquiries, please contact Prof. Gulshan Kumar or Prof. Reji Thomas.Research Collaboration Cell, Department of Research and Innovations at Block 38-404.

title: Design Sense: A Workshop on The UX Laws and Wireframing Sprint : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250501/0001 (5/1/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Design Sense: A Workshop on The UX Laws and Wireframing Sprint”. This fast-paced, interactive workshop will be designed for students, beginners, and creative minds curious about the world of UX design. Through this engaging session, participants will cover the key psychological laws that shape great digital experiences and will learn how to apply them to create clean, user-friendly wireframes. From understanding Fitts’ and Hick’s Laws to building their first mobile app wireframe, this workshop will simplify UX concepts and will help them think like designers — no prior experience will be needed. The main objectives of the event are: · To understand the fundamentals of User Experience (UX) design principles. · To identify and apply key UX laws such as Fitts' Law, Hick’s Law, and Visual Hierarchy to real interfaces. · To comprehend the importance of user-centered design thinking in product and interface design. · To learn the basics of wireframing and its role in the UX process. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS). : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250430/0131 (4/30/2025)
body: This is for the information of all PhD scholars and their supervisors that the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) will be conducted tentatively from June 2025 onwards. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is finalization of: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for SAS registration: a. The research scholar must have cleared the course work or must be exempted for the same due to M. Phil. b. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration c. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy Note: Agriculture research scholars who have cleared the first term of coursework may request for registration at : rdc.sas@lpu.co.in I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation All eligible research scholars are required to register for SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --- Examination system --- Ph.D. Evaluation --- Registration of Upcoming Activity --- SAS – Select “Click here for SAS registration” Note: The interface for registration and file uploading will remain active from 30th April 2025 to 26th May 2025. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --- Examination System--- Ph.D. Evaluation --- Registration of Upcoming Activity--- Submit report Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 30th April 2025 to 26th May 2025. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --- Division of Examination --- Department of Ph.D. Evaluation ---Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --- SAS The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the verified synopsis by their supervisors. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 30th May 2025. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a. At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b. No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c. The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 26th May 2025, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS d. If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS only after the clearance of all pending dues. e. The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines ( for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f. File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g. The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h. Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of SAS synopsis will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of SAS synopsis, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of SAS synopsis. i. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. j. Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. k. The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Search by Category: Ph.D - Research Degree Evaluation Cell: SAS -->Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Search by Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Ph.D - Centre for Research Degree Programmes.

title: Open Now: Registration interface for EduRevolution for the upcoming term. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)/IC/250429/0048 (4/29/2025)
body: Dear Students, Welcome to a new era of learning! The University proudly announces the launch of EduRevolution for the upcoming term– a student-centric transformation initiative where gamification in education would be aiming at redefining your academic experience with greater flexibility, beyond classroom exposure, freedom to choose alternative learning modes, skill development for effective industry readiness and opportunity to convert real world implementation into real earnings. Step into this revolutionary academic experience where Artificial Intelligence will be your learning companion — guiding, supporting and empowering you at every step of the way. Begin your EduRevolution Journey here: You can now access and apply for EduRevolution through your UMS student login in the below mentioned categories. For each category, options (that you may choose) have been crafted by expert faculty members for specific courses of your upcoming term. . Recognition of Prior Learning(RPL) (Core/Non-Core) . Grade Upgradation (Core/Non-Core) . 10% attendance relaxation . Duty Leave for Recognized Activities . Value Addition in Academic Transcript . Evaluation Component modification Summer break extends an excellent opportunity to students to complete these offered activities so that students come better equipped and prepared for upcoming term. To effectively tap the benefits of summer break the students can apply for their nominations latest by May 10th, 2025 (for Phase I). After required approvals, the approved nominations for Phase I shall be intimated to students by May 20th, 2025 so that they can complete these tasks during the summer break. Steps to Apply: Login UMS --> LMS---> EduRevolution:Be the Change---> Apply for EduRevolution Have an Idea to Add? Be the Voice behind the Revolution! EduRevolution is built with you and for you. If you have a new option for any course that aligns with real-world learning or flexible academic enhancement which is not available in the EduRevolution portal, then you can share it through the category -“Any Other” (available across all categories) for all courses. Your contribution could shape future academic innovations! Across all categories the provision has been laid in the interface wherein students can submit their own ideas and after due approval and intimation of associated academic benefits, the students may pursue these ideas. Important Instructions: i. All selections must be completed for Phase I, by 10th May, 2025. For subsequent phases periodic intimidation shall be released. ii. Student can apply for maximum one course under the category of Recognition of Prior learning (RPL) for the upcoming term; the examination for the same will be scheduled in 15 days of start of the Autumn term 2025-26. iii. Student can apply for maximum of 1 course under the category of core course equivalence. iv. Student can apply for a maximum of one course under Non-core course equivalence along with Core course equivalence or RPL. v. In case student is not availing any benefit specified in Recognition of Prior learning (RPL) and Core Course Equivalence, then the student may avail course equivalence in 2 Non-Core courses. vi. In addition to the above, student can apply for other categories as well. vii. Once submitted, your preferences will be reviewed and verified by the standing committee of the school. viii. For assistance, feel free to reach out the Query Handling and Assistance Zone (Room 27–102). You may also raise queries via RMS under the EduRevolution category for effective resolution. *(For detail refer attachments) Let EduRevolution empower you to own your learning, elevate your profile, and lead with skills that matter in the real world. Additional Highlight of EduRevolution: Student Contribution and Rewards Initiative: A platform which empowers students to contribute meaningfully to University’s progress where for the student’s contribution in fields like . Corporate Tie ups . Guest lectures and Industry engagement . Admission referral . Alumni Engagement The student can avail benefits in the form of . Monetary Reward . Achievement Badges . Benefits under University’s Revenue Generation Model . Gain Real world experience Details provided in attachment. Upon their rejoining, this attendance record will be used to determine their attendance bonus and eligibility to appear for the End Term Examinations. Students can appear for their End Term Examinations (of current term) in the month of July 2025 as per the new date sheet which will be displayed in the UMS login of these students. In case if any of these students who are residing outside the University, wishes to avail the University hostel facility inside the campus, on payment basis, then they can submit the request at the UMS link mentioned below. The requests will be considered subject to the availability of seats in hostels. Allocation will be on first come first serve basis. Students can also request assistance for transportation arrangements (on payment basis) to the bus stands (Jalandhar/Phagwara), railway stations (Jalandhar/Phagwara), or Amritsar Airport through the online application portal mentioned below. The link for the online application portal is: https://forms.gle/otGbNBUsHArNGd3Q9 The last date for application is 30th April 2025 (Wednesday). Note: The students who do not wish to return to their hometown i.e. Jammu and Kashmir shall continue attending their classes as per their time table and appear for the End Term examination as per the date sheet already displayed to them in the UMS login.

body: Dear Students, We are delighted to announce the launch of the Student Contribution & Rewards Initiative - a visionary platform that empowers you to contribute meaningfully to your university’s progress while being rewarded for your efforts. EdRev Policy Benefits: · Avail benefits under the university’s EdRev Revenue Model · Contribute to growth initiatives and gain real-world experience Areas Where You Can Contribute Initiative Description Points that can be earned Bonus points Corporate Tie-Ups Help establish corporate collaborations for Training, Internship Research, or Sponsorships, MoUs, Live Projects, Joint Programs, Hackathons, CoEs, Consultancy and CSR Activities 500 to 1500 points depending upon the level of Tie-Ups* 3000 additional points for more than 5 successful partnerships Guest Lectures & Industry Engagements Arrange guest speakers from industry or academia. 500 points for each guest lecture arranged 1000 additional points for more than 3 guest lectures arranged Admission Referral Refer potential students who successfully enrol at the university for the regular programmes. 2000 points for each referral 5000 additional points for more than 5 referrals Engagement Connect with alumni for engage them for providing career opportunities, guest lecture/workshops, generating alumni student support funds, industrial visits, event sponsorships, start-up seed fundings etc 500 points for each alumnus successfully engaged 1000 additional points for more than 10 alumni successfully engaged Contribution Levels, Badges & Rewards To encourage progressive participation, different contribution levels have been made: Level Criteria (Minimum points earned) Badge Earned Rewards Level 1 4000 points Contributor Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 10,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Participation Level 2 6000 points Advocate Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 18,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Excellence Level 3 10000 points Ambassador Badge 1. Monetary Reward Rs. 35,000 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. Certificate of Leadership Level 4 20000 points Champion Badge 1. Monetary Reward (Rs. 75,000) 2. Benefit under Revenue Generation Model of University 3. 3.Certificate of Distinction Social 4.Media Recognition How to Get Started? · Register for the initiative through the University Portal to show your initial interest (Path for the same through separate announcement will be notified soon). · The detailed process for each initiative will be notified through UMS. · Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. · Track your progress, points, and badges via the portal. · Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification! Make Your Contribution Count! This initiative is not just about rewards — it's about becoming an integral part of your university’s story. Whether you're helping with admissions, representing us online, or bringing in industry voices, your contribution shapes the future of the University. The first three participants to buzz in will be invited to craft and deliver a short story—on the spot—based entirely on the emojis provided. The faster they respond, the more points they earn! This competition is designed to challenge and enhance participants' ability to think quickly, articulate ideas clearly, and engage their audience with confidence and flair. title: Part Time job as Student Counselor at Division of Admissions : LPU/18.4/EWYL(ICPT)/2024/007(7.1)/IC/250419/0004 (4/19/2025)
body: Division of Admissions is recruiting students for Part time job (9 am to 5 pm/6 pm) as a student counsellor. The primary purpose is to utilize student's talent, zeal and enthusiasm positively for In-campus tasks like counselling through Walkin/telephonic, preparation of ID cards and handling files, inquiry feeding, dispatching prospectus in postal cell etc. in the Division. Nature of Job: 01. Conducting surveys and collecting information from students/parents in Social Media outreach and Reputation Management cell: Student will be responsible for conducting surveys and collecting information. 02. Data Entry, Reception handling, Campus visits and Routing in Walk-in Inquiry Cell: Candidates will be responsible for data entry for new enquiries and routing the enquiries to the counselor for further processing. 03.Packing and dispatch of Prospectus, lpunest kits in Postal Cell: Candidates will be responsible for packing, dispatch of material time to time in postal cell. Personality Traits, Working Hours: 01. Candidate should possess good communication and interpersonal skills. 02. Good teamwork and team member. 03. Efficient handling of Procedures. 04. Good Information of LPU’s strengths, processes and interfaces. 05. Good knowledge of using computers/internet/social networking/office tools. 06. Estimated number of days in a week is 6 and working hours will be 8/9 hrs which can be extended on a rotational basis depending upon the task allotted. Shortlisting and Academic Criteria: 01. Students enrolled in Under Graduate/ Post Graduate Degree (with no active backlogs). 02. Students having any curriculum requirement/Placement activity/Classes/Training scheduled during the period of job (Between May to July) which is clashing with job timings (9 am to 5 pm/6 pm) need not to apply. Students will not be relieved or exempted for this purpose during the tenure of job. 03. Students will be relieved one day before the start of classes. title: LPU's Flagship Annual Cultural Festivals – One India and One World 2025! : LPU/18.2/CULA/2024/001/IC/250418/0003 (4/18/2025)
body: We are thrilled to invite all students to LPU's flagship cultural festivals: One India and One World, which will take place on 22nd, 23rd, and 24th April 2025 at Baldev Raj Mittal Unipolis. These festivals celebrate the vibrant diversity of our campus, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of India and the world. title: IET India Scholarship Award 2025 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250415/0001 (4/15/2025)
body: About The Program:- The IET India Scholarship Award is one of India's most prestigious scholarship programs for undergraduate engineering students. Established by the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), it aims to identify and support the next generation of engineering leaders in India by recognising their creativity, innovation, leadership, and academic excellence. Now in its 9th edition, the program is open to undergraduate engineering students across all years (1st to 4th year), offering a total scholarship fund of Rs 10,00,000. Applications are entirely free of cost, making this opportunity even more accessible to all eligible candidates. About the IET:- The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), one of the world’s largest professional societies for engineers, is headquartered in the UK. It collaborates with industry, academia, and government to advance engineering and technology, supporting engineers at every stage of their careers in its mission to engineer a better world. In India, IET focuses on Future Technologies, Mobility & Transport, and the Future of Work. Its esteemed Honorary Fellows include Shri Ratan Tata, N. R. Narayana Murthy, and T. V. Ramachandran. Through strategic partnerships, practical learning initiatives, and thought leadership, IET aims to enhance engineering skills, drive technology adoption, and address challenges of national importance. Eligibility for Applicants:- Open for students studying in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of a full-time regular undergraduate engineering program (in any field) approved by AICTE/UGC. Applicants must have cleared all credit courses in a single attempt. Applicants must have scored a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate (or 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) in the semesters cleared so far. There is no age limit for the applicants. Applications are entirely free of cost. Note:- Application is open for all IET members and non-members and for all branches of engineering as recognised by the AICTE/UGC. Also, lateral entry students joining a B.Tech. program in the 2nd year can apply too. Last of Registration:- 31-May-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:-The selected scholars will receive the scholarship prize as mentioned below – For Regional Round of Selection: There will be five regional centres (Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata and Mumbai), and the scholarship award will be as follows. [1] Regional round winner – Rs 60,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). [2] Regional round runner-up – Rs 40,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). For National Finals: The winners of the regional round will compete in national finals, and the scholarship award will be as follows . [1] Winner – Rs 3,00,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). [2] 1st runner-up – Rs 1,70,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). [3] 2nd runner-up – Rs 1,50,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). Note: If a student wins the scholarship at regional and national levels, he/she will be awarded a certificate for both levels and the prize money for the national level only. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/iet-india-scholarship-awards Link 2 : https://forms.gle/fgEL4Xo72iuDXQsT6 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.
