title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250414/0036 (4/14/2025)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from May 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after every 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of ETP registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy for that term. c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation ---> Examination System--> Ph.D. Evaluation --> Registration of Upcoming Activity ETP Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 15th April 2025 to 5th May 2025 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --> Examination System--> Ph.D. Evaluation ---> Registration of Upcoming Activity---> Click to Submit report Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 15th April 2025 to 5th May 2025 3. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --->ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 9th May 2025. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. d) Research scholars are also required to bring a hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation, failing which the scholar will not be allowed to appear for the evaluation. e) Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. f) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. g) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. h) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process/appear for the evaluation after registration will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". i) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines and as per the guidelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) -->Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

title: Register for Community Edition Project 2025 by Nothing. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250414/0003 (4/14/2025)
body: The Nothing Technology in India launched the second edition of The Community Edition Project, which is a contest that invites our community to re-design four elements of one of our smartphones, from hardware and software to the creative marketing campaign. Each winner gets to work with the relevant internal team to co-develop their idea in time for production and a limited sale at the end of the year! Last year, the Phone (2a) Plus Community Edition, which the company co-created with five talented community members, sold out online in just 15 mins. The winners recently became iF Gold Award recipients and have since spoken at design events across the world! This year company is inviting our community to submit a proposal on how they would re-imagine the following elements of Phone (3a): 1. Hardware Design - dream up a new look (through colour, material and finish) for Phone (3a) and have your say on the look of the packaging. 2. Software Design - ideate new software design elements to deliver a unique on-screen experience. Think widgets, wallpapers and clock faces! 3. Accessory - develop an exclusive accessory or collectible to accompany Phone (3a) Community Edition. 4. Marketing Campaign - submit a creative proposal that’ll launch (3a) Community Edition to the world. Prize: The winners of each stage will receive £1000 (or local equivalent) and will embark on the co-creation journey with the Nothing Team. We’ll pay for a trip to London for the launch event towards the end of 2025, plus any in-person workshops that we invite the winners to over the summer! They will also receive the final Phone (3a) Community Edition once it has launched. Last date of Submissions : 23rd April 2025, 11am BST Submission Link: https://nothing.tech/pages/community-edition Registered students are requested to fill this Google for confirmation-https://forms.gle/GZ1aX1d3ywzbUT1t9 The full briefs for each of the four stages are mentioned on the above mentioned website For any query please contact: - Department of student project and research, Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Student Welfare Wing -Phone: +91 98148 18964

title: Flipkart Foundation Scholarship Program 2024-25- reg. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250411/0050 (4/11/2025)
body: Flipkart Group is committed to strengthening the retail sector including the Kirana Stores which form a significant part. As part of our endeavour, the Flipkart Foundation is supporting a scholarship for children of Kirana Store Owners to make them future-ready. The Flipkart Foundation Scholarship 2024-25 is an initiative by the Flipkart Foundation aimed at supporting deserving, financially disadvantaged students, with a strong emphasis on empowering meritorious and underprivileged female students. Aligned with goals emphasising affordable education and gender equality, the program aims to enable access to higher education and promote empowerment. Under this program, first-year students enrolled in professional STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) undergraduate programs and children of Kirana Store Owners (KSOs) in the academic year 2024-25 will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 50,000 Link to apply for the Scholarship: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/flipkart-foundation-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship application is 16-Apr-2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship:- Applicants must be currently studying in the 1st year of professional undergraduate STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) courses at government colleges in India. 1. One parent must be a Kirana Store Owner (KSO). 2. Applicants must have scored at least 60% in their Class 12 exams. 3. The annual family income should not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. 4. Children of employees of Flipkart Group and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: The scholarship fund may be utilized to cover academic-related expenses, including, but not limited to, tuition fees, exam fees, hostel fees, books, stationery, travel, data, food and lodging, etc. Benefits:- A fixed scholarship of INR 50,000 Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-size photograph 2. College/ Institution admission proof (Admission Letter/ Institution Identity Card, etc.) 3. Class 12 mark sheet 4. Family income proof (ITR, salary slips, income certificate issued by concerned Government authority, etc.) 5. Proof of Kirana Store Owner (Shops and Establishment Registration Act, Entity Registration, GST Registration or as applicable) 6. Proof of identity (PAN Card, Aadhaar card, Driving Licence, etc.) 7. Disability certificate issued by the concerned government authority (if applicable) 8. Payment receipts of educational expenses (tuition fees, hostel fees, books, mess fee, etc.) along with fee structure for the academic year 9. Student’s Bank passbook HOW TO APPLY: 1. Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. 2. Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and land on the ‘Application Form Page.’ 3. Register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile/Gmail account. 4. You will now be redirected to the ‘Flipkart Foundation Scholarship 2024-25' application form page. 5. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. 6. Fill in the required details in the online application form. 7. Upload relevant documents. 8. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. 9. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->- Flipkart Foundation Scholarship Program 2024-25- reg All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103 (B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: LPU GLOBAL: AUTOSOL, CYBERSOL & EUROPEAN TECH LEADERS 2025 – INTERNATIONAL IMMERSION AND INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITIES IN GERMANY : LPU/11.2/IRCS(GVG)/2024/002(2.1)/IC/250410/0001 (4/10/2025)
body: Step into the future of innovation and leadership — in the heart of Europe! The Division of International Affairs (Relations Cell) is proud to present a prestigious international opportunity for Engineering and Business students of LPU to gain unmatched global exposure. In collaboration with Indo-Euro Synchronization, students can participate in immersive training across Automobile Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Management & Leadership Skills. This 15-day program (equivalent to 4 academic credits) offers a dynamic blend of academic excellence and industrial experience through expert-led workshops, company visits, and real-world learning in Germany. Students will receive international certifications in cutting-edge technologies while engaging directly with Europe’s top research centres and industry leaders. Three options available according to your field: Core Engineering students can join AutoSol 2025 Computer Science students and its aligned branches can apply for CyberSol 2025 Students from business and related fields (BBA, MBA) passionate about entrepreneurship and innovation, can apply for the European Tech Leaders Program 2025 Duration of the Program: 6th July 2025 to 20th July 2025 Eligibility: CGPA: 6.0 Applicable to all students of B.Tech. (CSE, EEE, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Aerospace), B.Sc. (CS/IT) and BBA/MBA from 2nd, 3rd & 4th Year. Must have no backlogs, reappears, or disciplinary cases. Must not be in their final semester. B2 level of proficiency in English. Valid passport (Validity of at least 6 months) COST & SCHOLARSHIPS: Actual Program Cost: 1.65 Lakh INR Special Fee for Early Bird Registrations (Till 15th April 2024)- 1.40 Lakh INR Registration fee: 15000 INR (included in program fee). Optional Fee: Paris Trip for 18000 INR (Additional to the Actual Program Cost). Application Fee: 2000 INR Application Deadline: Early Bird Registrations: 15th April Regular Registrations: 20th April Includes: Accommodation. Airport transfers in Germany. Breakfast and Lunch ONLY on Training days. Seminars by industrial experts. Certification from German Research Centers/Companies. University visits. Industrial visits (Mercedes Benz, Audi, Porsche) Cultural and City tours in Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Aachen, and optionally Paris Higher education assistance. Excludes: Round trip flight ticket, any expenses related to Embassy/VISA application requirements in India (German consulate fee in India), health & travel insurance, Dinner in the Training days and all meals during the non-training days, personal expenses. Register Here: https://forms.gle/1R4B4rHShjU9MZek6 For further information, please contact Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310) or Call at 9875928583/9501110446 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Nutanix Heart Women in Technology Scholarships 2025-26 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250409/0001 (4/9/2025)
body: Nutanix Heart Women in Technology Scholarships 2025-26 is an opportunity offered by Nutanix, an American cloud computing company for undergraduate female students pursuing degree in software engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or computer engineering. The main objective of this scholarship is to identify and develop the talent of women who want to support the expansion and innovation of the tech industry. Up to 10 scholarships are available from Nutanix to students in India and other countries who wish to use their passion for technology to advance the status of women in the profession and have a positive impact on both the industry and the environment. Selected applicants will receive a one-time scholarship of up to $2,000 towards tuition and fees. Eligibility for Applicants:- Be a female student be full-time undergraduate or graduate students during the 2024-25 school year. Be currently pursuing a degree in software engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or computer engineering or the academic year 2025–2026. Be enrolled in one of the schools in India or other eligible countries namely the US, Mexico, Australia, UK, France, India, Serbia, Netherlands, and Spain. Have secured a minimum of 3.0 GPA in nations that use GPA scoring. (Note:- Transcripts are required for applicants using GPA scoring when applying.) Demonstrate excellent communication and leadership abilities. Possess a history of community service and extracurricular involvement. Note: - Nutanix employees are not eligible for these scholarships. Immediate family members of Nutanix employees are also not eligible. Current Nutanix interns are not eligible for these scholarships. Last of Registration:- 16-Apr-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- Scholarships worth up to $2,000 each to cover tuition and other expenses. title: SBIF Asha Scholarship Program for Overseas Education 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250405/0001 (4/5/2025)
body: About The Program:- The SBIF Asha Scholarship Program for Overseas Education 2024-25, one of India's largest scholarship programs, is an initiative of the SBI Foundation under its education vertical - Integrated Learning Mission (ILM). This program aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families across India, ensuring the continuity of their education. This scholarship is open to SC/ST students pursuing a master’s or above course (any year) at a premier university/college outside India. Selected students can receive a scholarship of up to Rs 20 lakh for a year to support their educational endeavours. About SBI Foundation:- SBI Foundation is the CSR arm of the State Bank of India. Upholding its tradition of service beyond banking, the Foundation operates in over 28 States and Union Territories of India, focusing on Rural Development, Healthcare, Education, Livelihood & Entrepreneurship, Youth Empowerment, Promotion of Sports, and more. The Foundation is dedicated to contributing to the socio-economic development and betterment of underprivileged sections of society, reflecting the ethos of the SBI group by running ethical interventions that promote growth, equality, and a positive societal impact. Eligibility for Applicants:- Applicants must be Indian nationals. Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories. Applicants must be pursuing a master’s or above course (any year) at a premier university or college outside India OR should have received an acceptance/offer letter from universities outside India. Students must have secured 75% marks or above in their previous academic year. Students with a gross annual family income of up to Rs 6,00,000 are eligible to apply. Note: - Premier universities/colleges outside of India will include those listed at the top in reputed world rankings such as the QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education World University Rankings Preference will be given to students with a family income of up to Rs 3,00,000 per annum. 100% of the slots for overseas education will be reserved for SC/ST scholars. Last of Registration:- 15 April-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- Up to Rs 20,00,000 or 50% of course-related expenses (whichever is less). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-asha-scholarship-program-for-overseas-education Link 2 : https://forms.gle/qVnnRP96iNqEhGjJ7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Online HRD Verification, Attestation, and Apostille of Educational Documents through eSanad portal-reg. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-3)/IC/250404/0019 (4/4/2025)
body: Dear All, We are pleased to inform you that the HRD Verification process has been started, including Attestation and Apostille of educational documents through eSanad portal of Govt. of India. Earlier, the students were visiting the office of Higher Education, Punjab, Mohali for HRD verification by submitting the documents physically. Now, this process has been made online by the Govt. The link for the online attestation/ Apostille is as under: Link: https://esanad.nic.in The complete process of applying for the documents verification and fees payment to LPU & Govt. of India is available on LPU website. The links are as under: a. Fees payment link: https://www.lpu.in/esanad/frmESanad.aspx b. Complete process link: www.lpu.in/eSanad The copy of the complete process of HRD verification is enclosed for your reference (Annexure -1) Some important points for the verification process are as under: 1. After successful submission of the application on eSanad portal, the portal will generate an acknowledgment with a unique ARN (Application Registration Number). Save this acknowledgment for future reference. 2. After the final submission by the student, the request of verification of the documents will be forwarded to the university for verification of certificates. The university will check and verify the certificate and forwarded the application online to Higher Education, Punjab for further action. 3. The Higher Education will forward the application online to the Ministry of External Affairs for final verification. 4. The verified documents will be sent to the students through post by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA). 5. Student can track the application status from govt. website https://esanad.nic.in/ using the Application ID or Document ID under tab Online Services – Track your application status. For any other information, you may contact us at Building No. 32, Room No. 101 A (Window No. 2) or lodged an RMS via UMS path – UMS Navigation---> RMS --->Records and Certificates ----> E-Sanad.

body: This is for the information of all faculty members supervising the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines mentioned in Annexure-III (Attached). 1. Uploading the soft copy of final report. All students need to prepare the final report of their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in four parts i.e., PDF File-1, PDF File-2, PDF File-3 and PDF file-4 (details of pdf files are given in Table 1) via their UMS as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation Table 1- Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) PDF File 1* PDF File 2 PDF File 3 PDF File 4 (Applicable only for final stage Master Dissertation) Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload "only Content Report" which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student's Name, Reg. Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone Project-II, Dissertation-II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf. Also, AI plagiarism check will be applied so students should refrain from using AI. Student need to submit graphical abstract from Thesis/Dissertation work at Master's Level) Please ensure that PDF File 1 contains student as well as supervisor signatures on the declaration certificates before uploading the same on the UMS interface. Important Note- 1. It is advised that the student(s) must ensure timely uploading of their final report before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report before final submission of the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office by the students. 2.In Extreme cases if the final report is not ready and requires more time, student can request for an extension of maximum 60 days with a fee of Rupees 1000/- in 30-310 by filling the hard copy Extension form. 3.The guidelines (Annexure-II) attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done. 4.Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-III. 2. Online Report Recommendation from Supervisor: The soft copy of the final report uploaded by each student should be recommended by the supervisor in order to be eligible for the final ETP viva. In case report is not recommended by supervisor then final ETP viva for the student(s) shall not be conducted. 3. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative office (A.O. Office) Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, two hard copies, either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. While submitting the hardcopy of project report the AOs must write the E-Receipt Number, sign and put their UID along with the University stamp on hardcopies carried by the student. One Signed and stamped copy of the report should be returned to the student and the same must be carried by the student at the time of ETP viva. Respective School AO’s can generate an online report submission number via the following UMS path. UMS Navigation-- >Administrative Task-->Report Submission Important Points: 1. For students working in groups, any one member of the group can make the submission in AO office and it will be considered for all. Whereas, the supervisor must recommend the uploaded soft-copy via UMS interface for all students in-order to enable hard-copy submission for the whole group. 2. In case a student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be awarded. 3. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III. In case of any query, student may log an RMS request using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)--->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Select Category: Examination Select Sub Category: Training/ Dissertation/ OJT / Thesis / Seminar / Capstone & Viva

title: CALL FOR INVESTIGATOR-INITIATED RESEARCH PROPOSALS (Intermediate Extramural Grants – 2025) : LPU/9.1/SPRO/2024/014/IC/250329/0001 (3/29/2025)
body: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) invites applications for Intermediate Extramural Research Grants under its prestigious Investigator-Initiated Projects scheme. This call supports Indian scientists (outside ICMR institutes) to undertake impact-driven research in medicine, public health, and allied fields. The research should be based on proven concepts and aim to deliver tangible health solutions such as new diagnostics, treatments, public health interventions, or commercial/clinical products. Types of Research Supported: Discovery Research – Novel targets, drug discovery, AI/ML for biomarkers, personalized medicine, etc. Development Research – Diagnostics, medical devices, vaccines, predictive tools. Delivery/Implementation Research – Barriers in healthcare delivery, health system optimization. Descriptive Research – Burden, risk factors, disease pathogenesis. Priority Areas Include (but not limited to): Tuberculosis, Cancer, Diabetes, Cardiovascular Diseases, Maternal & Child Health, Mental Health, Vector-borne diseases, AMR, Preterm Birth, Climate & Health, Anemia, Ageing, and more. Funding & Duration: Budget: 2 Crores to < 8 Crores Duration: Up to 4 years (+ optional 6-month preparatory period, no cost) Last date of submission: 08 April 2025 Link: https://www.icmr.gov.in/post/call-for-investigator-initiated-research-proposals-for-intermediate-extramural-grants-2025-last-date-april-8-2025-5-00-pm-ist

title: Pursuing Two Academic Degrees Simultaneously. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)/IC/250327/0076 (3/27/2025)
body: Dear Students, National Education Policy (NEP, 2020) aims to remove rigid boundaries in education, enabling students to create new possibilities for life-long learning along with enhancing inter disciplinary thinking by pursuing two academic programmes simultaneously. In order to extend the same benefit, Lovely Professional University is providing an opportunity to students to enrol in two academic programmes simultaneously. Advantage of pursuing two Academic Programmes simultaneously: . Gaining Multiple Skill sets: Students can acquire multiple skill set across different disciplines or domains. . Enhanced Specialization: Pursuing two academic programmes simultaneously will help students to enhance their specialisation, enabling interdisciplinary research with expanded placement opportunities. . Diversified Career Planning: Knowledge of multiple fields increases career choices and opportunities. Different modes that can be adopted for pursuing two academic programmes simultaneously can be as follows: Mode I(Regular + Online/Distance) Mode II(Regular + Regular) Students of LPU who are pursuing on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are eligible to apply for an Online/Open and Distance Learning (ODL) programme offered by LPU(established eligibility criteria for admission shall be followed) Students of LPU who are pursuing on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are eligible to apply for a simultaneous another on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate programmes offered by LPU(established eligibility criteria for admission shall be followed) Instructions to avail the opportunities: . For pursuing simultaneous degree, guidelines issued by UGC notice titled “Guidelines for Pursuing Two Academic Programmes Simultaneously” of April 2022 shall be followed (attached with this communication for reference). . The student will be required to undergo the same rigor for both the programmes. The University will not make any adjustments in assignments and examination schedules for the students. . In case a student misses any course(s) during the regular session, then they can attend summer term classes. . The option of summer term classes would be as per the University policy. . Students are advised to select programmes that complements each other, that are highly valued by the industry and encourage interdisciplinary learning. title: Programming Test for Product Based Pathway [2nd year students] : LPU/6.1/OMC7/2024/056/IC/250326/0001 (3/26/2025)
body: The School of Computer Science and Engineering will be offering a pathway called “Corporate – Product Based (Placement oriented track of Competitive Programming for product-based companies)” to the students currently in the second year of their study under CSE/IT programmes. Under this pathway, the following 03 courses based on competitive coding theme will be offered in the next two terms i.e. Term 5 and Term 6 besides the Engineering minor, Open Minor/Open Elective and other regular courses. PRELUDE TO COMPETITIVE CODING COMPETITIVE CODING APPROACHES-TECHNIQUES CODING PEARLS A maximum of 270 students will be registered for this pathway. The students will be selected on the basis of performance in an online programming test containing two sections. Following are the details of the shortlisting process: A separate coding based diagnostic test of 70 marks shall be conducted on 03rd May, 2025 (Saturday) on IamNeo/Hackerrank platform. The test will have 02 coding problems (each of 35 marks) to be solved in 01 hours. A section of 15 multiple choice questions on Database Management Systems, Operating Systems, Data Structures, Computer Networks (totalling 30 marks) to be solved in 15 minutes.Students who are willing to go for the Product based pathway must register themselves by 15th April 2025 on https://tinyurl.com/productBasedTest Students having a maximum of 01 E/F/G grade courses at the time of declaration of result are allowed to take this pathway. Seating plan for this diagnostic test will be shared with students shortly through a separate UMS announcement. The number of courses for the students in the coming semesters will remain the same as for all the other students. These courses will replace some of the courses. The students selected in the programming test will have to continue with the product-based pathway. There will not be any separate process to take options for product-based pathway.Students selected for product-based pathway will have to register for placement services of the University in the first phase of placement registration process. For any further queries regarding the same, the students can contact their respective section HoDs.

title: Open Mike Show (Cultural & Social Hub of LPU) : LPU/18.2/CULA/2024/001/IC/250324/0001 (3/24/2025)
body: Division of Art and Culture is organizing a series of Open Mike Show at Uni-Polis(Cultural & Social Hub of LPU) on every Thursday w.e.f March 20, 2025; 5 PM onwards. The Open Mike Show will offer a creative platform for students to show case their talents and connect with one another in a positive and inclusive environment. The Open Mike Show will feature a diverse range of activities, allowing participants to showcase their unique talents and creativity. Performers can take the stage to present various forms of entertainment, including live music, stand-up comedy, poetry readings, storytelling, dance, and spoken word performances. Additionally, participants may engage the audience with improvisational acts or share their original compositions. This vibrant and inclusive event aims to provide a platform for artists of all kinds to express themselves, entertain, and connect with a supportive audience, making it a dynamic and interactive experience for both performers and spectators alike. Selection Criteria Statement for Open Mike Show (First-Come-First-Serve Basis)To ensure fairness and transparency, the Open Mike Show will be operated on a first-come-first-serve basis, where the following criteria will be used to select participants: 1.Participants must register for the Open Mic Show as soon as the registration opens. The earliest registrations will be given priority for performance slots. 2.All participants must provide accurate and complete registration details. This includes the name, contact information, preferred performance type (e.g., music, comedy, poetry). 3.Once a participant has successfully registered, they will receive a confirmation email or message with the details of their performance time. This confirmation secures their slot in the show. 4.Each participant will be allotted a specific time slot based on availability. The time limit for each performance will be communicated upon registration, and participants are expected to adhere to this limit to ensure all performers are given equal opportunity. 5.In case of a high volume of registrations, priority will be given to those who register first, up to the maximum available slots. Late registrations may be placed on a waiting list in case of cancellations. 6.If a registered performer fails to show up at the designated time or cancels without proper notice, the slot may be offered to a participant on the waiting list or the next available registrant. 7.Participants are expected to respect the event’s schedule, including arriving on time for their performance. Any late arrivals may forfeit their slot in favor of those who are on time.By adhering to these selection criteria, we aim to ensure a smooth, fair, and enjoyable experience for all participants in the Open Mic Show.Schedule: March 27, 2025; April 03, 10, 17 & 24, 2025(Every Thursday) For Registration Kindly fill the google form at https://forms.gle/bNd7fJe6SDM7gncG7 For More Info, Kindly contact Dr. Bhumika Sharma, Assistant Professor, LPU(UID:32676), BL 13-211.

title: LPU GLOBAL: FUNDED OPPORTUNITY IN FRANCE - CHARPAK EXCHANGE SCHOLARSHIP : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/250322/0001 (3/22/2025)
body: LPU GLOBAL: FUNDED OPPORTUNITY IN FRANCE - CHARPAK EXCHANGE SCHOLARSHIP The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to present an exciting opportunity for LPU students to apply for the France Excellence Charpak Exchange Scholarship – Autumn Session (Sept – Dec) 2025. This prestigious scholarship is designed for Indian students from all fields and streams of study who are currently enrolled at the Bachelor’s or Master’s level and wish to undertake a study exchange semester in France for a period of one to six months. Benefits: Monthly Stipend of 860 euros. Tuition Fee waived off. Social security coverage. Student Visa fee waiver. Campus France fee waiver or reimbursement. Assistance in finding affordable student accommodation. Eligibility: CGPA: 8.5 Be an Indian national. Must have a valid passport. Not more than 30 years old at the time of application. Must have no backlogs, reappears, or disciplinary cases. Must not be in their final semester or pursuing a research project or thesis during the application process or exchange program. Excluding: Flight tickets, health & travel insurance, food, and transportation (Could be covered in monthly stipend). Application Fee: 2000 INR Registration Deadline: March 28th, 2025 Publication of Results: Second week of June 2025 To apply register at this link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1n2DDAnt8s1kFNno6YsVCT_TC-FTMeoWHxWRmEgxyuXg/edit For further information, please contact Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310), Contact No. 9875928583/7888398891 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Interview Strategist 4.0: A Competitive Bootcamp : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250325/0004 (3/22/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Division of Residential Services is going to conduct an event named “Interview Strategist 4.0: A Competitive Bootcamp”. This event will focus on improving the employability skills of the students through hands-on practice and discussion on interview questions and answering strategies. It will be an activity-based bootcamp that will equip students with various techniques to handle stress-based questions, situation-based questions, goal-related questions, etc. The placement interview questions asked during recent placement drives will also be discussed to give students real-time exposure. The students will also be given feedback on their language skills as per the expectations of the corporate world. Target audience: The students of Boys Hostel – 4 will participate in the event. Date: 25th March, 2025 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Boys Hostel – 4 Resource Person:1) Ms. Shally 2) Mr. Prince Kumar

title: Session on Semiconductor Day: The Heart of Technology (3/22/2025)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU in collaboration with Silicon Labs, Philips, SanDisk, and Mavenir will organize the "" Session on Semiconductor Day: The Heart of Technology "" to create awareness about the semiconductor industry and its pivotal role in the tech ecosystem. Silicon Labs is a leader in secure, intelligent wireless technology. Philips is a global health technology company focused on improving people’s lives through innovation. SanDisk specializes in flash memory storage solutions widely used in mobile and computing devices. Mavenir is a network software provider redefining network economics for communications service providers. title: Invitation to Participation in "Innovate with GoIStats" hackathon : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250321/0001 (3/21/2025)
body: The Department of Student Research and Projects, Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Student Welfare Wing, Lovely Professional University, is excited to announce that the National Statistics Office (NSO) of the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) releases essential macroeconomic indicators, including Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and Consumer Price Index (CPI). The NSO also conducts large-scale sample surveys across the country, exploring various socio-economic aspects, and publishes the survey results in the form of detailed reports and micro-data, all of which are accessible on the MoSPI website. This hackathon aims to create awareness about the data being generated by the Ministry and encourage students and researchers to utilize the data for creating innovative data-driven insights that would be useful for the policy-makers in building a 'Viksit Bharat'. The hackathon will be hosted on the MyGov platform and will provide participants an opportunity to work with official statistical datasets to create impactful visualizations Eligibility Criteria: The hackathon is open to the following categories of participants: Students enrolled in Undergraduate (UG)/ Postgraduate (PG) degrees/ diploma or equivalent courses, Research Associates currently enrolled in recognized and bonafide Indian universities, colleges, and institutions or completed the above degrees in Financial Year 2024-25. Participants must be Indian nationals. After evaluation of the entries, the winning candidates are to submit the certificate from their college/institute certifying that he/she is a bonified student of the University currently enrolled in (i) degrees/ diploma or equivalent course / completed or (ii) degrees/ diploma or equivalent course in FY 2024-25. Outcome of the Hackathon: Participants will analyze official statistics available on the MoSPI website and create impactful data visualizations for submission. Registration Last Date: 31st March 2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovateindia.mygov.in/goistats Gratifications Top 30 entries with the highest normalized scores will be shortlisted. Among these, the top 5 will be awarded as the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd prizes. The remaining 25 will receive consolation prizes. Prize details are as following: 1st Prize: ?2 Lakhs (1) 2nd Prize: ?1 Lakh (2) 3rd Prize: ?50,000 (2) 25 Consolation Prizes: ?20,000 each (25) A poster, prepared by MoSPI with the necessary details, is attached to this communication For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

title: Opportunity for Final year Post Graduate Students of Lovely Professional University (LPU) to enroll for Ph.D. Programme for August 2025 session at LPU. : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/250313/0052 (3/13/2025)
body: Recent trends in the job market have revealed the desire of the corporate sector as well as government undertaking institutions to hire candidates for various job positions who have research background through pursuance of Doctoral Degree. Looking into this context of new job opportunities which are not only well paid off but also very high in demand, Lovely Professional University (LPU) has brought an excellent opportunity for the final year Post Graduate students to register for Ph.D. programme for the upcoming August 2025 session. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, research contingency grant and various annual research fellowships. Important Points : 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year PG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student needs to appear for LPUNEST on 22nd April 2025 followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Important Dates: LPUNEST Ph.D. Registration 12th March 2025 (Wednesday)– 19th April 2025 (Saturday) Conduct of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 22nd April 2025 (Tuesday) Result of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 25th April 2025 (Friday) Research Proposal Discussion 28th April 2025 (Monday)– 30th April 2025 (Wednesday) Final Result 3rd May 2025 (Saturday) Last date of Ph.D. Admission 31st May 2025 (Saturday) 4. Programme Fee and Scholarship: The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 60% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee Applicable per semester 60% Rs 30,000/- Rs 20,000/- 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- How to Apply ? The final year post graduate students can register for LPUNEST through their UMS. The students can register by visiting the following link. UMS Navigation --->Research and Development ---->PhD Discipline Preference. The detailed steps to apply for LPUNEST is attached with the announcement. For further information about the benefits and opportunities, please visit Centre of Research Degree Programme (CRDP) in Block 38-406 or reach us out through the following RMS path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department (Ph.D. [Centre for Research Degree Programmes]) -- > Category -- > Sub Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description

title: IndusInd Bank ‘Educate For Life’ Scholarship Program : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250313/0002 (3/13/2025)
body: IndusInd Bank ‘Educate For Life’ Scholarship Program is an initiative by IndusInd Bank that aims to provide scholarships to needy students and to support them in continuing their education in the form of scholarships. Under this scholarship, students from graduation courses will be provided with one-time financial assistance of up to Rs 75,000 to cover their academic expenses. About IndusInd Bank:- IndusInd Bank demonstrates a strong commitment to enhancing educational opportunities for needy students through its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. Its programs include providing scholarships to deserving students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, supporting remedial education to bridge learning gaps, and enhancing foundational learning and numeracy skills. The bank partners with various organizations and institutions to implement these programs, focusing on creating sustainable and impactful change in the lives of underprivileged children. Through these focused educational initiatives, IndusInd Bank aims to empower students and contribute to building a brighter future. Eligibility for Applicants:- Students from general/professional graduation courses (any year) are eligible. They must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in Class 12. Open to PAN India students. Total annual family income must be less than Rs 6 lakhs from all sources. Children of IndusInd Bank and Buddy4Study are not eligible. Last of Registration:- 16 Mar-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Professional Graduation Courses - Rs 72,000 (Fixed scholarship) For General Graduation -Rs 24,000 (Fixed scholarship) Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/indusind-bank-educate-for-life-scholarship-program Link 2 : https://forms.gle/8ZZpgdAKkkdYE3ZL9 Note:-It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship.The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: LPU GLOBAL: FUNDED OPPORTUNITY IN FRANCE - CHARPAK EXCHANGE SCHOLARSHIP : LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024/005(5.2)/IC/250312/0001 (3/12/2025)
body: LPU GLOBAL: FUNDED OPPORTUNITY IN FRANCE - CHARPAK EXCHANGE SCHOLARSHIP The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to present an exciting opportunity for LPU students to apply for the France Excellence Charpak Exchange Scholarship – Autumn Session (Sept – Dec) 2025. This prestigious scholarship is designed for Indian students from all fields and streams of study who are currently enrolled at the Bachelor’s or Master’s level and wish to undertake a study exchange semester in France for a period of one to six months. Benefits: Monthly Stipend of 860 euros. Tuition Fee waived off. Social security coverage. Student Visa fee waiver. Campus France fee waiver or reimbursement. Assistance in finding affordable student accommodation. Eligibility: CGPA: 8.5 Be an Indian national. Must have a valid passport. Not more than 30 years old at the time of application. Must have no backlogs, reappears, or disciplinary cases. Must not be in their final semester or pursuing a research project or thesis during the application process or exchange program. Excluding: Flight tickets, health & travel insurance, food and transportation (Could be covered in monthly Stipend). Application Fee: 2000 INR Registration Deadline: March 22, 2025 Publication of Results: Second week of June 2025 To apply register at this link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1FNgthuHKrtfUfbHvmGpAQ5KpQL40gPqUCY0DYHVunvo/edit For further information, please contact Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310), Contact No. 9875928583/7888398891 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Open Mike Show at Uni-Polis(Cultural & Social Hub of LPU) : LPU/18.2/CULA/2024/001/IC/250312/0001 (3/12/2025)
body: Division of Art and Culture is organizing an Open Mike Show at Uni-Polis(Cultural & Social Hub of LPU) on every Friday w.e.f March 21, 2025; 5 PM onwards. The Open Mike Show will offer a creative platform for students to show case their talents and connect with one another in a positive and inclusive environment. The Open Mic Show will feature a diverse range of activities, allowing participants to showcase their unique talents and creativity. Performers can take the stage to present various forms of entertainment, including live music, stand-up comedy, poetry readings, storytelling, dance, and spoken word performances. Additionally, participants may engage the audience with improvisational acts or share their original compositions. This vibrant and inclusive event aims to provide a platform for artists of all kinds to express themselves, entertain, and connect with a supportive audience, making it a dynamic and interactive experience for both performers and spectators alike. Selection Criteria Statement for Open Mic Show (First-Come-First-Serve Basis)To ensure fairness and transparency, the Open Mic Show will be operated on a first-come-first-serve basis, where the following criteria will be used to select participants: 1.Participants must register for the Open Mic Show as soon as the registration opens. The earliest registrations will be given priority for performance slots. 2.All participants must provide accurate and complete registration details. This includes the name, contact information, preferred performance type (e.g., music, comedy, poetry). 3.Once a participant has successfully registered, they will receive a confirmation email or message with the details of their performance time. This confirmation secures their slot in the show. 4.Each participant will be allotted a specific time slot based on availability. The time limit for each performance will be communicated upon registration, and participants are expected to adhere to this limit to ensure all performers are given equal opportunity. 5.In case of a high volume of registrations, priority will be given to those who register first, up to the maximum available slots. Late registrations may be placed on a waiting list in case of cancellations. 6.If a registered performer fails to show up at the designated time or cancels without proper notice, the slot may be offered to a participant on the waiting list or the next available registrant. 7.Participants are expected to respect the event’s schedule, including arriving on time for their performance. Any late arrivals may forfeit their slot in favor of those who are on time. By adhering to these selection criteria, we aim to ensure a smooth, fair, and enjoyable experience for all participants in the Open Mic Show.Schedule: March 21 & 28, 2025; April 04, 11, 18 & 25, 2025(Every Friday) For Registration, Kindly fill the google form at https://forms.gle/bNd7fJe6SDM7gncG7 For More Info, Kindly contact Dr. Bhumika Sharma, Assistant Professor, LPU(UID:32676), BL 13-211.

title: ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES FOR ACADEMIC SESSION 2025-2026 (3/12/2025)
body: Online Allotment Process for Residential Facilities i.e. Residence, Mess, Gym, and Laundry for existing students with Active Academic Status (Admission Batch 2024 or earlier) is going to start from 10th March 2025 for session 2025-26. Students can book the residential facility with Early Decision Benefit (upto Rs. 10,000/-) till 30th Apr. 2025. To ensure accessibility and affordability of the students, hostel charges for most categories remain unchanged from last year. Allotment of residential facilities will be done in 2 Phases as mentioned below: Phases Process Start Date End Date Eligibility Phase-1 Allotment of Residential Services (Without Token Amount) Round -I At 05:30 PM on 10th March 2025 At 11:59 PM on 31st March 2025 Students Having CGPA 08 or Above (For both Boys & Girls) Round –II At 05:30 PM on 11th March 2025 For all Girls Round –III At 05:30 PM on 12th March 2025 For all Boys Phase-2 Allotment of Residential Services (With Token Amount of Rs. 10000/-) At 12:00 AM on 01st April 2025 NA All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) Payment of Residential Charges Token Amount Students who booked the residential facility in Phase-1 (Till 31st March 2025) will have to pay the minimum token amount of Rs. 10000/- by 07th April 2025 to secure EDB and booked hostel seat. In case of failure to make the payment the hostel seat of students may be cancelled as per refund guidelines. 50% of Residential Charges All the students (Phase-I & Phase-II) will have to pay 50% residential charges on or before 15 June 2025 to secure EDB on residential facilities. In case of failure to make the payment the EDB benefit will be forfeited. Students who are unable to pay 50% of residential charges till 15 June 2025 will have to pay that amount by 30th June 2025. In case of failure to make the payment the hostel seat of students may be cancelled as per refund guidelines. 100% Residential Charges Students have to pay complete residential charges on or before reporting in the hostel. Booking can be done through “Hostel Booking” option available on UMS Dashboard or by visiting: UMS Navigation >> Residential Services >> Residential Facilities Booking >> Hostel Booking There are 3 options available on this interface that a student can choose: 1) INDIVIDUAL BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat for their own. 2) GROUP BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat along with their friends. Student can choose his/her roommates by selecting group booking option (Validation of group members has to be done using the OTP sent to individual group member’s “My message” on UMS). 3) WAITLIST: This option is applicable for the situation if student is unable to book the desired hostel/seater. EDB benefits will not be applicable on Waitlist request, rather these benefits will be applicable according the date of actual booking the residential services. Waitlist request can be submitted under following scenarios: a. Waitlist (Hostel Not Booked):- In case student have not booked the hostel due to non-availability of preferred hostel/ seater, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. b. Waitlist (Hostel Already Booked):- In case student have already booked the hostel seat but still want to change the booked seat and the desired hostel/ seater is not available, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. Allotment for Residential Scholarship Holder:- Allotment will be separately managed by OMC-DRS (Block 29-301) (based on the details provided by the concerned departments i.e Sports or Cultural) for students awarded hostel charges waiver under any scholarship scheme (like Sports, Cultural, Board topper etc.), such students need not to participate in the Allotment Process of Residential Facilities. Changes in the booked residential facilities: - Option to change booked hostel seat will be provided to students after 01st April 2025. Students can change their booked hostel seat without any shifting charges once in a complete academic session. Its programs include providing scholarships to deserving students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, supporting remedial education to bridge learning gaps, and enhancing foundational learning and numeracy skills. The bank partners with various organizations and institutions to implement these programs, focusing on creating sustainable and impactful change in the lives of underprivileged children. Through these focused educational initiatives, IndusInd Bank aims to empower students and contribute to building a brighter future. title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250311/0006 (3/11/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. The last date of registration has been extended on student's request. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 16- March-2025.The time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. body: We are excited to announce the launch of our Peer-Tutoring led Coding Workshops, providing students with the opportunity to develop essential programming skills through hands-on, interactive learning sessions. These workshops are designed to enhance technical proficiency, problem-solving abilities, and real-world coding experience for the students. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. body: Punjab State Council for Science & Technology (PSCST) has launched the Capstone Program under the Punjab State Innovation Council, aimed at connecting students from scientific and engineering disciplines with industry to address real-time industrial challenges. PSCST has conducted extensive mapping of Punjab's tech-intensive industries and identified 29 real-world industrial challenges for which students can develop workable solutions. Benefits of Participation: . Exposure to real-world industrial challenges . Opportunity to work directly with industry experts . Enhance problem-solving and innovation skills Eligible disciplines include: i. Engineering (Diploma/BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech/Ph.D.) or ii. Sciences (M.Sc./Ph.D.) Team Composition: i. Students from Diploma /Undergraduate are encouraged to apply as a team comprising 3–5 members. ii. The Postgraduate & Ph.D. students may submit application individually. iii. The application for Capstone Project to have mentor from same Host Institution. How to Apply: Students must submit their applications in the prescribed format. The advertisement and background details and other details can be downloaded from the official website https://pscst.punjab.gov.in: Last Date for Application Submission: 15th March 2025 Funding Support Funding support of Rs. 0.75-1 Lac including fellowship (upto 40% of Grant), contingency, travel to be provided per Capstone Project by PSCST. Academic Benefits under EDU Revolution: student shall be eligible for i. Course Equivalence and/or Grade Upgradation depending upon the status of project. ii. Duty leaves in case they are allocated the project Selection Process i. The initial screening of applications will be done by a committee formulated by PSCST ii. The screened applications will be evaluated by the Expert Group for selection of Capstone projects. iii. The result be released on website of PSCST. Capstone Project Timeline i. Timeline for Completion of Project is max. 1 year. Students are encouraged to submit the solution at earliest. ii. Mid-Term Review of Capstone Project be conducted to record progress and take industry feedback. iii. Final Review be conducted at project completion to evaluate outcomes and industry impact. iv. Certificate for 'Innovation Fellowship' be issued to students who successfully complete their Capstone Projects. Encourage innovation, solve real challenges, and make a difference!

title: ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES FOR ACADEMIC SESSION 2025-2026 (3/10/2025)
body: Online Allotment Process for Residential Facilities i.e. Residence, Mess, Gym, and Laundry for existing students with Active Academic Status (Admission Batch 2024 or earlier) is going to start from 10th March 2025 for session 2025-26. Students can book the residential facility with Early Decision Benefit (upto Rs. 10,000/-) till 30th Apr. 2025. To ensure accessibility and affordability of the students, hostel charges for most categories remain unchanged from last year. Allotment of residential facilities will be done in 2 Phases as mentioned below: Phases Process Start Date End Date Eligibility Phase-1 Allotment of Residential Services (Without Token Amount) Round -I At 05:30 PM on 10th March 2025 At 11:59 PM on 31st March 2025 Students Having CGPA 08 or Above (For both Boys & Girls) Round –II At 05:30 PM on 11th March 2025 For all Girls Round –III At 05:30 PM on 12th March 2025 For all Boys Phase-2 Allotment of Residential Services (With Token Amount of Rs. 10000/-) At 12:00 AM on 01st April 2025 NA All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) Payment of Residential Charges Token Amount Students who booked the residential facility in Phase-1 (Till 31st March 2025) will have to pay the minimum token amount of Rs. 10000/- by 07th April 2025 to secure EDB and booked hostel seat. In case of failure to make the payment the hostel seat of students may be cancelled as per refund guidelines. 50% of Residential Charges All the students (Phase-I & Phase-II) will have to pay 50% residential charges on or before 15 June 2025 to secure EDB on residential facilities. In case of failure to make the payment the EDB benefit will be forfeited. Students who are unable to pay 50% of residential charges till 15 June 2025 will have to pay that amount by 30th June 2025. In case of failure to make the payment the hostel seat of students may be cancelled as per refund guidelines. 100% Residential Charges Students have to pay complete residential charges on or before reporting in the hostel. Important Point Students who are not opting for the residential facility will be required to submit their PG/Rented/Private Accommodation details as per guidelines of UGC, Police and other local authorities. Residential Facilities will be provided till the end of the regular academic session including regular exams or 10 months from the start of the session, whichever is earlier. Students may check the complete process of booking through demo video as mentioned in following link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AmvWn-8DJlA Students must go through the attachments for rest other details i.e. Residential Charges, Refund Guidelines or Step by Step Booking Process. Attachment: 1. Charges For Residential Facilities 2025-26.pdf 2. Refund Guidelines Session 2025-2026.pdf 3. Steps To Book Residential Facility.pdf For any query students may visit Residential Query Window: Block 32 Basement, Window No. 03, or lodge RMS on UMS through following path: UMS Navigation >> Relationship Management System (RMS) >> Log Request >> Academic & Administrative Issues >> Select Message Type "Grievance" >> Search by category "Residential Services (Hostel Allotment/ Transfer) : Hostel Allotment" category. body: This is for the information of all students, faculty and staff members that the University Library has subscribed the “MyDiscovery” Service from TDNet, which is a federated search tool system for academic resources and databases. Federated search allows users to search across multiple databases, catalogs, or content repositories simultaneously from a single search interface. These resources will be highly useful for all students, research scholars as well as faculty members. All students, faculty and staff members are encouraged to maximize the utilization of this facility. Note: This service is available to all students, faculty and staff members, both within and outside the campus. How to access? On-Site Access: (Within Campus) The discovery tool is accessible on all public computers within the library or via Wi-Fi for users with their own devices. Kindly visit the link (https://lpu.mydiscovery.xyz/) Outside Campus (Remote Access) a. Visit the link https://lpu.mapmyaccess.com/ b. On the landing page, click on LOGIN and select the Option to login via “UMS CREDENTIALS”. c. Sign in with your UMS CREDENTIALS (UMS User ID and Password). d. Click on My Discovery Additionally, please refer to the information manual attached herewith for step-wise guide on accessing the e-resources and also MyDiscovery Tutorial Video. If a student, faculty or staff member is facing difficulty in accessing the e-resources through this portal, they may put an query log RMS at: UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Transactions ---> Log Request Category: Library Subcategory: Online Database/E-Resources To find out more about LPU library services and resources or for any feedback please visit at: https://www.lpu.in/academics/libraries.php

title: SVAR and WriteX Assessments for all placement registered students of 2026 graduating batch : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250306/0001 (3/6/2025)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled the AMCAT SVAR and WriteX Assessments from 13th March to 16th March 2025 for all placement registered students of 2026 graduating batch. These assessments are important for you in terms of placement perspective. Good performance in these assessments will play a vital role in creating career opportunities for you. Therefore, it is essential to approach these assessments with complete enthusiasm. About SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess Student's Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. A crucial test essential for Interviews or Client based Interaction Profiles. Based on CEFR Levels. About WriteX: The only Written English Test driven on Machine Learning to help you in assessing the overall quality of a candidate's written sample. major factors that attribute towards the construction of a great write-up like grammar, usage, mechanics, style, organization and development etc. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Both assessments are mandatory for every student, as per the attached list. 2. Both SVAR and WriteX Assessments will remain open from 13th March (9AM) to 16th March (11PM). You can attempt any Assessment at any time within the given time span but make sure once you start an assessment then complete it in one go without taking a break. 3. Assessments will be conducted online in Auto Proctored mode. You can appear it in from your own location. 4. The total combined duration of both assessments is approximately 60 minutes. 5. Reattempt / Reschedule is not allowed. Therefore kindly follow the Assessment instructions carefully before starting your assessment. 6. For WRITEX Assessment instructions, kindly visit at: http://tinyurl.com/writexexaminstructions 7. For SVAR Assessment instructions, kindly visit at: http://tinyurl.com/svarexaminstructions 8. Duty Leaves will not be provided. Therefore attempt the assessments accordingly. 9. Absence in any of this Assessment will lead you towards debarment from placement services. Therefore make sure you participate in both assessments with full enthusiasm. 10. Assessments credentials will be shared with you via UMS My messages on 12th March.

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Geospatial Technologies: Theory, Practice and Future Directions : LPU/13.2/OMC/2024/005(Vol-1)/IC/250306/0001 (3/6/2025)
body: Registrations are open for the Short Term Course on Geospatial Technologies: Theory, Practice, and Future Directions, organized by the Centre for Space Science (R&D Cell) in collaboration with Human Resource Development Center at Lovely Professional University. The course covers fundamental and advanced concepts of satellite remote sensing, GIS, and GPS technologies. Participants will explore the integration of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in geospatial data analysis. The curriculum emphasizes practical applications in agriculture, disaster management, and environmental monitoring. This course will equip participants with essential skills for addressing real-world challenges using geospatial technologies. The following are the details of the course: Title Short Term Course on Geospatial Technologies: Theory, Practice and Future Directions Course Outcomes After completion of the course, participants will be able to: 1. Understand core principles of satellite remote sensing, GIS, GNSS, and their applications. 2. Gain practical experience in data acquisition, image processing, and spatial analysis using open tools. 3. Learn how artificial intelligence and machine learning enhance geospatial data interpretation and decision-making. 4. Apply geospatial technologies in agriculture, disaster management, and environmental monitoring For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Persons Dr. AK Saraf, Professor, Earth Science, IIT Roorkee Dr. Ajanta Goswami, Associate Professor, Earth Science, IIT Roorkee Dr. Reet Kamal Tiwari, Associate Professor, Civil Engineering, IIT Ropar, Ropar, Punjab Dr. Mahesh Pal, Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Kurukshetra, Haryana Dr. Markand Oza, Former Scientist SG, Content Generation and Data Dissemination, Space Application Centre, ISRO, Ahmedabad Dr. Kumar Gaurav, Associate Professor, Earth Sciences, IISER , Bhopal Dr. Rishitosh Sinha, Scientist SE, Planetary Science, Physical Research Laboratory, Department of Space, Ahmedabad Dr. R.K Setia, Scientist E, Remote Sensing, Punjab Remote Sensing Centre, Ludhiana Dr. Kavita Mitkari, Post-Doctoral Fellow, Space Science and Engineering Centre, University of Wisconsin-Madison, USA Dr. Har Amrit Singh Sandhu, Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering, Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh Dr. Swati Sharma, Assistant Professor, Amity School of Natural Resources and Sustainable Development, Amity University , NOIDA , UP Dr. Himanshu Kumar, Research Analyst, Fodder area development, Amul India, Anand, Gujarat Dr. Vandana Chabra, Associate Professor, School of Agriculture, LPU Dr. Prakash Singh Tanwar, Associate Professor, School of Electronics and Electrical Engineering, LPU Dr. Rohan Kumar, Associate Professor, Centre for Space Science, RDC, LPU Date and Time Date: March 24, 2025 to March 29, 2025 (Monday to Saturday) Time: 9:30 am to 05:00 pm (IST) Platform (Mode Online) https://myclass.lpu.in/ Registration Fee LPU UG/PG Students - body: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to present an exciting opportunity for LPU students to join the HSE University St. Petersburg Summer School 2025. This program offers high-quality learning experiences with international faculty while allowing students to explore St. Petersburg’s rich historical and cultural heritage and enhance their academic knowledge in a dynamic international setting.
