title: Establishment of the Student Education Revolution Board. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)/IC/250305/0043 (3/5/2025)
body: Dear Students, Join the Student Education Revolution Board! Objective: The University is establishing a Student Education Revolution Board that is aimed at transforming the educational landscape by encouraging student engagement, collaboration, and leadership. Through this initiative, the University seeks to empower students to play an active role in shaping the future of education. Why join the Student Education Revolution Board? . Be a part of active decision making . Provide innovative inputs for academic improvement, teaching innovation, course updates, and integration of AI and other emerging technologies . Introduce and implement gamification strategies in curriculum and pedagogy . Experience improved industry-academia collaboration for real-world exposure . Gain hands-on experience in career development, research, and student engagement . Highlight School events and achievements through a strong social media presence . Build clear strategies for improving student engagement and community building initiatives . Opportunity to work in teams and coordinate with peers and faculty Composition of Student Education Revolution Board The Board is divided into the following four Committees Student Academic Gamification Advisory Committee Student Career and Start-up Command Committee Student Research and Innovation Committee Student Campus Connect Committee Please note: 1. For each School, every Committee shall have Student Co-ordinator(s) and Student Members. 2. The Student Education Revolution Board shall operate under the guidance of the Faculty Leadership Board (Details given in the attached Guidelines). Student Selection Criteria: 1. Common eligibility criteria for selection across all Committees . CGPA of 6.5 or above with no pending or fail grades . No record of disciplinary action 2. Committee wise eligibility criteria: Student Academic Gamification Advisory Committee While shortlisting students, preference shall be given to students with the following attributes/experience for this Committee. 1. Interest in Academic Reforms – Keen on contributing to education-focused initiatives and improvements. 2. Tech Enthusiasts & Gamers – Passionate about creating innovative educational tools. 3. Participation in Academic Competitions – Engaged in events like Hackathons, Robotics, Coding, Graphic Design contests etc. 4. Certifications & MOOCs – Completed relevant online courses or certifications. 5. Internship Experience – Has undertaken an internship. 6. Leadership & Extracurricular Activities – Held leadership roles or actively contributed to extracurricular activities. 7. Availability – Open to working on campus beyond regular hours. Student Career and Start-up Command Committee 1. Student should have registered for sitting in Placements. (mandatory) While shortlisting students, preference shall be given to students with the following attributes/experience for this Committee. 2. Entrepreneurial Achievement – Successfully generated revenue from an entrepreneurship venture. 3. Competitions & Events – Participation in business competitions (e.g., case study challenges, pitch events). 4. Work Experience – Internship or work experience relevant to start-ups or industries. 5. Leadership – Leadership roles in career-oriented clubs. 6. Certifications – Completion of certifications in entrepreneurship, finance, or innovation. 7. Entrepreneurial Interest – Demonstrated interest in start-ups or entrepreneurship. 8. Availability – Open to working on campus beyond regular hours Student Research and Innovation Committee While shortlisting students, preference shall be given to students with the following attributes/experience for this Committee. 1. Research Experience – Prior involvement in research projects or publications. 2. Competitions & Conferences – Participation in research competitions or conferences. 3. Coursework & Certifications – Completion of relevant coursework or certifications related to research methodologies. 4. Innovation & Exploration – Open to exploring new technologies. 5. Availability – Open to working on campus beyond regular hours Student Campus Connect Committee While shortlisting students, preference shall be given to students with the following attributes/experience for this Committee. 1. Student Engagement – Active involvement in student organisations or clubs. 2. Leadership Experience – Held leadership positions in the University, such as serving as a Class Representative, or demonstrated strong leadership abilities. 3. Event Management – Experience as an event organizer or manager. 4. Digital Strategy – Skilled in social media tactics, including crafting digital campaigns. 5. Community Contribution – Participation in community service or outreach programs. 6. Communication Skills – Strong communication and interpersonal abilities. 7. Inclusivity & Diversity – Commitment to promoting inclusivity and diversity on campus. 8. Availability – Open to working on campus beyond regular hours How to Apply? . Self-Nomination: Fill out the online application form through the Student Education Revolution Board Interface UMS Path for Self-Nomination: Login to your UMS account: LMS Student Education Revolution Board Nomination . Nomination by HOS/COS: Your Head of School (HOS/COS) can nominate you through the Student Education Revolution Board Interface (Details shall be communicated by your respective HOS/COS.) Please go through the guidelines attached with this communication for understanding in detail the expected outcome from the Student Education Revolution Board and other important details. For any queries, contact your respective HOS/COS. Don’t miss this opportunity! This is your chance to be a warrior for change and help shape the future of learning.

title: Announcement: Call for Proposals – Australia-India Strategic Research Fund (AISRF) Collaborative Research Projects (Round 16) : LPU/9.1/SPRO/2024/014/IC/250305/0001 (3/5/2025)
body: LPU researchers are invited to apply for the Australia-India Strategic Research Fund (AISRF) – Collaborative Research Projects (Round 16), a prestigious funding opportunity under the Indo-Australian Biotechnology Fund. This initiative, jointly managed by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India, and the Department of Industry, Science, and Resources (DISR), Government of Australia, aims to foster cutting-edge research collaborations between Indian and Australian scientists. Key Details: o Deadline for submission: 11th April 2025 o Research Focus Areas: Biomanufacturing (biochemicals, biofuels, novel bio-based materials) Biotechnology for agricultural productivity and climate resilience RNA vaccines and biotherapeutics (immunotherapy) o Eligibility: Public and private universities, research institutions, and recognized not-for-profit organizations in India Indian and Australian teams must jointly apply Projects must align with the fund’s objectives and demonstrate strong collaboration o Project Duration: Up to 3 years o Funding Coverage: Equipment, manpower, consumables, travel, contingency, and overheads Why Apply? Establish international research partnerships with leading Australian institutions Access substantial funding to advance impactful scientific innovations ü Contribute to solutions for global challenges in biotechnology and biomanufacturing For further details and application guidelines, visit: https://dbtindia.gov.in/sites/default/files/Indo-Australia%20Round%2016.pdf

body: Inter School Powerlifting (Men/Women) Tournament - General Sports Championship organised by LPU Sports Council, Division of Sports, Student Welfare Wing, LPU where athletes will showcase their strength and technique in three main lifts: the squat, bench press, and deadlift. Each participant is required to perform these lifts in their maximum possible weight, following specific rules and guidelines for form and execution. The lifters will be categorised by weight class, age group, and gender, to ensure fair competition. Competition Format: Lifters will have three attempts per lift and their highest successful attempt in each lift is recorded. The total of the highest successful squat, bench press, and deadlift attempts is summed up to determine the lifter’s overall total. The lifter with the highest total in each weight class wins. The lifts will be judged by a panel of referees who ensure the lifter follows the required technique and performs each movement correctly. If any part of the lift doesn’t meet the standards, it is considered a "no lift," and the attempt is disqualified. body: Under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club Bosch of School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Voices of Persuasion: The Ultimate Group Discussion Showdown”. This event aims to encourage participants to enhance their communication and public speaking skills through engaging and structured discussions. In this competition, students will be divided into groups of 10. Each group will be given a topic and will have 1 minute to think and prepare their points of view. Following this, each group will have 10 minutes to present their perspectives on the given topic. title: Battle of Wits 12.0: A sustainable development goals competitive Ideathon : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250301/0009 (3/1/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Battle of Wits 12.0: A sustainable development goals competitive Ideathon” This competition will be a battle of innovation, strategy, and impactful solutions! Participants will be presented with real-world problem statements based on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and will be required to develop and present innovative, feasible, and impactful solutions in the form of presentations. The objective of this event will encourage students to think critically about global challenges, foster a culture of problem-solving and innovation, and promote structured and impactful presentation skills. Through this event, participants will not only enhance their analytical and research skills but also learn how to effectively communicate their ideas, work collaboratively, and develop sustainable solutions to some of the world's most pressing issues. The main objectives of the event are: · To enhance participants' problem-solving and critical thinking abilities by analyzing real-world SDG challenges. · To help participants develop confidence in presenting innovative ideas with clarity, logic, and impact. · To improve participants' research, collaboration, and communication skills by working on structured solutions and delivering compelling presentations. Target audience: The students of Girls Hostel–4 will participate in the event. Date: 6th March, 2025 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Girls Hostel-4 Resource Person: 1) Ms. Tamanna Kaur 2) Ms. Laxmi Devi

title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250301/0004 (3/1/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. The last date of registration has been extended on student's request. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 10- March-2025. The time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 10-March-2025 Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in/Details/553/JudiciaryExamPreparationCourse For queries: Dr. Amandeep Singh Block 29-203D

title: College Youth Ideathon | Give wings to your startup dreams : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250228/0002 (2/28/2025)
body: Department of Student Research and Project, Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Student Welfare Wing, Lovely Professional University is informing the LPU students that- The College Youth Ideathon is a dynamic joint initiative by Management Entrepreneurship Professional Skills Council (MEPSC), IIT Delhi and the ThinkStartup The College Youth Ideathon aimed at fostering innovation and entrepreneurship among college students across India. This groundbreaking competition shifts the focus from traditional academics to nurturing a “job-creator’s mindset,” encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and proactive thinking. As India’s premier platform for youth-driven innovation, the Ideathon features a multi-stage format that guides students through ideation, prototyping, and pitching their innovative solutions to industry experts. College Youth Ideathon event schedule WHO IS IT FOR? The College Youth Ideathon has four stakeholders – College Students, Teachers and Universities and Colleges. It is OPEN for registration for following categories: College students from any university or autonomous institution operating in India However, participation is only allowed in teams of 2 to 5 members. Teachers and Mentors of College Students-College Youth Ideathon have an open platform even for college teachers and mentors provided they have a team of students they are mentoring. YI25 provides special rewards for teachers in the fields of innovation and entrepreneurship. Principals will act as institutional champions for the Ideathon, driving student and faculty participation, promoting the program's importance, and ensuring access to essential resources and mentorship for success. Colleges / Universities or autonomous institution - Colleges will serve as central hubs, facilitating team formation, providing mentorship, and supporting students with resources, workshops, and infrastructure to foster entrepreneurial growth. COLLEGE YOUTH IDEATHON THEMES The College Youth Ideathon shall focus on innovative ideas and entrepreneurship around following key themes, as below: Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance Geospatial Intelligence Technology Education Sustainability E-commerce, D2C & Retail Travel & Tourism Food & Beverage Agriculture Medicine & BioTech (Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Healthcare IT, Biotechnology) College Youth Ideathon will encourage students to identify societal and industrial challenges, collaborate across disciplines, and develop solutions that not only address immediate issues but also pave the way for sustainable and scalable impact Benefits:- The benefits of College Youth Ideathon are as below: Cultivate a “Job Creator’s Mindset” by fostering a culture of innovation, risk taking, and entrepreneurialism among college students. Nurture high potential student ideas with incubation support Inspire college students to think innovatively and embrace entrepreneurship. Encourage the development of prototypes and scalable solutions. Offer a platform for interdisciplinary collaboration and learning for college students Activate and foster a vibrant Entrepreneurial Ecosystem by recognizing and nurturing promising ideas with financial grants and incubation support. Bridge the gap between Academia and Industry by facilitating collaborations between students, faculty, industry mentors, and investors. Recognise efforts of motivated college teachers / mentors and institutions who are working behind the scenes to develop entrepreneurship in colleges · Chance to WIN cash prize of 25 Lac and also chance to WIN Incubation Grant up to 50 Lac. · Last Date of Submission of Idea Submission = 4th March 2025. · Fees= NIL · Registration link: https://youthideathon.in/ · Also fill the detail on Link for updates: https://forms.gle/NEQCkUQLXr7mw5Vi9 For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

title: Unlock Your Idea's Potential: Join Our Innovation Idea Incubation support Program : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250227/0001 (2/27/2025)
body: Lovely Professional University is happy to announce the launching of the Idea Management System Portal-a platform designed to empower and support your innovative, entrepreneurial, and start-up ideas! The Idea Management System portal aims to create an environment that nurtures creativity, fosters entrepreneurship, and supports the development of ground breaking initiatives, paving the way for them to be transformed into successful realities. Student may avail the following benefits after successful processing and approval of their Idea:- 1. Mentoring and Guidance: Eligible ides will receive personalized mentoring and guidance from experienced professionals, fostering their growth and enhancing the viability of their projects. 2. 24/7 Access to the Innovation Studio: The IMS ensures round-the-clock accessibility to the Innovation Studio, providing a conductive environment for students to collaborate, experiment, and bring their ideas to fruition. 3. IPR Generation and Research Publication Guidance: Students will benefit from expert guidance on intellectual property Right (IPR) generation and assistance in navigating the process of research publication, enhancing the visibility and impact of their work. 4. Dedicated Workspace Allocation: Successful idea submission will result in the allocation of dedicated space for students to actively pursue the development of their concept. 5. Lab Resources and Tools Support: The IMS extents support by proving access to essential laboratory resources and tools required for the practical implementation of innovative ideas. 6. Granting of Duty Leaves : Students with promising idea may be eligible for duty leaves, facilitating dedicated times for them to focus on advancing their projects. 7. Financial Support Based on Feasibility: Depending on the feasibility assessment of the idea, funding opportunities will be made available to students to support the implementation and execution of their innovation projects. Here’s how the process works: 1. Submit Your Ideas: Log in to the portal and submit your innovative, entrepreneurial, or start-up ideas. title: Participate in GREEN Olympiad for Youth (GO4Youth) 2025. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)/IC/250226/0109 (2/26/2025)
body: Dear students, The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) has launched GREEN Olympiad for Youth (GO4Youth) 2025. This year GO4Youth (an annual multiple-choice question (MCQ)-based examination) has taken an interdisciplinary approach covering key areas such as the framework for Eco-Friendly and Sustainable Campus Development in HEIs (SATAT), Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), Net Zero, along with other national priority schemes. This initiative aims to align with the National Education Policy (NEP) and integrate environmental awareness into higher education while enhancing students’ understanding of key sustainability issues. Why Participate? . Expand your knowledge on science, technology, policy, and sustainable development. . Learn about national initiatives like Mission LiFE and Unnat Bharat Abhiyan. . Get a chance to win cash prizes and merit certificates. . Access internship opportunities and build your environment portfolio. . Join TERI’s youth network and connect with like-minded individuals. GO4Youth Exam Details: . Mode: Online (English/Hindi) . Format: 50 MCQs | No negative marking | 60 minutes . Eligibility: Students aged 18-30 years, enrolled in Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) in India Key Dates: . Registration is now open and the last date of registration is till March 10, 2025 . Examination Dates: April 7 – 11, 2025 Rewards & Benefits: . E-Certificates for all participants . Merit and distinction e-certificates for rank holders . Cash awards for the top three positions . Membership in TERI’s youth network . Internships opportunities at TERI and other renowned institutions. Development of an impressive environment portfolio. How to Register? Students can visit the website http://greenolympiad4youth.com/ and register for the exam.

title: Battle of Wits 6.0: A Competitive Group Discussion Bootcamp : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250220/0012 (2/20/2025)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Division of Residential Services is going to conduct “Battle of Wits 6.0: A Competitive Group Discussion Bootcamp”. The competition will be a clash of ideas, opinions, and perspectives! The Group Discussion Battlefield is a dynamic platform where students will engage in intense, moderated discussions on pressing topics, testing their communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills which will help them prepare for the interviews. The objective of this event is to teach the students how to perform in the group discussions, foster a culture of constructive debate, encourage active listening, and promote effective articulation of thoughts. By participating in the Group Discussion, students will not only hone their skills but also gain confidence in expressing their opinions, respecting differing viewpoints, and emerging as articulate, empathetic, and informed individuals. The main objectives of the event are: · To enhance participants ability to involve in critical thinking and analysis · To help participants overcome stage fright, nervousness, and self-doubt to become more confident and charismatic speakers during group discussion rounds of interviews. · To improve participants ability of effective communication and articulation. Target audience: The students of Boys Hostel –1 will participate in the event. Date: 24th February, 2025 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Boys Hostel – 1 Resource Person: 1) Ms. Kawaljit Kaur 2) Mr. Divay

title: National Recognition for Ph.D. Scholars – Apply for UGC’s Ph.D. Excellence Citation Award. : LPU/10.2/ANN/2024/023/IC/250218/0012 (2/18/2025)
body: Centre for Research Degree Programmes is pleased to invite applications for the Ph.D. Excellence Citation 2024, instituted by the University Grants Commission (UGC). This award recognizes exceptional doctoral research and honours scholars whose work significantly contributes to knowledge creation and societal impact. About the Award The Ph.D. Excellence Citation promotes high-quality research by identifying outstanding doctoral theses across various academic disciplines. Selected scholars will be honoured at a national-level felicitation ceremony organized by UGC. Eligibility Criteria . Ph.D. must have been successfully awarded between January 1, 2024, and December 31, 2024. . The thesis must be publicly accessible on the INFLIBNET repository. . The research must demonstrate originality, innovation, and impact in one of the following categories: i. Sciences (including Agricultural & Medical Sciences) ii. Engineering & Technology iii. Social Sciences (including Education & Humanities) iv. Indian Languages v. Commerce & Management . The scholar must have significant publications or patents derived from their Ph.D. work. Selection Process at LPU . An internal screening committee will review and shortlist the five best theses (one per category) for nomination. . Evaluation will be based on: i. Originality and innovation in research ii. Methodological rigor and research quality iii. Impact and contribution to academic and societal progress iv. Publications or patents arising from the Ph.D. work v. Quality of thesis defense and presentation Application Process Scholars must submit the following documents for internal evaluation via the google link provided in the end: i. Copy of the Ph.D. thesis ii. List of research publications or patents related to the Ph.D. work iii. Synopsis of the research contribution (maximum 500 words that includes novelty of work and impact) Last Date of Submission: February, 28th 2025 How to Apply? a. Submit your thesis and relevant details and proof of publication for internal evaluation by February 28, 2025, via google form link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/10vFIOkJZ_bIhPQ1RoxyT5hYJu4-vU2wI3y4KFkzy7wI/edit b. This is an opportunity to showcase your research at the highest level and bring national recognition to your work. Apply now! For more details and submission guidelines, please visit Dr. Oriza Kamboj in 38 202. Or, you may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request---> Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] -- > Category [International Research Exchange Program/International Co-Supervision Program] We look forward to receiving your applications and witnessing the fruitful collaborations that will undoubtedly emerge from this unique experience.

title: Call for Application for Fellowship Grant from The Royal Norwegian Embassy in New Delhi to Accelerate Community Innovations in Battery Energy Storage in India : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250211/0004 (2/11/2025)
body: The Department of Student Research and Project, Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship-Student Welfare Wing is informing the students that the The Royal Norwegian Embassy in New Delhi, in collaboration with Innovation Norway, Atal Incubation Centres (AICs), and TERI, invites applications for the Fellowship Grant to Accelerate Community Innovations in Battery Energy Storage in India. The fellowship programme is supported by The Royal Norwegian Embassy in New Delhi and Innovation Norway in collaboration with AIC-SMU Technology Business Incubation Foundation (AIC-SMUTBI). Shortlisted proposals will receive mentorship and financial support to advance their innovations. The fellowship programme consists of two phases, each lasting 3 months. During this time, each candidate will be hosted at an AIC-SMUTBI (Atal Incubation Centre Sikkim Manipal University Technology Business Incubation Foundation) and The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), New Delhi. They will gain awareness of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), develop entrepreneurial skills, and explore concepts of the circular economy. A total of 12 fellowships will be awarded. The mode of mentoring will be online. Who can Apply: · Aspiring innovators, entrepreneurs, and researchers in the field of energy storage. · Students and working professionals. · Communities in underrepresented and underserved regions. · Women innovators and entrepreneurs. Eligibility Criteria: · Applicant must be an Indian citizen. · Applicant must be 18-year-old or above. · Open to all educational backgrounds. · Applicant must have a valid PAN card. Applicant must be a resident or working in one of the following states/regions, or the idea must already be implemented or have the potential to be implemented in any of the following states/regions: · Arunachal Pradesh · Assam · Manipur · Meghalaya · Mizoram · Nagaland · Tripura · Sikkim · Gender equity is encouraged. · Candidates with ideas at the MVP (Minimum Viable Product) stage will be given preference Application Deadline: 25th Feb 2025 The web link for applying the program is: https://fellowship.amityincubator.com/ You are also requested to fill this google form also for the smooth communication with the participants for more updates Link: - https://forms.gle/gCkGLL4e2h2GhyVE8 For any query please contact: -Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

title: Expression Unlocked: A Non-Competitive Event on Tone and Mood Mastery : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/250210/0008 (2/10/2025)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “Visionary Minds” of Mittal School of Business is going to conduct “Expression Unlocked: A Non-Competitive Event on Tone and Mood Mastery”. This event aims to sharpen students skills in conveying emotions and intent through vocal expression. In this event, participants will read selected dialogues, focusing on delivering the correct intonation, pitch, and mood. Listeners will then assess each performance, identifying the tone and mood conveyed to determine if the speaker has successfully communicated the intended message. Expression Unlocked provides a unique opportunity for students to refine their vocal delivery, improve their ability to interpret and express emotions, and enhance their overall communication skills, making their spoken messages more impactful and engaging. The main objectives of the event are: · To enhance vocal delivery and intonation skills. · To improve the ability to convey and interpret emotions effectively. · To build confidence in delivering impactful and engaging spoken messages. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Registration is invited for the Short-Term Course on Simulation Expertise with ANSYS. Learners will be able to identify and define engineering problems that can be effectively solved using ANSYS simulations. Converting ideas into a concepts that can be presented to others Participants will acquire the skills to create accurate 3D models, apply boundary conditions, and perform simulations to analyze physical phenomena in fields such as structural mechanics, fluid dynamics, and more. title: Professor Dr. Jaspal Singh Sandhu joined as Vice Chancellor of Lovely Professional University : LPU/13.1/HRCR/2024/009/IC/250205/0008 (2/5/2025)
body: Professor Dr. Jaspal Singh Sandhu has assumed the role of Vice Chancellor at Lovely Professional University (LPU), bringing with him 35 years of remarkable experience. His career is marked by groundbreaking contributions to sports medicine, research, and policy- making, along with a strong track record in academia and leadership. Dr. Sandhu has held several key leadership roles,including Secretary of the University Grants Commission (UGC). During his tenure at UGC, he also served as the Director of the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) and contributed to the governing bodies of multiple national and international educational organizations, such as the Consortium for Educational Communication (CEC), the Inter-University Accelerator Centre (IUAC), and UGC-DAE Consortium for Scientific Research. He is serving as Advisor (Higher Education) to the Hon'ble Governor of Punjab. Dr. Sandhu, upon stepping into the role of Vice Chancellor at LPU, shared, 'LPU has already established itself as a leader in higher education, and my vision is to build on this strong foundation. I aim to further enhance the University’s legacy of academic excellence, promote innovation, and encourage interdisciplinary learning. My focus will be on expanding LPU’s global presence, boosting research capabilities, and ensuring an enriching, transformative educational experience for all students. Dr. Sandhu is a highly accomplished academician and a renowned expert in the field of Orthopedics and Sports Medicine. He is a gold medalist graduate in medicine from Government Medical College, Amritsar. Dr. Sandhu further pursued his postgraduate studies in Sports Medicine at the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports, Patiala, where he was recognized as the university topper. With around 250 publications in national and international journals, his research contributions are widely recognized in the academic community. Dr. Sandhu during his time at Medical College Amritsar, introduced several groundbreaking courses in Sports Medicine, including the MD, Ph.D., and Masters in Physical Therapy programs which were unprecedented in India. He later served as a Professor in the Department of Sports Medicine and Physiotherapy. He then served as Vice-Chancellor at three universities during his career, including an impressive seven-plus years’ tenure at Guru Nanak Dev University (GNDU). In his illustrious career, Dr. Sandhu has been a Fellow of several prestigious academies, including the National Academy of Medical Sciences, the International Federation of Sports Medicine (the first Indian to be honored), and the Asian Federation of Sports Medicine. Dr. Sandhu’s contributions have earned him widespread recognition. He has also been elected as a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians, London, a distinction he received for his exceptional contributions to the field of sports medicine. He has also been honored with a D.Sc. (Honoris Causa) by Avinashilingam Deemed to be University, funded by the Government of India.

body: Dear Students, National Education Policy (NEP, 2020) aims to remove rigid boundaries in education, enabling students to create new possibilities for life-long learning along with enhancing inter disciplinary thinking by pursuing two academic programmes simultaneously. In order to extend the same benefit, Lovely Professional University is providing an opportunity to students to enrol in two academic programmes simultaneously. Advantage of pursuing two Academic Programmes simultaneously: Gaining Multiple Skill sets: Students can acquire multiple skill set across different disciplines or domains. Enhanced Specialization: Pursuing two academic programmes simultaneously will help students to enhance their specialisation, enabling interdisciplinary research with expanded placement opportunities. Diversified Career Planning: Knowledge of multiple fields increases career choices and opportunities. Different modes that can be adopted for pursuing two academic programmes simultaneously can be as follows: Mode I(Regular + Online/Distance) Mode III(Regular + Regular) Students of LPU who are pursuing on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are eligible to apply for an Online/Open and Distance Learning (ODL) programme offered by LPU(established eligibility criteria for admission shall be followed) Students of LPU who are pursuing on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are eligible to apply for a simultaneous another on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate programmes offered by LPU(established eligibility criteria for admission shall be followed) Instructions to avail the opportunities: For pursuing simultaneous degree, guidelines issued by UGC notice titled “Guidelines for Pursuing Two Academic Programmes Simultaneously” of April 2022 shall be followed (attached with this communication for reference). The student will be required to undergo the same rigor for both the programmes. The University will not make any adjustments in assignments and examination schedules for the students. In case a student misses any course(s) during the regular session, then they can attend summer term classes. The option of summer term classes would be as per the University policy. body: Dear Vertos, Applications are open for Google Summer of Code 2025. Google Summer of Code (GSoC) is a global, online program that brings new contributors into open source software organizations. Starting in 2005, the program's main goal was to introduce university students to open source. Company have broadened the program to include students and all new open source contributors who are at least 18 years old in applying to be GSoC Contributors as of 2022. These GSoC Contributors will join these open source communities and contribute code. From learning about the community to assisting GSoC Contributors in familiarizing themselves with the code base and testing procedures before making their code publicly available, the organizations offer mentors who serve as guides throughout the entire process! If you are a beginner to open source development or a student interested in learning about open source, this is your chance to get involved and gain experience on real-world software development projects. Goals of the Program: - Inspire developers to begin participating in open source development. - Help open source projects identify and bring in new developers. - Get more open source code written and released for the benefit of all. - Give newer developers more exposure to real-world software development. Google Summer of Code 2025 Timeline: https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/timeline For more information regarding GSoC, refer to the following links: https://opensource.googleblog.com/2025/01/google-summer-of-code-2025-is-here.html https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/ After the registration is done, fill the confirmation on the following link: https://bit.ly/CEventCon

title: Registration for Google Summer of Code 2025 : LPU/6.1/PDCE/2024/005/IC/250130/0001 (1/30/2025)
body: Google Summer of Code 2025 is back. Google Summer of Code (GSoC) is a global, online program that brings new contributors into open source software organizations. The program began in 2005 and until 2021 was focused on bringing university students into open source. Starting in 2022, they have expanded the program to welcome students and all beginner contributors to open source who are 18 years and older to apply to the program as GSoC Contributors. These GSoC Contributors will write code and become part of these open source communities while making some money along the way. The organizations provide mentors who act as guides through the entire process, from learning about the community, to helping GSoC Contributors become familiar with the code base and testing practices, to finally releasing their code for the world to use! If you are a beginner to open source development or a student interested in learning about open source, this is your chance to get involved and gain experience on real-world software development projects. The application period for the contributor is March 24 - April 8 For more information refer to the following links: https://opensource.googleblog.com/2025/01/google-summer-of-code-2025-is-here.html https://google.github.io/gsocguides/student/ After the registration is done, fill the confirmation on the following link as well: https://bit.ly/CEventCon

title: 'LIFE’S GOOD' Scholarship Program 2024: reg : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-2)/IC/250129/0061 (1/29/2025)
body: LIFE’S GOOD' Scholarship Program 2024 is a CSR initiative by LG Electronics India Private Limited to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker backgrounds. Under this scholarship program, students pursuing their undergraduate or postgraduate courses at select institutes/colleges can receive financial aid for one year to support their educational journey. This program aligns with Sustainable Development Goals 4 and 5, emphasizing quality education and gender equality. In accordance with Schedule VII of the Companies Act 2013, it gives preference to eligible female students, promoting education and championing their empowerment through inclusive learning-25 Link to apply for the Scholarship https: www.buddy4study.com/page/life-s-good-scholarship-program#singleScApply The Last date for the scholarship application is 31st January 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship Students must be pursuing undergraduate/postgraduate courses (any academic year) from colleges/institutes across India. First-year students must have scored a minimum of 60% marks in their class 12th examinations, while students in the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th years must have achieved a minimum of 60% marks in the previous academic year. Children of employees of Buddy4Study and LG Electronics India Private Limited are not eligible to participate in the scholarship. Note: Preference will be given to meritorious students, female students and students with an annual family income of not more than INR 8 lakh. Benefits:- For UG students - 50% of tuition fees or up to INR 1 lakh (whichever is lesser) For PG students - 50% of tuition fees or up to INR 2 lakh (whichever is lesser) For meritorious candidates with zero tuition fees and a family income of less than INR 8 lakhs: UG students will receive INR 50,000 PG students will receive INR 1 lakh Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: Class 12 marksheet and previous year/semester marksheet (for 2nd / 3rd / 4th year students) Government-issued address proof (e.g., Aadhaar card) Proof of family income (any one of the following documents): Income Tax Return (ITR) statement Salary slip Form 16 (if salaried) BPL/Ration Card Income proof certificate signed by Tehsildar/BDP (for rural areas) Letter/certificate from Gram Panchayat (signed and stamped) Proof of admission (college/school ID card, academic fees receipt) and fee structure Bonafide certificate from the institute Bank account details of the beneficiaries Photograph HOW TO APPLY: Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and land on the ‘Application Form Page’. Register at Buddy4Study with your email, mobile, or Gmail account if not registered. You will now be redirected to the ‘LIFE’S GOOD’ Scholarship Program 2024 application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online application form. Upload relevant documents. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->- 'LIFE’S GOOD' Scholarship Program 2024 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103 (B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

body: The public pre-submission evaluation of the Ph.D. research scholar Satbir Kour (Registration No:- 41800860), Discipline of Molecular Biology and Genetic Engineering under the supervision of Dr. Anjuvan Singh and co-supervision of Dr. Sugunakar Vuree is scheduled on 31st Jan 2025 from 12:00 PM-02:00 PM. title: Research Internship Opportunity: Reserve Bank of India Research Internship Scheme : LPU/9.1/PMOU/2024/023/IC/250127/0002 (1/27/2025)
body: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has launched the Research Internship Scheme to provide young individuals with exposure to cutting-edge research in central banking. This initiative is targeted at recent graduates aspiring to pursue a PhD in economics, banking, finance, or related fields, or those seeking roles in government research institutions or financial organizations that demand strong quantitative and analytical skills. Interns will assist RBI researchers in policy-oriented projects and papers targeted for publication in high-quality economics and finance journals. Responsibilities include compiling accurate data, applying statistical and econometric tools, and contributing to writing research and policy articles. Eligibility Criteria: -Applicants must have completed a three-year undergraduate degree with one year of postgraduate study or a four-year integrated course such as B.Tech or B.E. -Strong quantitative skills in economics, finance, statistical sciences, or expertise in computer or data analytics are required. -Programming skills or the ability to acquire them are essential. -Open to both domestic and international candidates. Application Process: -Applications are accepted twice a year, with internships commencing on January 1 and July 1. -For January internships, applications are open from July to November and reviewed in December. For July internships, applications are accepted from January to May and reviewed in June. -Candidates must submit a CV, references, and a statement of purpose via email to the relevant department: Selection Process: -A maximum of 10 interns are selected annually based on their CV, references, and statement of purpose, followed by a personal interview. -Interns are placed in departments such as DEPR, DSIM, or SRU. Duration and Location: -The internship lasts six months, extendable up to two years based on performance and RBI’s requirements. -The internship is based in Mumbai, India. Stipend and Facilities: -Interns receive a stipend of ?35,000 per month. -Office space, internet connectivity, and other support facilities are provided. -Interns must arrange their own accommodation. For further details, visit the RBI website: Take advantage of this opportunity to contribute to impactful research at the Reserve Bank of India! For inquiries, please contact Prof. Gulshan Kumar or Prof. Reji Thomas. Research Collaboration Cell, Department of Research and Innovations at Block 38-404.

title: Mahindra Saarthi Abhiyaan. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-2)/IC/250124/0035 (1/24/2025)
body: Mahindra Saarthi Abhiyaan is an initiative by Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. - Commercial Vehicles, aimed at providing financial assistance to girl children of commercial vehicle drivers. Under this scholarship, female students pursuing studies in Class 11, Class 12, vocational courses, polytechnic, diploma, ITI, or those pursuing graduation or post-graduation (in any year) after completing Class 10 will receive a one-time scholarship of Rs.10,000. Link to apply for the scholarship -: http://buddy4study.com/page/mahindra-saarthi-abhiyaan The Last date for the scholarship is 30th January 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship Girl students studying in, diploma courses, or ITI, as well as those pursuing graduation or post-graduation (in any year), are eligible to apply. Applicants must be the children/wards of truck drivers only. Students from PAN India are eligible to apply for the scholarship program. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or M&M are not eligible to participate. Note: Offline applications received from the Mahindra team will be given preference for this scholarship. Benefits One-time scholarship of ?10,000 Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: Student's Aadhaar Card (Both Sides) Marksheet of Class 10 Current Year ID Proof/Fee Receipt Father's Driving License (Both Sides) Father's Aadhaar Card (Both Sides) Bank Passbook HOW TO APPLY: 1. Click on the 'Apply Now' button. 2. Log in to Buddy4Study using a registered ID to land onto the 'Online Application Form Page'. a. If not registered - Register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile number/Gmail account 3. You will now be directed to the 'Mahindra Saarthi Abhiyaan’ application form page. 4. Click on the 'Start Application' button to initiate the application process. 5. Fill in all the required details in the online scholarship application form. 6. Upload the required documents. 7. Accept the 'Terms and Conditions' and click on 'Preview'. 8. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->- Mahindra Saarthi Abhiyaan All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103 (B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250122/0002 (1/22/2025)
body: About The Program:- The Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship 2024-25, an initiative by the Virtusa Foundation, provides financial assistance to high-achieving students from low-income backgrounds who are pursuing higher education. This program aligns with SDG4 and SDG5, emphasising affordable quality education and gender equality. Under this scholarship, students enrolled in their 1st or 2nd year of B. Tech/BE programs PAN India or from the 36 colleges, which are part of the Centre of Excellence will receive financial assistance of INR 50,000 to cover their academic expenses. Virtusa Foundation is an extension of Virtusa Corporation’s global CSR efforts. The foundation actively supports initiatives focused on enhancing healthcare, education, and environmental well-being. With this commitment, Virtusa Foundation has launched this scholarship program. Virtusa is a global leader in Digital Business Transformation, Digital Engineering, and IT outsourcing services. Through its deep industry expertise and seamless technology delivery, Virtusa helps businesses accelerate progress and achieve faster results.Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship 24-25 (PAN India). Eligibility Criteria:- Open to students in their 1st or 2nd year of B. Tech/BE courses across India. Applicants must have achieved a minimum of 70% marks in their 12th grade. The applicant’s annual family income from all sources should be below INR 6,00,000. Children of employees of Virtusa and Buddy4Study are not eligible to participate. Last of Registration:- 31-Jan-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- INR 50,000 for 1 year NOTE: This financial aid can be utilised only for various academic-related expenses, including exam fees, hostel fees, tuition fees, books, stationery, travel, data plans, laptop or tablet, food, and lodging. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/virtusa-scholarship-program Link 2 : https://forms.gle/mRtPqJ8wrNBEyGLY6 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250122/0001 (1/22/2025)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream.Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc.Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Jan-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship.The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Grammar Masters – A Quiz Competition on Parts of Speech”. It will aim to test a user s understanding and mastery of the different parts of speech in the English language. The event will emphasize how understanding the functions of different parts of speech will allow for the construction of grammatically correct and meaningful sentences. A solid grasp of parts of speech will enable individuals to express themselves more clearly and concisely in both written and spoken language. Learning about parts of speech will naturally expand vocabulary as learners will encounter and categorize new words. This event’s ultimate goal will be to make students realize the need for the fundamentals of grammar. Therefore, learning parts of speech will not just be about memorizing definitions; it will be about developing a deeper understanding of how language works, which will have far-reaching implications for communication, learning, and personal growth. The main objectives of the event are: · To reinforce the importance and application of grammatical concepts in constructing grammatically correct and meaningful sentences. · To encourage participants to develop a deeper understanding of how language functions, leading to improved clarity, conciseness, and effectiveness in both written and spoken communication. · To promote vocabulary building as participants encounter and categorize new words within the quiz context. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. title: Registration for Tuition Classes (Jan- Feb 2025) has been extended. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/250117/0158 (1/17/2025)
body: The University is dedicated to fostering your academic success and supporting you in overcoming any academic challenges faced by you in previous semesters. As part of this commitment, we are excited to introduce a special initiative of tuition classes designed specifically for: Students who feel that they have performed below expectations in the courses of First term (Autumn term) of Session 2024-25 : The marks for End Term Examination for 1st term, Session 2024-25 will be declared tentatively by 9th January 2025. The students will be able to view the course wise marks obtained and if they feel that their performance in any course is below expectations and they wish to strengthen their understanding and improve the course results, they can become part of a special initiative—tuition classes Jan-Feb 2025. Students with pending E/G grades: through tuition classes the students will have an opportunity to clear their pending E/G grades and enhance readiness for placements. The exams for registered courses will be conducted immediately after the completion of tuition classes. Key Details of the Initiative: Registration Process: Students can register for tuition classes via the University Management System (UMS) under the following path: UMS Navigation: Examination System →Exam Registration →Tuition Classes registration Registration Fee: Rs. 1000 per course (due upon registration). Once registered, fee for the selected courses will be made due in your account. 2. Class Schedule: Last Date of Registration: 20th January 2025 Start Date of Classes: 01st February, 2025 (Tentative) Course Duration: 40 hours per course (Maximum 2 hours per day). Class Timing: 50% of lectures will be scheduled during regular hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). Remaining 50% will be held during early morning (8:00 – 9:00 AM) or evening (5:00 – 6:00 PM) for greater accessibility. Course Registration Limit: Maximum of two courses per student. Classes for a particular course will be conducted only if sufficient student registrations are received for that course code. 3. Additional Support: Students will be granted duty leaves for classes overlapping with their regular schedule (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). Examinations for registered courses will be conducted immediately after the completion of tuition classes (Tentatively by Feb- March 2025) 4. Important Notes: Attendance: A minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory. Non-Refundable Fee: Once registered, the fee will be charged to your account, and no deregistration will be allowed. Additional Exam Registration: Students registering for tuition classes must ensure they register for corresponding E/G grade exams, if applicable, via the separate registration portal. This initiative is crafted to provide focused support and help you achieve your academic goals. We strongly encourage all eligible students to take advantage of this initiative. Your success is our priority, and we are dedicated to providing the resources you need to achieve your academic goals. Register before 20th January 2025 and take a step closer to your academic success! In Case of any query, student may log RMS at UMS Navigation---- RMS--- Log Request--- Student Relationship (DSR) ---- Academic Support--- Additional Tutoring classes or contact us at 01824-520150.

title: L'Oréal Brandstorm 2025 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250117/0001 (1/17/2025)
body: About L'Oréal Brandstorm is a Global Innovation Challenge, an initiative of the L'Oréal Group that aims to offer the participants an experience and an opportunity to innovate in the beauty-tech industry. It enhances participants' entrepreneurial skills and creativity skills, making them ready for the real world. The competition echoes the L’Oréal philosophy of innovation, entrepreneurship, and excellence to make beauty universal thereby defining the future. It is equally challenging as today’s evolving business landscape so you can try yourselves on a real case that businesses are facing today! We hope you will learn, innovate, and enjoy this mission! The program is supported through strong mentorship from senior management, brand managers, and HR throughout the competition journey, which is divided into domestic and international rounds. Eligibility Criteria :- Brandstorm 2025 is open to MBA students and Engineering students. Terms & Conditions:- Each participant is allowed to register for one team only· The participants can be from any specialization. Students in one team should belong to the same campus. Inter-campus teams are not allowed to participate. There is no restriction on the number of teams from an institute . Only entries submitted before the due date will be considered for evaluation. Any exception to this will be purely at the discretion of the management. If the participant is found to have plagiarized any aspect of their entry, the participant will be disqualified. The final eligibility of the participant will be subject to the discretion and approval of the management. Any extensions in the deadlines will be at the sole discretion of the management. All information related to timelines/case rules will be updated on the Unstop website and L'Oréal's Facebook, Instagram & LinkedIn pages. Last Date to Register:- Jan 27, 2025 at 23:59 PM Rewards:- National Winner :- The team securing the position of India National Winner will be extended a Pre-Placement Interview by the L'Oréal team and will also get the opportunity to compete against other national finalists from different countries in the battle for the title of International Winner in Paris. National Finalist:- All the National Finalist teams will have the opportunity to secure Pre-Placement Interviews with L'Oréal. Semi-Finalist:- Selected teams that secure a spot in the Semi-Finale will have the opportunity to secure Pre-Placement Interviews with L'Oréal. How to Register:- Link1:- https://unstop.com/competitions/loreal-brandstorm-2025-loreal-1267961?ref=LW6yhKau Link2:- https://forms.gle/34HgL5wv1mWen1jG6 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. title: Registration open for BGMI tournament by JIO Games : LPU/18.3/FAOP(STUB)/2024/002(2.1)/IC/250117/0002 (1/17/2025)
body: Hello Vertos, JIO Games, supported by Student Organization Oasis under the aegis of Division of Youth Affairs, Student Welfare Wing, LPU is thrilled to present the JioGames Experience at Lovely Professional University! This exciting event will feature a range of activities including: Hack-a-thon Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) Tournament Session on Gaming Introduction Product Development in Gaming Watch Streaming Opportunities Cloud Experience Centre Opening Academic Session And the registration for the BGMI Tournament is open, so to register follow the given steps: The team captain can either scan the attached QR code or click here https://jiogames.page.link/LyNo to install the JIO GAMES app & log in using your phone number. Create Team: Scroll down, tap the "+" icon in the Teams section, select "Create Team," choose BGMI, and save. Add Members: Add your team members using their contact numbers. Enter Game IDs: Ensure all team members update their in-game BGMI IDs. Registration: Team creator must scan the QR code to complete registration. Important Notes: Ensure all four team members are added before registration. Verify that all Game IDs are updated. Only the Team Creator can scan the QR code and register. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to participate in this thrilling experience & in case of any query, kindly contact Mr. Rahul K, Officer, Division of Youth Affairs, LPU - 9110329481. Regards

title: Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/250110/0001 (1/10/2025)
body: About The Program:- The Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship 2024-25, an initiative by the Virtusa Foundation, provides financial assistance to high-achieving students from low-income backgrounds who are pursuing higher education. This program aligns with SDG4 and SDG5, emphasising affordable quality education and gender equality. Under this scholarship, students enrolled in their 1st or 2nd year of B. Tech/BE programs PAN India or from the 36 colleges, which are part of the Centre of Excellence will receive financial assistance of INR 50,000 to cover their academic expenses. Virtusa Foundation is an extension of Virtusa Corporation’s global CSR efforts. The foundation actively supports initiatives focused on enhancing healthcare, education, and environmental well-being. With this commitment, Virtusa Foundation has launched this scholarship program. Virtusa is a global leader in Digital Business Transformation, Digital Engineering, and IT outsourcing services. Through its deep industry expertise and seamless technology delivery, Virtusa helps businesses accelerate progress and achieve faster results.Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship 24-25 (PAN India). Eligibility Criteria:- Open to students in their 1st or 2nd year of B. Tech/BE courses across India. Applicants must have achieved a minimum of 70% marks in their 12th grade. The applicant’s annual family income from all sources should be below INR 6,00,000. Children of employees of Virtusa and Buddy4Study are not eligible to participate. Last of Registration:- 20-Jan-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- INR 50,000 for 1 year NOTE: This financial aid can be utilised only for various academic-related expenses, including exam fees, hostel fees, tuition fees, books, stationery, travel, data plans, laptop or tablet, food, and lodging. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/virtusa-scholarship-program Link 2 : https://forms.gle/mRtPqJ8wrNBEyGLY6 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. 2. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Prevention from viral fever : LPU/8.3/HGCR/2024/008/IC/250109/0002 (1/9/2025)
body: At this time of the year, viral fever is a common occurrence. Its common symptoms include: Chills, Sore Throat, Running Nose, Red & Watering Eyes, Body Aches, Cough, Headache Please observe following precautions as preventive measures: 1) Wash your hands frequently, this will prevent spreading the disease through physical constant. 2) Cover your mouth and nose with mask/ handkerchief when in the vicinity of infected people. 3) Don’t use your palms to cover your mouth while coughing or sneezing as you will transfer virus to your hand which will subsequently transmit to someone else. 4) If you have fever, consult your doctor for advice.

body: Dear students, Hope you are refreshed from the Holidays and ready to take up new assignments. We are thrilled to announce the launch of LPU SkillUp Club, an exciting initiative designed to help us grow together, learn new skills and stay ahead in an ever-evolving VUCA (Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity, and Ambiguity) world. If you are somebody who wants to learn new skills, is a technology geek, or marketing enthusiast, a great public speaker, someone willing to build networking skills, or simply looking to meet like-minded individuals, try something new, or carve your own niche in your chosen field of study and help other students too in being industry and ready,then the LPU SkillUp Club is the best choice for you. The LPU SkillUp Club is ideal for students looking to expand their skill sets, contribute to a collaborative campus environment, and take initiative in their personal and professional growth. In short, this LPU SkillUp Club is the best platform for all LPU students belonging to different streams to connect, learn new skills and grow for their personal and professional journeys. To start this Club, we are inviting applications for various positions. Eligibility criteria: * Students of any course, any year with a minimum of 7 GPA may apply. * Enrolled as undergraduate/postgraduate/diploma student at Lovely professional University. * Strong interest in personal development and skills enhancement. * Eagerness to learn and collaborate with peers. * Basic proficiency in MS Office or Google Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). * Prior experience in organizing events or leading peer groups is a plus but not required. Positions available: All the positions will work under, assist and report to the Skills Development Department (under DSW) of Lovely Professional University. Faculty coordinator: Ms Shruti Chatwal. JOB DESCRIPTIONS can be viewed here https://shorturl.at/ToGIJ Here is the list of positions: 01. Coordinator (1) 02. (2 positions) * Marketing and sponsorship.(2 positions) * Social Media. (2 positions) * Public speaking/ Anchoring/MC. (2 positions) * Graphic designer. (2 positions) * Videographer/ Video Editor. (2 positions) * Photographer/ Photo Editor. (2 positions) How to apply/ Important timelines: * Please Click on the link below: to apply https://forms.gle/DxDN17QnrAg3AVS98 * Deadline to submit the applications: Wed, Jan 16, by 6:00 pm. * Scrutiny of applications, personal Interviews and results: From Jan 16-22. * Announcing the results/launching the Club: Jan 24. * Training of the office bearers: End of Jan,2025. * Meeting with the Skills Development team, expectation setting and getting started: First week of Feb. Last date for sending the application is Wed, Jan 16, by 6:00 pm. Let’s build a community where we inspire, support, and challenge each other to grow. Together, we’ll unlock new opportunities and have fun while learning! For any further queries, you may contact the undersigned: Shruti Chatwal (32882) Assistant Director, Room no 314, Building 13 Department of Innovation and Skill Development Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship Student Welfare Wing innovation.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: EDU-REVOLUTION: BE THE CHANGE. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DAA)/2024/023(23.2)/IC/250108/0057 (1/8/2025)
body: The beginning of the Spring Term 2024-25 at Lovely Professional University will mark the onset of an EDU-REVOLUTION, bringing in a transformative shift in education where AI will be your learning companion. A student-centric approach will take center stage, catering to diverse learning styles while emphasizing real-world applications and incorporating gamification in education. Students will be offered a variety of learning options tailored to their individual capabilities and styles. The initiatives will be designed to provide flexibility in key academic areas, all aimed at enhancing your learning experience and ensuring your success. This initiative will address the following key aspects: A. Course Equivalence and Attendance Relaxation B. Grade Revision and Overall Welfare (GROW) C. 10 % Attendance waiver for students in Pre-final/Final year of the programme D. Continuous Assessment Reduction Through Experience (CARE) E. Students in active decision-making through Student Committees [A] Course Equivalence and Attendance Relaxation: The students will be provided an opportunity to seek attendance relaxation and course equivalence for some courses registered to him/her in the upcoming term through various platforms as detailed below. 1. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL): For basic elementary courses such as English, Mathematics, Analytical skills, Soft skills etc.- Before the start of each term, students who believe they already possess the required knowledge or skills in a course registered to him/her in upcoming term, can request a relaxation from the course and attendance via an online interface. Upon approval of the request, to qualify for RPL course equivalence and attendance relaxation the student must take a RPL examination within 15 days of the term's start to assess their prior learning. A minimum grade of B+ (7 GPA) is required to be earned for the exemption. Upon successful qualification, grade earned by the student in RPL examination will be directly reflected in the final DMC and student will be exempted from Attendance, CA and examinations of the course. A student can select only one course in a term under Recognition of prior learning (RPL). 2. NPTEL Course/MOOCs/Certifications: A student can request for course and attendance relaxation in upcoming term’s course in lieu of any NPTEL Course/MOOCs/Certifications he/she wishes to pursue in that term. The request will be submitted by the student through an online interface at the start of the term. Eligibility to apply under this category will be CGPA based: Program Year CGPA requirement Maximum course count 1st Year* 7.5 and above 1 2nd, 3rd and 4th Year 8 and above 1 a. Students meeting the above CGPA eligibility conditions will not be required to attend classes or appear for examinations of the equivalent course. On successful completion of the NPTEL Course/MOOC/Certification, he/she would be required to submit the certificate of completion through an online interface and will be graded accordingly. b. Students who do not meet the CGPA eligibility criteria may still pursue a NPTEL Course/MOOC/Certification, but will not be granted any exemptions from attendance, classes, or exams. Upon successful completion, the higher grade in the equivalent course will be updated. 3. Pursuing Project: Students wishing to pursue project against any course of upcoming term may receive course equivalence and attendance relaxation as per the table given below. Program Year CGPA requirement Maximum course count 1st Year* 7.5 and above 1 2nd, 3rd and 4th Year 8 and above 1 At the start of the term, the student can submit details of any project he/she wishes to complete during the term. The student will submit the request through an online interface, after which it will be reviewed for course equivalence and attendance relaxation, subject to approval. The student will be clearly required to state the final outcome of project like AI Based Apps/Patent/Copyright/Publication/Industry funding/ Government sponsorship (like ATAL Innovation Mission) at the time of request submission for equivalence. The best project will also be selected for Project Expo and students will be rendered rational financial support by the university. 4. Any other: In addition to above, the students may also suggest any additional aspect with regard to which the student is seeking course equivalence and attendance relaxation in the upcoming term. In this regard the student can submit his/her request through the online interface. NOTE: A student will be eligible to apply for MAXIMUM 2 COURSES IN A TERM for seeking course equivalence and attendance relaxation. [B] Grade Revision and Overall Welfare (GROW): As the University believes that Learning never Ends, and learning styles of each student may differ, the students will now be extended an opportunity to improve their existing grade(s) through various other learning options as: 1. Competitions/Hackathons: Students who demonstrate exceptional performance in internationally or nationally recognized competitions or hackathons can request for grade upgradation in an equivalent course studied in current/previous terms. 2. Entrepreneurial Venture: Student pursuing freelancing or a start -up venture can request for grade upgradation in a course based on revenue generated through the entrepreneurial venture. 3. Publications/Patents/Copyrights shall also be considered for relevant grade upgradation 4. Performance in higher studies, Recruitment Exam (GATE/ JAM, UGC-NET, CAT, AFCAT, CDS, IELTS, CTET etc.) Performance shall be considered at both national and international level 5. Projects/consultancy taken in collaboration with NGO/agency for social service 6. Social Media Presence (Blogs/Vlogs created and posted on various social media platforms) The requests for the same will be submitted by students through an online interface. After review, if the new accomplishments reflect a higher grade, your original grade may be upgraded [C] 10 % Attendance waiver for students in Pre-final/Final year of the programme: Students with a CGPA of 8 or higher can apply for an attendance relaxation in their pre-final/final year. Eligible students will be granted a 10% attendance relaxation to support their career development for pursuing the following aspirations like: 1. Preparation of Competitive Exam 2. Preparation of Technical Competition 3. Freelancing Activity/Entrepreneurship/Revenue Generation 4. Industry/ Field Project 5. Consultancy Project 6. Social Service ( for executing social service project) AI Based solutions for companies/institutions The applicability of 10% attendance relaxation is detailed below: Programme duration (in years) Applicability of attendance relaxation 2 In 2nd Year 3 In 3rd Year 4 In 3rd and/or in 4th Year More than 4 In pre-final /final Year The students who wish to apply for the 10% relaxation should submit their requests through UMS at the start of every term and specify the activity he/she wishes to pursue in lieu of attendance relaxation. The attendance relaxation shall be subject to outcome achieved by student in the submitted career development option. [D] Continuous Assessment Reduction through Experience (CARE): Students are required to appear for Continuous Assessment (CA) evaluations, as per their course CA category. However, those wishing to explore innovative learning methods or alternative approaches may apply for CA modifications by opting for real-life problem-solving assignments, social service, blogs, vlogs on social media etc . The course teacher will provide details about the various CA options available for the course during the Zero Lecture. Based on this information, students may apply (through UMS) for CA modifications in one course for the upcoming term. The CA modifications will be approved upon approval from the academic committee. Applicability of Continuous Assessment Reduction through Experience (CARE) Program Year CGPA requirement Maximum course count 1st Year* 7.5 and above 1 2nd, 3rd and 4th Year 8 and above 1 [E] Students in active decision-making through Student Committees Students will be actively involved in decision-making related to academic and learning procedures applicable to them, by becoming a member of various committees as listed below: a. Student Academic and Project Review Committee b. Student Career Committee c. Student entrepreneurship and Media Committee The students can submit their nominations through UMS for becoming members of their desired committee. The members will be selected based on student’s credentials and interview. These committees will operate on defined agenda points and decision areas. UMS link to apply for all the above-mentioned initiatives: UMS Navigation --- LMS EDU Revolution: BE THE CHANGE Students are advised to submit their nominations timely. In case of any query in this regard the student can approach for resolution through RMS at the following path: UMS Navigation--- Relationship management system EDU Revolution: BE THE CHANGE OR get your queries resolved through the Helpline Number: 01824-520150. * First-year students can apply for all of the above initiatives. However, approval of the submitted initiatives will be subject to satisfaction of CGPA requirements after the declaration of the result.
